張偉業與譚家俊等兩對夫婦一同在配音組工作。業將買啤酒送的三個避孕套放衫袋，雪生疑。俊約業傾談在怨婦俱樂部賺外快事，雪聽到誤會。業、俊、明同忙於兼職，雪、君、恩找不到丈夫，以為丈夫行為不軌，決還以顏色。

婦人吳瑞嬌因兒子早年被丈夫賣掉而抱憾終生，藉著出千及飲酒麻醉自己。嬌在麻雀館出千被警察姚家傑逮住，嬌契女方綺莉助嬌脫險時遇意外昏迷，嬌怒斥傑。傑因自小是孤兒，知嬌往事後，感同身受，與嬌變得投緣，答應助嬌尋子。傑悉心照料病床上的莉，二人感情大增，與嬌亦融洽得儼如母子。莉所住大廈清拆在即，想往大陸發展。嬌恐莉因放不下自己而放棄，訛稱找到失去的兒子，但終被揭破。嬌決與莉一起北上，此時傑亦尋回嬌子聰仔讓母子相認。

B3建議讓大翹加入特工行列，小嬌卻表明會於任務後退出。大翹得悉B3是特工後感雀躍，還主動請纓加入。小嬌偶遇大勁，各自說出心底話，小嬌希望大勁暫時遠離她，以保障高家安全。大勁開始物色新居，期待小嬌回來重新開始。大翹在羅娜的追求者面前「宣示主權」，隨時被控傷人，羅娜要大翹隨她同往道歉，大翹卻拒絕。A5要脅香港政府，稱會在鬧市散播病毒，小嬌分析A5下手地點，鎖定某大商場……同一時間，有A5手下擄走希朗。

小嬌收到A5傳來的短片，要趕往營救希朗，只能將拆彈任務交予B3。高歐以一敵三救走希朗；小嬌向家人坦白，還為自己連累家人安全而道歉，決定於這段高危時期留家保護眾人。高家高度戒備，以免壞人有機可乘。大勁見小嬌注射增強劑，擔心小嬌身體受損。A5再威脅香港政府，B3等懷疑襲擊地點是數據城。小嬌下令眾人留家，大翹卻偷偷離家，大勁跟蹤下發覺他到了數據城。見小嬌有麻煩，大勁出手護花，但小嬌只想他離開以保安全……
孝義在返回南京途中發難出走，在河邊遇見月鳳，月鳳開解他。二人回家途中遇到有人舉行喪事，孝義被喪家指毒死其父親，要他填命。糾纏期間月鳳被撞倒在地上，日軍出現替孝義解圍。月鳳動了胎氣，幸終順利誕下麟兒，萬齊替兒子取名天命。萬齊不理平安反對，決舉家返回南京。昭兒打傷睛睛，被世昌勒令停工，泓山乘機游說她替自己拍戲。孝義絕食多天，松田毅做餡餅給他，孝義憶起亡母，父子關係緩和。萬齊等人終於回到南京。

后妒忌意，更為免除後患而計劃將意送出宮外。意定時為昇執拾房間，乾隆看準機會接近她。意誤會昇製造機會給隆，感被昇出賣。安把意賣給人肉販子，乾隆得知後大動肝火，毒打他洩忿。乾隆對意死心不息，更為找尋意而不惜杜撰藉口派昇到民間查察，更派清沿途相護。昇追查得知意被賣落楊州，二人遂起程趕赴。昇到達青樓林立的楊州，大開眼界。昇到妓院萬花樓見識，畫眉、相思、喜鵲及杜鵑四大花魁獻技之餘又大考顧客對酒的認識。昇大膽向花魁較量，結果大獲全勝，眾人佩服不已。蘇三見花魁大敗，親自出馬與昇較量。

龍哥瘋狂加息，立本認為是勒索，決不再還錢。志勤下令以恐嚇手段追債，天佑與手下拿動物內臟拋到立本家外，天佑逃走時打傷警察。天佑流落鄉間，又掛念父母，忍不住聯絡翠花。力弘發現志勤先前所交的計劃書有問題，警方找志勤調查天佑和龍哥，志勤大力否認同二人有關係。力弘得知志勤在外經營財務公司，更涉嫌放高利貸，大為憤怒。小敏眼睛康復，力弘替她高興，二人關係大有進展。進毅決定辭職到外國留學，委託裘莉售樓，但小敏卻要承擔部份損失，為進毅負上鉅債，小敏堅決拒絕力弘幫她還債，並冷卻二人關係。

小敏到銀行借貸，雖要支付高息，仍被逼借下。力弘提出助小敏還債，並告知自幼喪母，與父親關係疏離，童年並不愉快，小敏感同情，漸接受力弘。天佑約見父母告別，被小敏發現，幸小敏早已報警，警察拘捕一干人等。天佑反省自己過去，決意改過。志勤發現自己被通緝，欲自殺但卻沒勇氣，力弘陪他到警局自首。貫庭為保公司聲譽，請永亨代志勤處理官司，表示只要志勤能償還騙取公司的錢，可保留現職，不作追究。力弘認為貫庭包庇志勤，為公司聲譽破壞公義和法律，大為不滿。貫庭覺力弘滿口理想，忽略現實，非做大事之才。

正當鐵將被處斬之際，清帶皇上口諭要博刀下留人。皇上要博將功補過重審鐵之案。博雖不敢違抗皇命，惟有表面上對炳言聽計從。炳向鐵說出在辰屍體上發現有長針傷口，但鐵不肯回答一心求死。英偷入牢房找鐵，更向他道明真相。英欲殺鐵之際，幸被埋伏的官兵捉拿。鐵一案令皇上對炳另眼相看，博見炳日漸受器重甚感不悅，更獨自到酒館喝悶酒。博重遇汪正，汪正為答謝博在山西一案放過他，主動向博獻計。博與炳吃飯更向他道歉，炳以為好友已改過。嫻正欲離開周家之際，郎卻找上周家。炳憑其口才，令郎答應與嫻再比賽。

郎為免嫻抵賴，要求雙方畫押作實擇日重賽。牛縣丞等人搜獲未完稅之貨物，發現全是景德鎮所出產之官瓷。博審問貨主時，發現是山西撤職官員司馬文風。果因病訪尋名醫而到臨金山縣，博把搜獲貨物之事向果報告。博回家祭祖，相邀果同行。恭見兒子事業有成，過分高興而酒後失言，幸得炳阻止。果成功得悉博之身世後暗喜。果向博道出他的身世，更要脅博將貨物放行。博趕回家向父親問明一切，為了自己仕途只得為果辦事，把貨物放行。擊走比賽將至，炳因嫻之終身大事而着緊。嫻在比賽時想出了新的規則，終於把郎難倒。

威訪問贏得高球賽的高生，高生提及是按摩大師貢品替他治好腰患，晶晶提議找貢品做專訪，Susan自動請纓到電視台找貢品做訪問，卻被徐監製阻止。玫瑰被貢品吸引，當發現貢品與她住同一樓層，即用望遠鏡偷窺對方。Susan未能成功訪問貢品，玫瑰提出協助她，以鄰居的身分接近貢品，請他幫忙修理水喉與廁所，豈料……玫瑰與Susan看見貝兒與貢品熟稔，遂向貝兒迫供，玫瑰不惜以減租誘貝兒答應貢品的提議。玫瑰上門找貢品借東西，發現貢品的初戀女友樣貌與貝兒甚為相似；玫瑰更借貢品按摩之名向眾女收費……

瑪利的妙手仁心會與桂森的善心坊，一起開會商量慈善籌款晚會；當談到支票頒贈儀式，善心坊表示將由桂森代表上台，瑪利提出桂森見到偶像時可能會失控出醜，並當眾數落她的缺點。瑪利為補償桂森，帶她到城中名人孔太的墟藝廊欣賞名畫；瑪利安排桂森在墟藝廊畫畫，孔太看到桂森的畫後大讚她有天分，即場用十萬元買了她的畫，更邀桂森為她的畫展再畫五幅畫。桂森在墟藝廊畫了四日四夜畫叫苦連天，國柱特意帶飯菜給妻子並安慰她。田凱給國柱看孔太因當街剪露宿者頭髮及亂派錢被警察捉拿的相片，並指孔太有精神病……

國棟收到一批眼鏡盒後親自送到賀昌眼鏡店；國楝回到店內，不禁回憶起與前妻賀嘉寶的往事……思雅睡眠不足戴不上隱形眼鏡，Susan提議她做激光矯視手術，但國柱聞言謂激光矯視有風險。思雅悄悄找國棟商量進行激光矯視，剛好發現思翰也在，思雅竟要二人發毒誓保密。國柱看見國棟找眼科專科詹醫生咭片，擔心國棟因視網膜曾脫落而舊患復發。國柱致電國棟，但因國棟於深圳過關而匆忙掛線；思翰回家發現國柱躲在房中飲悶酒。國柱取出國棟穿上警員制服的相片，說自己當年為了阻止國棟當差而打了弟弟，更毀了他一生……

國棟收到一批眼鏡盒後親自送到賀昌眼鏡店；國楝回到店內，不禁回憶起與前妻賀嘉寶的往事……思雅睡眠不足戴不上隱形眼鏡，Susan提議她做激光矯視手術，但國柱聞言謂激光矯視有風險。思雅悄悄找國棟商量進行激光矯視，剛好發現思翰也在，思雅竟要二人發毒誓保密。國柱看見國棟找眼科專科詹醫生咭片，擔心國棟因視網膜曾脫落而舊患復發。國柱致電國棟，但因國棟於深圳過關而匆忙掛線；思翰回家發現國柱躲在房中飲悶酒。國柱取出國棟穿上警員制服的相片，說自己當年為了阻止國棟當差而打了弟弟，更毀了他一生……

后妒忌意，更為免除後患而計劃將意送出宮外。意定時為昇執拾房間，乾隆看準機會接近她。意誤會昇製造機會給隆，感被昇出賣。安把意賣給人肉販子，乾隆得知後大動肝火，毒打他洩忿。乾隆對意死心不息，更為找尋意而不惜杜撰藉口派昇到民間查察，更派清沿途相護。昇追查得知意被賣落楊州，二人遂起程趕赴。昇到達青樓林立的楊州，大開眼界。昇到妓院萬花樓見識，畫眉、相思、喜鵲及杜鵑四大花魁獻技之餘又大考顧客對酒的認識。昇大膽向花魁較量，結果大獲全勝，眾人佩服不已。蘇三見花魁大敗，親自出馬與昇較量。

龍哥瘋狂加息，立本認為是勒索，決不再還錢。志勤下令以恐嚇手段追債，天佑與手下拿動物內臟拋到立本家外，天佑逃走時打傷警察。天佑流落鄉間，又掛念父母，忍不住聯絡翠花。力弘發現志勤先前所交的計劃書有問題，警方找志勤調查天佑和龍哥，志勤大力否認同二人有關係。力弘得知志勤在外經營財務公司，更涉嫌放高利貸，大為憤怒。小敏眼睛康復，力弘替她高興，二人關係大有進展。進毅決定辭職到外國留學，委託裘莉售樓，但小敏卻要承擔部份損失，為進毅負上鉅債，小敏堅決拒絕力弘幫她還債，並冷卻二人關係。

小敏到銀行借貸，雖要支付高息，仍被逼借下。力弘提出助小敏還債，並告知自幼喪母，與父親關係疏離，童年並不愉快，小敏感同情，漸接受力弘。天佑約見父母告別，被小敏發現，幸小敏早已報警，警察拘捕一干人等。天佑反省自己過去，決意改過。志勤發現自己被通緝，欲自殺但卻沒勇氣，力弘陪他到警局自首。貫庭為保公司聲譽，請永亨代志勤處理官司，表示只要志勤能償還騙取公司的錢，可保留現職，不作追究。力弘認為貫庭包庇志勤，為公司聲譽破壞公義和法律，大為不滿。貫庭覺力弘滿口理想，忽略現實，非做大事之才。

正當鐵將被處斬之際，清帶皇上口諭要博刀下留人。皇上要博將功補過重審鐵之案。博雖不敢違抗皇命，惟有表面上對炳言聽計從。炳向鐵說出在辰屍體上發現有長針傷口，但鐵不肯回答一心求死。英偷入牢房找鐵，更向他道明真相。英欲殺鐵之際，幸被埋伏的官兵捉拿。鐵一案令皇上對炳另眼相看，博見炳日漸受器重甚感不悅，更獨自到酒館喝悶酒。博重遇汪正，汪正為答謝博在山西一案放過他，主動向博獻計。博與炳吃飯更向他道歉，炳以為好友已改過。嫻正欲離開周家之際，郎卻找上周家。炳憑其口才，令郎答應與嫻再比賽。

郎為免嫻抵賴，要求雙方畫押作實擇日重賽。牛縣丞等人搜獲未完稅之貨物，發現全是景德鎮所出產之官瓷。博審問貨主時，發現是山西撤職官員司馬文風。果因病訪尋名醫而到臨金山縣，博把搜獲貨物之事向果報告。博回家祭祖，相邀果同行。恭見兒子事業有成，過分高興而酒後失言，幸得炳阻止。果成功得悉博之身世後暗喜。果向博道出他的身世，更要脅博將貨物放行。博趕回家向父親問明一切，為了自己仕途只得為果辦事，把貨物放行。擊走比賽將至，炳因嫻之終身大事而着緊。嫻在比賽時想出了新的規則，終於把郎難倒。

昇與三較量之際，蛇羣突然出現，三誤會昇搗亂而與他起衝突，總捕頭年茂林將他們帶返公堂。知府楊古審理案件，他得知清與昇是京城要人後不敢輕率處理。古聽罷三與昇陳述事件經過，知悉是誤會一場，遂將他們釋放。惡霸周日炳是清的堂兄，他與清相認後，便借清的聲明與林勾結，經營黑市人肉販賣市場。昇在市內吃了不潔食物，古擔心他責怪自己管理不周。三與古甚為投契，她知悉古為了昇的事而煩擾，提出設和頭宴，好讓昇對楊州留下好印象。昇見店舖售賣宮中物品，猜測意被賣到此地。炳知昇找尋一宮女，遂與林施計敲詐。

永亨替志勤打官司，令志勤脫罪，而天佑被判入獄，天佑答應悔改。力弘在工作上處處針對志勤，但志勤為求賺錢還債，一直忍耐，等候機會翻身。美宜與小敏和寶欣等富太合作舉辦兒童畫展為兒童之家籌募經費，但美宜不滿富太只想借畫展出風頭，畫展差點腹死胎中。永亨建議貫庭拓展內地信貸市場，但力弘忙於籌備畫展，表明對事業沒野心。貫庭身體漸差，欲力弘早日繼承公司。力弘為畫展忙碌，更不惜送外賣和扮公仔娛賓，小敏感動。畫展場地的清潔工人梁好，工作時突然暈倒，力弘與小敏陪她送院，醫生謂她患上肝癌。

力弘思念亡母，回憶當年父親並沒告知其母患上絕症，令他沒好好與母親渡過最後的日子，此事成他一生最大的憾事。永亨叫貫庭應及早拓展公司北上計劃及安排接班人，貫庭苦惱。浚豪因母親患病被送往兒童之家，小敏發現浚豪生父李貴在獄中服刑，浚豪告知小敏痛恨李貴拋棄自己和母親，拒絕由父親照顧。貫庭因工作勞累感不適，要求力弘多放時間在工作上，力弘感厭煩，拒絕了貫庭。小敏約李貴往探望浚豪，李貴到兒童之家卻偷東西，更把罪名推落浚豪身上。浚豪默默承受，向小敏和力弘表明事實，小敏和力弘欣賞浚豪懂事。

郎在比賽佔上風，卿替嫻打出最後一球為嫻贏得比賽。炳以為自己可享齊人之福時，嫻卻表明今後兩人只是朋友。炳得悉博放走文風後大表不滿，博終說出果是山西一幫高官的幕後黑手，而博更以打擊果為由解釋為何放走文風。博要恭與麟說出所有知道他身世的人，恭把炳之名說出。恭決定找當年替麟夫人接生的穩婆何二姑商量，卻不慎把她殺死，恭不欲兒子受牽連寧願自首。果以恭之性命迫博協助自己運鴉片，博不欲受制，以苦肉計迫恭自盡。炳找麟商討營救友恭，博乘機說出果要脅他運鴉片一事，炳獻計讓博向皇上揭發此事。

恭死前寫下遺書給炳，要他義無反顧地幫助博，更把炳父親留下祖居之事告知他。博與炳在上京途中經過父母被殺之處，博因此得悉炳之身世。炳拜祭父母時遇上一白衣女子程大娘，娘把當年炳父親周雄之死的真相說出。炳陪伴大娘回家時遇上果，才知道謀害他父母的人正是果。炳因大腿受傷不能上京面聖，博決定自行前往。皇上接見博更對他賜予封賞，博感前途一片光明。皇上發現已解散的粘杆處文件，博亦因此得悉雍正曾被刺之事。博為求領功，不惜把炳身分說出。炳有感在朝廷工作太危險，答應卿辭去幕僚一職。

國柱的一巴掌不但令國棟視網膜脫落，也粉碎了他的警察夢；國柱醒來，估計自己喝醉後胡亂說話。思翰接國棟來電，要求他到賀昌眼鏡替茂叔修理電腦，思翰聽到茂叔稱呼國棟為姑爺，令思翰大感興趣。國柱致電詹醫生查詢國棟眼睛手術的事，對方拒絕透露；國柱在餐廳聽到玫瑰對國棟的時間表很清楚，於是假扮四川客戶探聽國棟手術的日期。國柱、桂森及瑪利到醫院見到國棟，以為手術已完成；國棟乘機責問兄長是否後悔當年打了他，國柱謂要自己捐出眼睛給弟也願意。思雅完成手術後出來，國柱才知道原來思雅做了矯視手術。

國棟剛回到公司門外，便聽到玫瑰痛罵家明被人騙走貨物。家明因遲交租被趕走，無家可歸下只得在外度宿，結果被保安棠發現。國棟發現band房的新成員竟是家明，但見家明對樂器一竅不通。家明神不守舍，國棟與玫瑰追問下家明說出愛上了晶晶，他更為了見晶晶決定辭職，欲轉到高瞻做辦公室助理。玫瑰謂會設法令他天天能見晶晶。晶晶與田凱為家務煩惱，玫瑰提議他們聘請家務助理；晶晶與田凱回家，發現家務助理是家明。晶晶與田凱決定請家明長期協助家務，玫瑰使出一招以退為進，成功令田凱讓家明遷進他家。

瑪利煮冬瓜盅，但國柱寧只吃白麵包裹腹，桂森明白丈夫為保持味覺敏銳以擔任廚神比賽評判。比賽上國柱吃一口便知道是哪位參賽大師的作品，更批評參賽者關大吉加多了薑片。玫瑰閒聊時說的話，竟令貝兒感到迷惘。貝兒教學生煮蝦籽鴨汁燴遼參，國柱試吃後批評味道太濃。貝兒向玫瑰說出自己習慣了遷就父親的口味。貝兒與思翰分別煮了海參，思翰覺得自己的作品太差而倒掉，向貝兒借她烹調的海參給瑪利品嚐。國柱吃了一口海參，驚覺是一生人從未嚐過的好味道，家人發現國柱舉止失常，平日不吃的食物統統放進口。

郎在比賽佔上風，卿替嫻打出最後一球為嫻贏得比賽。炳以為自己可享齊人之福時，嫻卻表明今後兩人只是朋友。炳得悉博放走文風後大表不滿，博終說出果是山西一幫高官的幕後黑手，而博更以打擊果為由解釋為何放走文風。博要恭與麟說出所有知道他身世的人，恭把炳之名說出。恭決定找當年替麟夫人接生的穩婆何二姑商量，卻不慎把她殺死，恭不欲兒子受牽連寧願自首。果以恭之性命迫博協助自己運鴉片，博不欲受制，以苦肉計迫恭自盡。炳找麟商討營救友恭，博乘機說出果要脅他運鴉片一事，炳獻計讓博向皇上揭發此事。

恭死前寫下遺書給炳，要他義無反顧地幫助博，更把炳父親留下祖居之事告知他。博與炳在上京途中經過父母被殺之處，博因此得悉炳之身世。炳拜祭父母時遇上一白衣女子程大娘，娘把當年炳父親周雄之死的真相說出。炳陪伴大娘回家時遇上果，才知道謀害他父母的人正是果。炳因大腿受傷不能上京面聖，博決定自行前往。皇上接見博更對他賜予封賞，博感前途一片光明。皇上發現已解散的粘杆處文件，博亦因此得悉雍正曾被刺之事。博為求領功，不惜把炳身分說出。炳有感在朝廷工作太危險，答應卿辭去幕僚一職。

瑪利煮冬瓜盅，但國柱寧只吃白麵包裹腹，桂森明白丈夫為保持味覺敏銳以擔任廚神比賽評判。比賽上國柱吃一口便知道是哪位參賽大師的作品，更批評參賽者關大吉加多了薑片。玫瑰閒聊時說的話，竟令貝兒感到迷惘。貝兒教學生煮蝦籽鴨汁燴遼參，國柱試吃後批評味道太濃。貝兒向玫瑰說出自己習慣了遷就父親的口味。貝兒與思翰分別煮了海參，思翰覺得自己的作品太差而倒掉，向貝兒借她烹調的海參給瑪利品嚐。國柱吃了一口海參，驚覺是一生人從未嚐過的好味道，家人發現國柱舉止失常，平日不吃的食物統統放進口。

epg.programme_title_en: To Marry by Demand of My Husband
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 吳明找來世伯投資，請他當公司董事長。兩人對李玫瑰及馬蓮娜有意，展開追求。玫瑰已有未婚夫鄭清河，而娜亦已婚，但河誤會玫瑰變心，竟幫董事長追求玫瑰，娜夫馮威文亦糊里糊塗助明追求娜。幸最終兩對佳偶冰釋和好。
以獵鷓鴣為生的程國元到一別墅借宿，遇女鬼何小鳳。原來鳳因得知庶母與情夫曾仁富的姦情，而遭富毒殺。時鳳父從外地歸來，感鳳之死有可疑，富為除後患，欲殺鳳父，元與鳳往營救，元更得知鳳原來是人，兩人成為眷屬。

epg.programme_title_en: Hero and the Beauty, The Pt.II
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: （續上集）傅天麟與甄秋水帶朱痕鐵劍找到師叔丹心劍客。逍遙子等人搶去劍，將麟打下山崖，幸大難不死。心自揭身份原來他是水的師父。大戰中，邪派高手挾持水，指她乃明朝遺裔瓊花公主，香師父突然倒戈，將敗局扭轉。
王爺調戲岑梅娘，鄒詩魂為梅解圍。後魂得知梅是其未婚妻，惜梅父嫌魂窮，逼魂退婚，魂暗中與梅商討私奔。王爺得悉將魂打至重傷，幸被王爺之妹相救。大婚日，梅行刺王爺事敗，幸魂出現重創王爺，王爺醒悟成全魂和梅。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: （續上集）傅天麟與甄秋水帶朱痕鐵劍找到師叔丹心劍客。逍遙子等人搶去劍，將麟打下山崖，幸大難不死。心自揭身份原來他是水的師父。大戰中，邪派高手挾持水，指她乃明朝遺裔瓊花公主，香師父突然倒戈，將敗局扭轉。
王爺調戲岑梅娘，鄒詩魂為梅解圍。後魂得知梅是其未婚妻，惜梅父嫌魂窮，逼魂退婚，魂暗中與梅商討私奔。王爺得悉將魂打至重傷，幸被王爺之妹相救。大婚日，梅行刺王爺事敗，幸魂出現重創王爺，王爺醒悟成全魂和梅。
何慧仙驚見伯父何書麟中刀身亡，報警求助。原來仙夫劉大偉與洪剛為奪麟的家財，殺害麟，嫁禍給李文中。中找仙幫忙，發現飛刀手趙標乃兇手。偉、剛見事情敗露，欲殺仙奪其遺產，幸警方趕至，迅速在24小時內破案。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 吳明找來世伯投資，請他當公司董事長。兩人對李玫瑰及馬蓮娜有意，展開追求。玫瑰已有未婚夫鄭清河，而娜亦已婚，但河誤會玫瑰變心，竟幫董事長追求玫瑰，娜夫馮威文亦糊里糊塗助明追求娜。幸最終兩對佳偶冰釋和好。

epg.programme_title_en: Young Swordsman Lung Kim Fei, The (Pt 1)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 龍劍飛被師妹及其夫所害，幸得「金眼神鵰」相救，並被古漢魂收為義子，習得如來神掌。飛為醫治魂雙眼往取金龍之子，途中救了奉孫碧玲之命往取金龍之子的裘玉華和裘玉娟，二人贈金龍之子予飛。飛往裘家，玲竟打傷飛。
千金小姐孫小玉嬌生慣養，刁蠻任性。一次在郊外因汽車壞了而闖進林君植家中求助，植無奈讓她留宿，豈料因此令未婚妻趙麗珍誤會，更遭趙父解僱。植與玉猶如貼錯門神，但在植之好友撮合下，兩人終共譜戀曲，琴瑟和鳴。
元帝無道，欺壓百姓，陶安、陶國兄弟欲投靠朱元璋的義軍，卻遭奸人所害以致家破人亡。後來，安幾經辛苦終尋回妻子大娘與女兒小安，豈料欽差垂涎大娘的美色，他強搶大娘並把安拘捕，幸國帶人趕至，成功救出兄嫂。
任本善見仇萬年身懷巨款，財迷心竅，將「血紙人黨」的標記放在他身上加以陷害，大隊長將年拘捕。年遭槍決，善得年財產。年女兒仇金花暗中調查善，善得知後欲殺花，卻槍傷秋菊。大隊長跟善駁火，兩人終被對方槍擊斃。

epg.programme_title_en: Story of a Chaste Woman, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文俊卿兄長俊傑及其妻向母親搬弄是非，卿母趁卿上京趕其妻江秀姑離家。盜賊入城，傑夫婦棄母逃生。卿高中狀元，傑夫婦恐受責，收買飛天老鼠毒害母親，並嫁禍給姑。傑夫婦滅口失敗，鼠報仇前迫傑坦承一切，還姑清白。

epg.programme_title_en: Young Swordsman Lung Kim Fei, The (Pt 2)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: （續上集）孫碧玲為引出古漢魂，囚禁龍劍飛，幸裘玉華與裘玉娟救出飛。娟穿上火雲戰衣引開追兵，卻被玲打下山崖。玲得知華、飛等行蹤，遂與各派對付他們。華、飛等不敵，幸魂趕至，並使出如來神掌擊敗玲，化解恩仇。
李秀珍與房客王俊青相戀，珍父母嫌青窮，反對二人交往。珍為助青母籌措醫藥費，應徴藥行的工展攤位售貨員，老闆錢開眼垂涎珍美色，以移花接木之計，誘騙珍父母答應婚事。青悉奸計，與眾租客施計向錢太告密破壞婚禮。
洪興邦之父被將軍趙通所殺，邦矢志報仇。邦與師弟玄雲巧遇女扮男裝的鳳美郡主，原來她暗中查探通密謀造反一事。邦等人得通義妹陸彩蓮相助潛入趙府，經過一番惡鬥，成功制服通。後來邦知道美實乃郡主，兩人終成眷屬。
方濤在雨中遇上丁家女孩，後得知女孩原來是午夜嚎哭的亡靈，於是濤往丁園詢問門公，得悉丁家小姐秀華自殺離世，追查下，還從「女鬼」口中獲悉事件與華後母有關。濤決為華討回公道，終讓幕後黑手道出謀財害命的真相。

陳季常遭妻柳玉娥管束，好友蘇東坡替其不值指責娥，娥向皇上告狀，坡受罰。坡為報復以表妹琴操引誘常，常欲立她為妾而遭娥重罰。坡著常休妻，事情鬧至金鑾殿。娥寧喝毒酒誓不讓步，幸皇后換掉毒藥，常悔疚與娥和好。

城中發生命案，死者身首異處。探長梁泰炎帶同助手綠楊幾經搜查後，梁探長發現死者疑是失蹤的商人胡貴祥，於是率眾手下向貴祥妻周綺華及司理黎連德問話。梁探長經詳細調查後，發現案情疑點重重。綺華原來與連德曾經相戀，後來貴祥在二人逃難時，竟將綺華強暴，因此綺華才嫁給貴祥。連德心生不忿，竟將貴祥殺死洩恨，更企圖將幫兇滅口，消滅所有證據，幸幫兇最後將真相和盤托出。梁探長緝捕連德時，二人發生打鬥，連德失足墮樓身亡。
花國偉不務正業，花天酒地。一日，偉偶遇謝玉霞，一見傾心，遂請求父親讓其打理酒家，欲親近霞，又資助霞母治病，終打動了霞。豈料偉婚後故態復萌，霞施計騙偉金錢以保花家業。偉一貧如洗，決發奮做人，終獲霞原諒。

陳季常遭妻柳玉娥管束，好友蘇東坡替其不值指責娥，娥向皇上告狀，坡受罰。坡為報復以表妹琴操引誘常，常欲立她為妾而遭娥重罰。坡著常休妻，事情鬧至金鑾殿。娥寧喝毒酒誓不讓步，幸皇后換掉毒藥，常悔疚與娥和好。
鏢頭呂騰空受託護送錦盒給金鞭大俠韓遜，不料江湖盛傳空護送武林至寶，空與妻西門一娘遭各派截劫，幸終把錦盒送交遜。遜發現內藏兒子頭顱，與空夫婦惡鬥，娘喪命。後遜被殺，其女玉霞誤會空是兇手，將空之子麟毒打。
術士領著一群行屍進城，宋丹萍混於其中，要找軍閥閻將軍報仇，機緣巧合下救了革命志士黃強。原來昔日萍與歌妓花鳳仙相戀，閻因迷戀仙而謀害萍，萍容顏被毁，仙則自殺。萍與革命志士合作，潛入閰府，與閰同歸於盡。

馮曼秋與林愛梨相戀，梨珠胎暗結，秋卻被逼與宮主成親，梨無奈忍痛成全。梨誕下麟兒後無力撫養，只好棄子於秋的官船上，秋不知情下收養了他，梨偶然下獲聘為乳娘。宮主得悉真相，欲放火燒死梨母子，結果害人終害己。

賈天雄的紡織廠周轉不靈，卻因面子而拒絕將之賣掉。雄見馬永年酷似南洋富商馮定德，要年假扮德，以騙好友及錢太母女入股。誰料錢也是表面風光，更要女兒綺萍親近年；年與萍互生情愫，後雄的騙局被揭，幸年獲萍原諒。

何文藻欲娶張翠娥，藻之寡嫂林氏覬覦何家家財，遂與吳德收買算命先生，要藻於成親一年後方可洞房，未料藻於成親日，偷與娥圓房。藻成親後上京謀職，未幾娥有孕，林斥其偷漢，爭執間娥被推倒地上暈倒。林與德以為娥已死，將其埋葬；其實娥未死，並扮成鬼魂藏身古廟，還誕下一子。娥於古廟認識劉華，華代娥向縣府告狀。德知娥未死，派人殺娥，期間一殺手意外死去，德遂誣陷娥殺人。時北京派專員來巡視，該專員竟是藻，藻終替娥雪冤。

epg.programme_title_en: Love Story of Siu Pak Choy & Yeung Nei Mo
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 舉人楊乃武家有賢妻，卻傾慕豆腐小販葛小大的妻子小白菜，遭母親棒打鴛鴦。知縣之子鄭仁賚垂涎菜的美色，毒死大後收買官員，又教唆菜嫁禍於武。武姊上訴至太師，終替弟洗冤，而菜獲太后赦免死罪，帶著大的傻妹離開。
許嘉輝替經理陳大年保管一封信，後卻在家中發現年屍體。輝與女友顧惠儀調查事件，竟發現年妻馬天娜也死去。輝、儀中了警方圈套被捕，雖逃走，卻被人押至陳家，更驚見娜。娜道出殺年嫁禍輝真相並欲殺二人，警方趕至。
甘四爺殺害馬麗華一家，幸華得陳英彪、美玉兩兄妹相救，後隨二人賣藝。甘子家強看上玉，施計欲親近玉，幸被強的情婦李湘揭破其陰謀。四爺重遇華等人，雙方展開打鬥，強預設的陷阱竟害死其父，時警方至將強等人拘捕。
黎秋與陳秀娟、阿六賣欖為生，一次，三人到一大屋避雨，遇女鬼張彩霞。霞被丈夫趙元彬謀財害命，秋替其申冤，卻被知縣當作胡言亂語。彬得知秋狀告自己，施計對付，秋卻堅持助霞。後霞附身彬身上，成功向知縣申冤。
（續下集）呂麟報仇心切，獨自找六指琴魔，並遇上韓玉霞，兩人在琴音操縱下大打出手。譚母擄走女兒月華，欲將她嫁予麟，時琴魔來到，麟和華在琴音影響下發生關係。後麟得到火羽箭，加上東方白捨命對付，終擊敗琴魔。

epg.programme_title_en: Couple and the Magic Lamp, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇帝駕崩，西宮奪位，駙馬衛國忠請任展鵬與白騰蛟相助。林飛鳳、林飛鶯兩姐妹唆使刺殺忠，幸被鵬等人制止。國舅劉厚瑞追殺太子，鵬借助神燈救走他。厚欲屠殺全城嬰兒，蛟以親兒頂替太子，並與鵬、鳳合計終推翻西宮。
閏秀李杏妍遭惡霸岳禮全迫婚，其未婚夫馬子龍亦被加害，幸為寺院方丈所救。妍為保清白而跳海，大難不死的她扮作厲鬼於雨夜出沒，人心惶惶。龍聯同被全迫害的苦主一同報仇，時妍出現，嚇得全墮崖身亡，妍和龍喜重逢。
梅夢雲為避戰火，與戀人阿芳失散。雲父生意失敗，愛上雲的余晚萍以借貸為條件逼婚。雲重遇芳，雲父為使雲死心，求芳假裝已婚。新婚夜雲與萍爭執後離去，萍為報復使計逼芳嫁予其兄。婚期近，芳自殺幸被救，與雲續緣。
徐子超目睹女友羅鳳玲墮樓身亡後，遇上劉福善，並得知羅伯豪當年強搶善妻及其孿生長女玲。玲受豪操縱販毒，直至重遇家人後欲擺脫豪，卻慘遭殺害，而與超相戀的是玲妹鳳珠。超得悉真相後，使計把豪誘到家中繩之以法。
葉文俊與妹玉英、表妹美蘭及英師姐施妙娥成功捉拿密謀造反的八王爺，豈料途中他被人救走。八王爺召集人馬準備起兵，俊等人得悉後欲先發制人，惜俊身中毒針，幸得九指神丐相救。俊等人與神丐裡應外合，終捉拿王爺。

劉競莊下嫁楊正儀，小姑冰嬌常借故令莊難堪，莊曾揚言報復。豈料嬌被殺，儀竟指證莊為兇手，莊被收監。莊姐夫趙君任高中狀元並任巡按，他感莊案疑點重重，遂微服偵查，卻險遭毒手，任大難不死，多番偵查終成功緝兇。
謝小瓊險被後父謝裕姦污，更逼她嫁給范玉山。其後裕被殺，黃二姑的表現，令雷探長起疑，可是二姑離奇斃命。瓊約會凌雲，惹山妒忌，於是誣告雲與命案有關，幸被雷識破。瓊與雲訂婚當晚，山潛入謝家，用槍指嚇瓊與雲…
醫生范俊華與未婚妻馬梅芳素未謀面，華堅拒沒有感情的婚姻。芳隨表妹區美英往看病，認識了華及助手畢烈。范父及馬父召華、芳回鄉成親，二人不知對方是訂婚對象而逃走。兩家各找烈、英代替，烈、英發現後撮合華、芳。
江山家園被燒，幸得新房東孔媽照顧，並與其女孔靜儀相戀。儀介紹山到侯家工作，侯悅容看上山，苦苦痴纏。管家一直覬覦侯家家財，儀因妒嫉竟與管家合謀害容，幸儀懸崖勒馬。容明白山愛儀，毅然讓愛，山與儀共諧連理。
姚庭春與妻田氏覬覦家產，田氏遂毒殺春弟並嫁禍弟婦楊秀珍，珍向兄楊勉求助卻被出賣。珍突然作動，幸得宋世傑妻唐氏助產子，並知悉珍被誣告著傑幫珍寫狀紙。傑施計將包庇田氏的田能等官員玩弄股掌中，成功為珍洗冤。

豔麗女模餘虹敏在一間盛傳鬧鬼的廢棄醫院中離奇身亡。事後,她生前的攝影師不斷接到如怨靈索命般的詭異來電,合作撰稿人突遭嚴重車禍,而她的摯友亦突然離奇失蹤。一連串毛骨悚然的怪事接踵而來,彷彿死者充滿妒恨的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天淩晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名年輕男子被困在一座廢棄的房子裡,拼命要尋找自己被困的線索。原來真相隱藏在連串被瘋傳的影片內,而這些影像亦逐漸影響了他的思想…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trapped in an abandoned house, a young man desperately searches for clues about his trapped situation. The unsettling truth actually lies in a sequence of viral videos and they gradually corrupt his mind…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個霜淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失明的游己任在離島的工廠工作。一天,因颶風的破壞,工廠與外界隔絕。此時突然有一隻怪物來襲,任何看到怪物的人都會化成黑影。因游己任看不見怪物,他能成功協助夥伴安全離開,更奮戰反擊,誓要殺死怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈?  在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個霜淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。凌晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The world descends into darkness when a sealed book, said to command the forces of the universe, is unearthed in an underground palace in the desert. As adventurers race to claim its power, the palace gates open, unleashing an unseen terror and heralding a catastrophe beyond imagination.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前水牛城女警Megan與友人到深山露營時,意外目睹當地警長以私刑處決毒販。事跡敗露後,警長為滅口,竟將他們列為追殺目標。眾人試圖逃離,卻發現所有下山路徑已被封死。為徹底掩蓋罪行,警長公然調動私人武裝民..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a camping trip deep in the mountains, former Buffalo cop Megan and her friends stumble upon the local sheriff unlawfully executing a drug trafficker. Spotted and marked for death, they find every escape route sealed. To cover up his crime, the sheriff summons an armed militia to hunt them down—triggering a deadly chase with no way out.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

epg.programme_title_tc: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz (Ang Pagsanib kay Leah Dela Cruz)
epg.programme_title_en: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 建築師May與男友Gun搬入新居後,驟聞繼母離奇身亡。May收留孤苦的繼妹Noon,怎料她入宅後竟行為詭異,頻遭惡靈附身,而May也陷入恐怖幻象與嚴重失眠的折磨。隨著宅內黑暗秘密逐步揭開,通靈法師終於..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After moving into a house with her boyfriend, Gun, architect May learns of her stepmother’s mysterious death. When May takes in her stepsister Noon, the girl begins showing signs of possession, while May suffers disturbing visions and insomnia. As dark secrets emerge, spiritual masters uncover an ancient black-magic curse hidden within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盂蘭時節,一位無視傳統的職場新人第一天上班即禍從口出,得罪了辦公樓裡的鬼魂。值夜班的過程中,連累同事們一同經歷了許多詭異事件,令他們重新反思自己的不敬行為和對神明的態度。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hungry Ghost Festival is around the corner. A newcomer at a workplace offends the ghosts in his office building when he shows disrespect for the spirits on his first day at work. In the course of a night shift, the man and his colleagues working overtime experience spooky encounters that make them reflect on their behaviours and beliefs...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤獨內向的阿振在工作中飽受同事殘酷欺淩,絕望中他試圖透過網路尋找理想伴侶來救贖心靈。當一位與他夢中情人如出一轍的神秘女子米娜出現後,阿振以為迎來了真愛,不料一連串驚悚詭異的怪事卻接連發生,將他拖入無底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bullied by his coworkers, the lonely Ah Zhen turns to the internet in search of his ideal girl. However, when Mina, the woman of his dreams, suddenly enters his life, a series of unexpected events begins to unfold.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 父親去世後,Nathan和妹妹回到祖家準備出售房子。在此期間,Nathan發現這處房產是從兩名曾被指控濫用巫術的女子的祖先手中偷來的。隨著他深入調查,揭開了一個與父親死亡相關的神秘陰謀,而這個陰謀如今..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their fathers death, Nathan and his sister return to their family home to prepare it for sale. While there, Nathan discovers that the land was stolen from the ancestors of two women accused of witchcraft. As he delves deeper, he uncovers an occult conspiracy linked to their fathers death which now threatens them both.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Olivia, an outstanding vampire romance novelist, longs to encounter a real vampire. Her wish comes true when Luke turns up at her remote snowbound cabin seeking for help. However, her dream transforms into a chilling nightmare on Christmas Eve when Lukes vampire companions track him down...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靜雯是一名努力奮鬥的戲劇學生,為了應付學費開支而接受了一份模特兒的工作。然而,當她為一位專門從事表現性人體素描的神秘藝術家擔任模特兒時,靜雯意外地揭露了一個驚人真相,更將她推向生死邊緣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jing Wen, a struggling drama student, takes on a modelling job to help cover her tuition costs. As she becomes a model for an enigmatic artist specializing in expressive human body sketches, Jing Wen accidentally uncovers a shocking truth, plunging her into a desperate fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在迷霧村,為人養子的文傑反復夢見同一個噩夢。為瞭解開身世之謎,他捲入連串神秘的失蹤案件中。隨著更多村民相繼離奇死去,村民更深信不疑千年來的井龍王詛咒。於是,文傑與保安隊長聯手探尋真相,揭開反派陰謀,最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在迷霧村,為人養子的文傑反復夢見同一個噩夢。為瞭解開身世之謎,他捲入連串神秘的失蹤案件中。隨著更多村民相繼離奇死去,村民更深信不疑千年來的井龍王詛咒。於是,文傑與保安隊長聯手探尋真相,揭開反派陰謀,最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天臺舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,江南某古村接連發生死狀離奇的驚人命案,導致該地淪為方圓百里人人自危的嗜血鬼村「封門村」。記者李穆與警員萬楓結伴深入陰森詭異的荒村,在重重迷霧中抽絲剝繭。面對頻頻發生的靈異異象,他們能否徹底揭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A remote Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes known as the cursed ghost village Fengmen. Determined to uncover the truth, journalist Li Mu joins forces with officer Wan Feng to investigate the chilling incidents. As fear spreads among the villagers, the two risk their lives to expose the dark secrets behind Fengmen.

epg.programme_title_en: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王懷卿賣畫,為要籌藥費救患重病的妻子,途中意外遇上雀妖的追擊,幸得狐妖小容相救。為躲避雀妖,王懷卿將小容帶回家中,三人隨即陷入一場情感困局,而一段淒美的人妖虐戀亦隨即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為逃離家暴陰影,Jennifer搬進212號公寓展開新生活,卻每天醒來身上出現詭異且疼痛的咬痕。她驚覺牆內潛藏著以活人血肉為食的古老寄生怪物。隨著襲擊加劇,面對這場嗜肉噩夢,她必須在被徹底蠶食之前,鼓..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈?  在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. Following the trail to Lingdu City, he encounters Princess Liu Li, who has been cursed into a half-human, half-monster form. Armed with his demon-slaying sword, he battles the demons to save Liu Li and protect the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群漠視勸誡的年青人貿然闖進詭異森林露營作樂,入夜之後,他們內心的邪念驅使他們落入性與愛的關係陷阱,引來了森林裡一連串的靈異事件。黎明將至,他們當中有誰能逃生?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends goes on a camping trip inside a supposedly haunted forest despite warning not to do so. As night falls and camps are set, the complicated relationships of lust and love between them are exposed, triggering a series of paranormal events that punishes them.  When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王懷卿賣畫,為要籌藥費救患重病的妻子,途中意外遇上雀妖的追擊,幸得狐妖小容相救。為躲避雀妖,王懷卿將小容帶回家中,三人隨即陷入一場情感困局,而一段淒美的人妖虐戀亦隨即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為逃離家暴陰影,Jennifer搬進212號公寓展開新生活,卻每天醒來身上出現詭異且疼痛的咬痕。她驚覺牆內潛藏著以活人血肉為食的古老寄生怪物。隨著襲擊加劇,面對這場嗜肉噩夢,她必須在被徹底蠶食之前,鼓..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈?  在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. Following the trail to Lingdu City, he encounters Princess Liu Li, who has been cursed into a half-human, half-monster form. Armed with his demon-slaying sword, he battles the demons to save Liu Li and protect the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群漠視勸誡的年青人貿然闖進詭異森林露營作樂,入夜之後,他們內心的邪念驅使他們落入性與愛的關係陷阱,引來了森林裡一連串的靈異事件。黎明將至,他們當中有誰能逃生?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends goes on a camping trip inside a supposedly haunted forest despite warning not to do so. As night falls and camps are set, the complicated relationships of lust and love between them are exposed, triggering a series of paranormal events that punishes them.  When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家為了挽救低迷的事業,決心創作一部暢銷小說。他重返童年故居,這裡亦是其身為知名作家的父親當年神秘身亡之地。當他意外發現父親留下的最後手稿時,才驚覺這部作品遠超自己的才華。於是,他決定將..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer retreats to his childhood home to finish a novel and save his career. There, he uncovers the final manuscript left behind by his father, a famous writer who died mysteriously years earlier. Realizing the work is beyond his own talent, he decides to plagiarize it, unleashing horrifying supernatural events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,富甲一方的康氏慘遭滅門,唯一的目擊證人—家中的幼女—在親眼目睹全家被殺後離奇失蹤。幾十年間,位於青木巷的廢棄康宅充斥著靈異驚悚的氣氛。隨著真相逐漸揭露,這個恐怖的疑團交織著復仇與死亡的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 思南和丈夫前往吉隆玻度假,希望能緩解懷孕帶來的壓力。然而,她意外發現丈夫有個陰險的計畫,要將他們的孩子變成「碌葛」以謀取利潤,使她陷入危險之中。思南幸得酒店鬼魂的幫助,成功逃脫並報警將丈夫拘捕,最終安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a Luk Krok for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩個立志成為網紅的男生連同一位漂亮女同學,合力在學校後面的舊大樓拍一部靈異實錄片,希望能吸引更多關注。三人遇上校內霸凌同學的富二代男女。原來女同學早已有計劃接近這幾個學校霸凌,籍此展開一場不惜犧牲無辜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A school girl joins two internet content creators in a horror video project filmed in an old building behind their school. The trio encounters a bullying gang and as events unfold, it becomes clear that the girl holds a personal grudge against the gang and is blinded by hatred to exercise justice, even if it means sacrificing the innocents…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幼女離奇失蹤後,悲痛的Drew與Helen在治療師安排下,前往偏遠林中小屋接受深度諮商。隨著孤立與壓抑逐漸侵蝕理智,療癒之旅化為噩夢。Helen飽受詭異幻象與異象困擾,逐漸分不清現實與幻覺,心智瀕臨崩..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy. As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 寂寞的寡婦Joyce瘋狂迷戀年輕的新租客。渴望得到愛情的她,為追求幸福,不惜排除感情路上的一切障礙,甚至要殺人滅口也在所不計!因而展開了一個令人毛骨悚然的迷戀故事 …
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. Before killing herself, she curses them to be haunted in their dreams. As the friends are killed off one by one, they must break the curse to escape their deadly fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。

During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 香港有不少別具代表性的美食，上酒樓就必會吃到各式點心。「My Little Show」，五位只有五至六歲的小女孩穿上中式傳統服裝，並拖着手登場。她們會為觀眾送上一首兒歌<排排坐 吃粉果>，得意動作配合活潑歌聲，好可愛！唱歌前，先玩個小遊戲了解各人的個性。在蝦餃、燒賣、馬拉糕之中，大家最喜愛哪一款點心？
小丸子一家今天吃壽喜燒，但碰巧雞蛋賣光，結果媽媽找到鵪鶉蛋代替。鵪鶉蛋那份美味，令小丸子對鵪鶉產生興趣。當知道鵪鶉幾乎每天都會生蛋，小丸子更有意飼養鵪鶉，讓自己每天都有新鮮的鵪鶉蛋吃。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
雞蛋一跌就碎，但其實堅強得很，不妨試試一手握碎它！母雞孵蛋時亦不會被壓破。四隻雞蛋「團結」的話，即使被數十磅的書壓着，仍然絲毫不損！原來秘密在於雞蛋的圓弧形外殼上，為甚麼它可以擁有巨大的承托力呢？因此，不少大橋或建築物都採用了拱形的設計。陳紹鵬老師用生、熟雞蛋直立旋轉的實驗，詳細說明雞蛋殼內的結構，並講述小雞如何打破堅硬的蛋殼破殼而出。

雞蛋一跌就碎，但其實堅強得很，不妨試試一手握碎它！母雞孵蛋時亦不會被壓破。四隻雞蛋「團結」的話，即使被數十磅的書壓着，仍然絲毫不損！原來秘密在於雞蛋的圓弧形外殼上，為甚麼它可以擁有巨大的承托力呢？因此，不少大橋或建築物都採用了拱形的設計。陳紹鵬老師用生、熟雞蛋直立旋轉的實驗，詳細說明雞蛋殼內的結構，並講述小雞如何打破堅硬的蛋殼破殼而出。
網上流行拍攝奇蹟影片，大雄等人欲仿傚但不成功，多啦A夢借他「奇蹟鏡頭」，鏡頭下一切變成奇蹟。「開心扭蛋機」讓人以身上任何物品換取機會，眼見其他人都抽到好東西，大雄和多啦A夢欲罷不能。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。

如何在不接觸萬字夾的情況下，將玻璃瓶中的萬字夾拿出來？指南針為甚麼恆常指向南方？為什麼磁浮列車可以浮在軌道上？其實基本原理與我們常見的磁鐵有關。磁鐵分為南、北兩極，同極相拒，異極相吸，而磁浮列車則是利用電磁鐵的原理，令列車和路軌產生強大的、同極相斥的磁力，從而令列車浮在路軌上。然後，再改變電流的方向，以改變磁場的南北極方向，令磁浮列車前進或者後退。

果園任務需要擲取高處的水果，又要靈活避開障礙物。試過失敗的布甸隊明白到箇中難處，決定拉一拉筋再作挑戰。做好準備後，表現又會特別亮麗嗎？啫喱隊要採集三款共六件水果，策略是先收集完一款水果，才去考慮其他水果。目標明確，也要小心企穩；知道水果在何方的同時，亦要看清障礙物的位置！布甸隊接着要推地壺收集食材，過程中不斷調整力度，惟加碼挑戰啤梨時仍過於用力？改變軌道去撞擊前方的地壺來卸力，終於超額完成任務！
天氣轉冷，外面有小販車出售煨番薯。小丸子滿心歡喜拉爺爺外出購買，爺爺卻忘記帶銀包，令小丸子與煨番薯緣慳一面。小丸子對此事耿耿於懷，翌日上學也談起這件事，豬太郎則說那架小販車會在某處定時出現……

剪刀、搖搖板、手推車、開瓶器、手臂，有甚麼共通點？原來它們的設計都與槓桿原理有關。兩支筆該怎樣擺放，才能托起重物？只要明白支點、力點、重點、力臂、重臂各項的關係，便可輕易省力地負重。但掃帚、食物夾的設計，重臂比力臂長，並不省力，為何有這樣「愚蠢」的設計？小朋友遇上難題，問如何可單手把牙籤夾斷，只要掌握槓桿原理，問題一瞬間便能破解！

除塵紙為甚麼可以帶走塵埃？原來與靜電有莫大關係。物件互相摩擦就會產生靜電，產生電荷，相同電荷會互相吸引。除塵紙正是利用了摩擦起電的原理，抹物件時來回摩擦，除塵布的纖維間就會產生靜電，以感應作用帶走塵埃。另外，閃電的產生亦與靜電有關，一於用范德格拉夫起電機，模擬空氣中閃電的發生，背後的科學則由Master Joe詳細解釋。避雷針的設計總是尖尖的，為甚麼？有部份貨車尾部連接了一條接地線，又有甚麼作用？

除塵紙為甚麼可以帶走塵埃？原來與靜電有莫大關係。物件互相摩擦就會產生靜電，產生電荷，相同電荷會互相吸引。除塵紙正是利用了摩擦起電的原理，抹物件時來回摩擦，除塵布的纖維間就會產生靜電，以感應作用帶走塵埃。另外，閃電的產生亦與靜電有關，一於用范德格拉夫起電機，模擬空氣中閃電的發生，背後的科學則由Master Joe詳細解釋。避雷針的設計總是尖尖的，為甚麼？有部份貨車尾部連接了一條接地線，又有甚麼作用？
大雄因為怕凍而被胖虎他們取笑，多啦A夢為了替大雄出氣，拿出可令人冷熱感覺顛倒的法寶…小夫的表哥駕著超級跑車來炫耀，並邀請小夫的朋友們乘坐。但唯獨大雄，卻因為座位數目限制而被排擠在外…
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。
Nutty發施號令，「神奇地壺」任務再次啟動，啫喱隊要「收集」的是香蕉與啤梨。兩位隊員各有分工，分別拿下一款任務食材，並加碼挑戰距離更遠的水蜜桃……在「拼砌下午茶層架」遊戲的第一回合，布甸隊誤將橙當作是奇異果，多花了時間糾正。第二回合，圖示層架上的食材數量增加不少。兩隊均加快手腳，希望可率先完成任務，最終成績如何？

Nutty發施號令，「神奇地壺」任務再次啟動，啫喱隊要「收集」的是香蕉與啤梨。兩位隊員各有分工，分別拿下一款任務食材，並加碼挑戰距離更遠的水蜜桃……在「拼砌下午茶層架」遊戲的第一回合，布甸隊誤將橙當作是奇異果，多花了時間糾正。第二回合，圖示層架上的食材數量增加不少。兩隊均加快手腳，希望可率先完成任務，最終成績如何？
小丸子與小玉對花輪的家很有興趣，花輪便爽快邀請小丸子等人出席他的派對。花輪的大宅氣派非凡，令小丸子一行看得目瞪口呆。這天花輪的朋友也會到來，於是小丸子也為他準備了禮物，結果卻令小丸子出乎意料！

除塵紙為甚麼可以帶走塵埃？原來與靜電有莫大關係。物件互相摩擦就會產生靜電，產生電荷，相同電荷會互相吸引。除塵紙正是利用了摩擦起電的原理，抹物件時來回摩擦，除塵布的纖維間就會產生靜電，以感應作用帶走塵埃。另外，閃電的產生亦與靜電有關，一於用范德格拉夫起電機，模擬空氣中閃電的發生，背後的科學則由Master Joe詳細解釋。避雷針的設計總是尖尖的，為甚麼？有部份貨車尾部連接了一條接地線，又有甚麼作用？
今集邀得香港芭蕾舞團導師教大家芭蕾舞的知識，在「芭蕾天地」中，她帶領一班學員示範芭蕾舞的腳部及手部開位動作。另外，節目繼續送上《胡桃夾子》的精采片段。而在「芭蕾禮儀教室」中，導師講述前往觀賞芭蕾舞劇的禮儀。另外，攝影藝術家尹子聰會教導小朋友攝影技巧。在「向攝影出發」中，他講解不同鏡頭的運用及其效果；還帶領一班小朋友到鯉魚門進行戶外實地攝影，讓他們運用所學的技巧，拍出專屬個人的作品。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。
看過希娜和甜音的星光魔法後，檸檬表示信心盡失，決定解散雙人組合，凱龍聽罷情緒激動，宣稱要與檸檬拆夥，然後一走了之。喵姆等麻那麻那負責挽留凱龍，小祭與米露琪留下陪伴檸檬加以安慰。

無處不在的空氣，是一種由氮氣、氧氣和其他氣體混合而成的氣體，它看不見，摸不着，無色無味。怎樣才能看見空氣的存在？高偉雄及鄭家明老師分別以實驗證明空氣佔有空間與重量，與及空氣中含氧氣成份。既然空氣是一種真實存在的物質，當它壓在一個物件上，就會對該物件產生壓力，即是大氣壓力，但是為甚麼我們感覺不到呢？

香港有一個名為「格仔山」的地方，這集的「大世界 小知識」就考考大家相關問題。開始之前，Carmen姐姐還給予提示：格仔山與以前的啟德機場大有關係。第一條問題是關於格仔山的原名，有小朋友根據啟德機場的提示，從地理位置推斷是「九龍仔山」……格仔山的斜坡被畫上多個「格仔」，是甚麼顏色？又有何用途？

日常生活中許多物品都要靠能量才能運作，而能量會以不同形式出現，如：光能、熱能、聲能、電能、動能、位能等等。人類利用熱能來煮食，還利用電能使電器和機械運作而改善生活。那麼，有甚麼東西可以產生能量呢？鄭婉雯老師以紙風車、水車模型及汽球火箭，解釋風力及水力發電的科學細節，與及能量互相轉換的現象。
星期日，爸爸被噪音導致無法好好休息。因此，大雄想找個寧靜的地方給爸爸渡過這一天。霸道的胖虎總是獨佔自己想要的東西。剛巧多啦A夢有法寶可令物品變成幾份，大雄於是想到用此法寶來應對胖虎的獨佔欲。

小丸子看到飲食節目介紹蟹後，要求家裡吃蟹但遭拒絕，小丸子把心一橫，決定用自己的壓歲錢買蟹。小丸子經常忘記行程，得知城崎有用記事簿的習慣後，決定有樣學樣，央求媽媽買記事簿給她。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
日常生活中許多物品都要靠能量才能運作，而能量會以不同形式出現，如：光能、熱能、聲能、電能、動能、位能等等。人類利用熱能來煮食，還利用電能使電器和機械運作而改善生活。那麼，有甚麼東西可以產生能量呢？鄭婉雯老師以紙風車、水車模型及汽球火箭，解釋風力及水力發電的科學細節，與及能量互相轉換的現象。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers’ claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching gove

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 斷魂谷趙家莊主趙雲陽有兩弟子,趙玉龍和趙劍英。玉龍終年浪蕩江湖,却得雲陽所有財産。劍英不憤,害死師父嫁禍玉龍,幷引其子金虎追殺玉龍。兩人在斷魂穀决鬥,劍英欲收漁人之利,幸金虎和玉龍發現穀中有埋伏,詐傷引出主谋,連手反攻...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Jianying discovers the Zhao clans fortune will be left to his brother Yulong, he engineers his parents death and sends his own son out to kill Yulong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 美麗但無知的李天珍被外星人捉上飛碟,事後無人相信她曾與外星人接觸。於是,當她打算一死以示清白之際,卻遇上同有輕生念頭的失敗私家偵探伊電。二人互吐心聲後改變主意,卻遭遇一連串奇遇,而二人的愛情故事也因此開始。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 神刀大俠臨終時,把神刀傳給了徒弟林振嘯,而且更識破了另一徒弟方世雄為奪神刀而混入門下的奸計。方世雄為了神刀,令林家破人亡和雙目失明。最後,林振嘯與方世雄大戰為家人報仇,並誓要重奪神刀…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Li

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祝英台女扮男裝入學堂求學,並與同窗梁山伯結下至死不渝的深情厚愛。山伯得知英台真實身份後,立即前往祝家提親,豈料英台早已被許配他人,二人被迫含淚分離。山伯因悲痛過度,一病不起,最終含恨離世。英台驚聞噩耗,悲痛欲絕,哭祭山伯墳前,更縱身躍入墓中,以身殉情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo di

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海盜張保仔洗劫一艘外國商船後,發現海盜船身出現裂痕。於是他上岸尋找材料修船,竟發現清朝貪官正在欺壓貧苦農民。本性善良的張保仔,決心要鋤強扶弱,最終更成為著名的大海盜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he d

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 秦鳳笙、鳳簫兄妹才情敏捷,滿腹經綸,卻常受繼母夏氏刻薄。鳳簫自幼許與李如龍為妻,夏氏貪圖富貴,強逼如龍退婚;如龍不肯,夏氏再施毒計誣告如龍偷盜,將其收在獄中。鳳簫為救如龍,與侍婢春蘭喬扮男裝上京,更以如龍之名赴考,一舉中恩科狀元。明世宗見鳳簫長得一表非凡,乃命相國為媒,招為駙馬。洞房之夕,鳳簫向公主
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hsiaos stepmother frames her fiancé Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沙氏家族的賭術、千術已達出神入化的境界,在賭壇更是無人不知,無人不曉,而沙通更是青出于藍而勝于藍,在賭壇素有“賭王”之譽,甚少遇到對手。然而,沙通亦背負一段由賭而來的深仇,其師遭牌霸彭天石誣告販毒,被判刑十多年。沙通矢志為師報仇,欲以“老千千老千, 騙子騙騙子”的手段對付彭天石…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, its cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The doub

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片根據中國經典同名名著改編。故事講述唐僧赴西天取經,中途在五指山收服馬騮精;在高家莊收服豬八戒;在流沙河收服沙悟淨的種種情節。。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang’s journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片根據中國經典同名名著改編。故事講述唐僧赴西天取經,中途在五指山收服馬騮精;在高家莊收服豬八戒;在流沙河收服沙悟淨的種種情節。。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang’s journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由老木匠收養的石生,長大後發現自己擁有異於常人的超能力,原來他乃是太陽神之子,但每逢日蝕的時候,石生便會失去超能力。一天,惡魔出現並大肆殺戮和破壞,石生誓與惡魔決一死戰以拯救世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武則天有傾國之貌,絕世才華,十四歲時更被唐太宗召為才人,但太宗死後卻入寺為尼,卻又與繼位之唐高宗有染,生有二子。時皇后與蕭妃爭寵,命武則天回宮以制妃子,卻反陷害皇后。武則天獲封皇后之後,更誅殺兩太子。直到高宗病亡,武后臨朝,成為史上第一個女皇帝。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陸虎出獄後,發現自己原來是被陰險的弟弟陸彪所陷害,更奪去家族煤礦生意。妹妹欲阻止陸彪,反被他監禁起來。陸虎救出妹妹後,發現煤礦已被日本幫派所奪,他們誓要打敗日本人取回煤礦。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the ha

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陳詠薇的父母準備離異,於是把她送到章家暫住。章家長子凌霄、次子凌風、三女凌雲和年輕畫家余亞南都對詠薇很好,使她在章家農場度過了難忘的暑假。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang’s. On the Chang’s farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莊主杜天道其子被人斬去雙臂,性格變得暴戾。無故地先後打傷四人致殘。四人成殘缺一族,走投無路,入深山找師父授以武功,立志報仇…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son’s arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 軍閥割據時代,江湖人物及狡黠之徒所玩弄的傳統騙術層出不窮,「蛇神」、「李三腳」、「三隻手」等一群妖言惑眾的騙徒令人云亦云的愚民上釣,反映舊時代一切牛鬼蛇神眾生相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少女波波為尋父和找尋未婚夫羅烈,遇上童時玩伴黑豹,黑豹是城中勢力最大金二爺的助手。波波在黑豹照料下,逐漸忘記羅烈而愛上黑豹,黑豹自幼就喜歡波波,但是處處輸給羅烈,心狠手辣的他,逼婚不成,便在波波面前折磨金二爺,原來金二爺竟是波波的父親趙大爺,後來羅烈出獄…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事源自膾炙人口的《啼笑因緣》,內容描述民國初年,富家子范嘉恕戀上歌女岑逢仙,同時又唯賣藝少女官繡珠及貌似岑的財政廳長女兒賀莉霞所迷戀。張大帥垂涎岑,更姦污了她。嘉恕後得繡珠相助,才從大帥手中救回愛人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General’s henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 浪跡江湖的汪禹,因被揭以木刀偽裝刀槍不入,而被村民群起而追。汪脫身回客棧後,發覺師傅江洋已被捕;數警察亦要抓汪,但汪已逃到另一村鎮;汪為抱打不平,又在眾人前顯露神打功夫,乘天將下雨,自謂是東海龍王化身,跳入河中隱身而去,未幾,果然大雨如注,眾人真以為有神靈出現。後汪遇恍如男孩的少女林珍奇,引為知己,
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the first kung fu comedies, this is a story about a con artist who uses kung fu to swindle villagers for money by pretending to be possessed by spirits. When they are threatened by bandits, he must use the same skills for good.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漢朝末年太師董卓霸道專橫,弄權禍國,忠臣王允誓要利用貂蟬的美色設計除掉董卓。王允得知董卓的義子呂布見貂蟬貌若天仙一見鍾情,於是將計就計把貂蟬獻給董卓為妾,終使父子反目。呂布最後殺了父親董卓,自此與貂蟬成為眷屬。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn’s beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong’s concubine as he knows Dong’s adopted son Lu Bu is in love w

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部史詩式電影的故事背景發生在六國時代,聲名遠播的刺客聶政決定隱退江湖。但當客卿嚴遂一家被殺害後,嚴遂找來隱居的劍客聶政相助,並游說他一起參予終極的復仇行動。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yens family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張生、崔鶯鶯才子佳人相會,俏紅娘從中牽赤繩;西廂夜訪,私定終身;崔老夫人知情大怒,憤而拷紅;紅娘怨夫人不該言而無信,終成就百年姻緣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family’s objection, s

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年廣州西關的陳家大屋,家道中落只剩下陳秀英及其入贅之丈夫楊振宇。秀英多病,而振宇又鬱鬱不得志,故常遭振宇辱打。直至自稱陳家僕人之女梁綺華的出現,聯同秀英反抗,竟錯手將振宇殺死!秀英自始活在驚恐之中,最終被振宇的鬼魂嚇死!原來這只是振宇在與綺華合谋殺害秀英,就在振宇以為可與綺華共築愛巢之際,秀英
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青年醫生時振聲在醫院中發現很多奇難雜症,無法以醫學理論解釋,遂請好友齊中平夫婦共同研究。幾經追查,才發現那些病人均是中了降頭。原來施降者是精通邪術,以「愛情降頭」協助富商追求夢中情人,博取巨額報酬。中平不信妖邪之說,其妻子更不惜以身相試,更被施以「死降」,如果無法破解,二十四小時後便會身亡…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女俠風靈得悉六弦魔琴重現江湖,唯一能克制魔琴的只有火弦弓及火羽箭,唯袖手樵隱知其下落;風找得群雄一起找樵;期間,眾人發現逍遙隱士就是六指琴魔...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set ou

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張珍與金寵之女牡丹早有婚約,金寵卻欲退婚。張珍偶遇化身金牡丹樣子的鯉魚精,兩人漸生情愫。一天,金寵請包公來公斷兩個真假牡丹,包公為成全二人,推辭此案…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhang and Jin’s daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he d

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四大家族之一的金虎堡堡主在一次押鏢途中,被四名幪面和尚劫殺。葉青花被懷疑與案有關,遊俠雷迅助友洗脫嫌疑,竟捲入奇案,三闖少林。雷迅找出四名和尚,當眾伏法,以為真相大白;豈料,不久武林又傳出四名和尚到處行兇,雷迅才知道被人利用,引發連場打鬥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served f

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凌玫瑰與方素美是一對感情要好的同窗。凌幼失怙恃,由當舞女之姊撫養成長,方則出身富家,受母呵護備至。畢業後,凌由淪落風塵攀至選美冠軍,方則滿足於平淡生活中;但她們卻偏偏同時愛上劉醫生。最後一件意想不到的事發生,改寫了他們三人的一生…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang’s fiancé and

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武松殺死潘金蓮及西門慶後,被判發配孟州牢營。武松元照例要接受一百下殺威棒,但得施恩求情,僥倖獲得豁免。武松為報答施恩,當知道她的「快活林」酒家被「蔣門神」蔣忠奪去,誓要不惜一切助她取回酒家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華南影帝張瑛與梁天合作的清末喜劇,二人分飾師爺荒唐鏡及奇人陳夢吉。陳得知荒平素極盡斂財害人之能事,遂喬扮應徵僕人...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of Robin Hood meets The Sting. Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (whos done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, its the age-old competition between a rookie c

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嚴太師遇刺斃命,護衛范義追擊刺客至窮巷,見他踏鏢逾牆逸去,而鏢乃寇英之器,范遂遍城貼滿通緝寇的畫像。寇取得遇害縣官宋化龍身上的公文,得以入城,卻仍為范捉拿,幸得酒店店主的女兒雪娘,自認寇是其表哥,寇才倖免被捕;寇向雪道出自己的身份及真相。其後,范遭假扮成寇的寨主賀西雷襲擊,而救回他的竟是……

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 施惠國的每個地區在一年一度的飢餓遊戲比賽都必須送出一男一女決一死戰。珍妮花羅倫絲飾演16歲的凱妮絲艾弗丁,她自願代替妹妹參加比賽。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every district in the nation of Panem must send a boy and girl to fight to the death in the annual Hunger Games competition. Jennifer Lawrence is 16-year-old Katniss Everdeen, who volunteers to take her younger sister’s place in the games.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹是一名掙扎求生的牧場主,他自願押送被捕的盜賊首領班・韋德前往火車站,準備搭乘開往猶馬的 3:10列車接受審判。然而,班那群冷血無情的同夥卻早已盤算好其他計劃。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dan is a struggling rancher who volunteers to safely deliver Ben Wade, the captured leader of a gang of thieves, to a train station where the 3:10 to Yuma will transport him to trial. Ben’s gang of cutthroats and robbers has other plans.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部電影取材自二戰真實事件,講述了一支美國潛艦小隊奉命捕捉一艘載有恩尼格瑪密碼機的德國U型潛艇的故事。一場充滿緊張、欺騙與生存挑戰的水下動作驚悚之戰即將展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Inspired by real WWII events, this film follows an American submarine crew tasked with capturing a German U-boat carrying the Enigma code machine. A tense, underwater action thriller full of deception, danger, and survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戰後的日本,哥吉拉的出現為滿目瘡痍的國土帶來了新的浩劫。當軍方無力介入、政府束手無策之際,倖存者們必須在絕望中團結起來,迎戰這股無情的恐怖力量。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:自由幻夢 Ⅰ
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球轟動的系列持續延燒。凱妮絲(珍妮佛·勞倫斯 飾)在摧毀飢餓遊戲後倖存下來,並與第13區聯手,挺身對抗殘暴的史諾總統(唐納·蘇德蘭 飾)。革命的火焰已被點燃,帕納姆的命運正面臨最關鍵的一戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The worldwide phenomenon continues. Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) has survived and destroyed the Hunger Games, and now rises with District 13 to fight against President Snow (Donald Sutherland).

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu Reeves stars in 47 Ronin, an epic fantasy where an outcast joins samurai on a quest for vengeance and honor against a ruthless overlord in ancient Japan.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Matt Damon returns as Jason Bourne in Jason Bourne, with director Paul Greengrass back for another thrilling chapter. Bourne is drawn out of hiding, facing new dangers with Alicia Vikander, Vincent Cassel, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《超世紀戰警》中,馮·迪索回歸飾演雷迪克,此時的他是一名被流放到殘酷監獄的逃犯。在凱拉的陪伴下,他必須逃離這裡並擊敗死亡兵團,以拯救銀河系。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *The Chronicles of Riddick*, Vin Diesel returns as Riddick, now a fugitive exiled to a brutal prison. With Kyra by his side, he must escape and defeat the Necromongers to save the galaxy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《星際傳奇》中,馮・迪索飾演危險罪犯雷迪克,與一群倖存者受困於荒漠星球。面對嗜血怪物與灼熱雙日,他們必須彼此信任,才能撐過致命黑夜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *Pitch Black*, Vin Diesel stars as Riddick, a dangerous convict stranded on a desert planet with survivors. Facing carnivorous monsters and scorching suns, they must trust each other to survive the deadly night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爭取脫離英國統治、追求獨立的民眾,遭到軍隊鎮壓,引發一場血腥暴動,而政府隨後加以掩蓋。超過一百名馬爾他人被誣陷為暴力事件的煽動者,遭到不公正的監禁。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Citizens fighting for independence from Britain were met by an Army-quelled bloody riot that the government covered up. Over 100 Maltese were falsely jailed for instigating the violence.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 派屈克・貝特曼是一名在華爾街、於父親公司任職的年輕人,卻毫無理由地殺人。隨著日子一天天過去,他對世界的仇恨愈發強烈。這部極度黑暗的黑色喜劇改編自布雷特・伊斯頓・艾利斯的同名小說。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A brilliant but controversial research scientist becomes obsessed with his quest to create a humanistic machine, leading to a dangerous conclusion.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *12 Monkeys*, Bruce Willis plays a time-traveling convict trying to prevent a deadly virus, while Brad Pitt shines as a manic asylum inmate. Directed by Terry Gilliam, its a mind-bending sci-fi thriller.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名少林武者對抗販賣奴隸的惡勢力,誓要阻止同胞被賣往美洲金礦淪為苦役。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Shaolin warrior battles slave traders to stop his countrymen from being sold into bondage in the gold mines in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 2084年,建築工人道格拉斯·奎德前往雷卡爾星球,進行一次虛擬的火星之旅——但這趟旅程卻意外喚醒被封存的記憶,將他捲入一場致命叛亂與特工身份的過去。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2084, construction worker Douglas Quaid visits Rekall for a virtual Mars vacation—but the procedure unlocks hidden memories, thrusting him into a deadly rebellion and a secret-agent past.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hobbs and Shaw team up to stop a superhuman villain with a deadly bio-weapon in this explosive Fast  Furious spin-off starring Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham, Idris Elba, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the Seven Deadly Sins to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武術宗師梁坤為保護心愛的女人毅然退隱江湖,不料他的隱忍卻換來了愛人的慘死。意識到宿命避無可避,他重返武林,在丐幫幫主蘇燦的鼎力相助下,梁坤殺出一條血路,誓要向那些冷血仇敵討回血債。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

epg.programme_title_tc: 混世四猴: 神猴歸來
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 救世主靈明石猴曾賜予絕望女孩生存的希望,並許下守護終生的承諾。不料多年後,他與傲慢的三眼戰神展開一場毀天滅地的大戰,最終慘遭擊敗,金身碎裂墮入凡塵。失去神力的石猴,究竟能否重燃鬥志,打破命運枷鎖,再度..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緝毒隊成員泰樺、老米、阿峰和阿棠共同參與抓捕毒梟的行動。然而,因黑警洩密,阿峰遇難,上司犧牲,阿棠也隨之消失。為了揭開真相,泰樺與老米在剿滅毒梟的過程中,必須在忠誠與背叛之間掙扎。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Narcotics squad members—Tai Hua, Lao Mi, Ah Feng, and Ah Tang—are involved in arresting a drug lord. However, a betrayal within the police leads to the deaths of Ah Feng and his superior, while Ah Tang vanishes. As Tai Hua and Lao Mi uncover the truth, they find themselves torn between loyalty and betrayal in their fight against the drug cartel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前特警隊長東谷在任務中罹患永久性失明,之後更被脅迫要承擔任務失敗的責任。幸好東谷在女兒的陪伴下逐漸走出陰霾,並開始適應黑暗的世界。可是曾經的宿敵再度出現,令女兒陷入危險之中。東谷為救女兒,展開了一場生..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..

It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在萊咖國政權交替之際,黑幫頭目宋邦企圖藉此洗白身份,欲坐上市長寶座。為了籌措龐大資金,他與官員勾結行賄,卻仍面臨嚴重的資金缺口。於是,宋邦的得力助手鄭吒和打手蘇萬殺人越貨、橫行作惡,逐步幫助他鞏固權力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika’s mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Ball是個韓國體育運動真人秀。節目邀請了韓國Iron Squad的特種部隊迎接一項新挑戰 — 閃避球。26名隊員將展開激烈角逐,直至選出一隊具超凡運動體能和最強心理素質的隊伍。在明星運動員..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sports entertainment show brings the best special forces from Iron Squad to take on a new challenge – dodgeball. The 26 players will enter a fierce competition, until a strongest team armed with powerful athletic endurance and mental strength is formed. Witness how they compete in front of the star athletes and legendary dodgeball coaches!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陳真在日本流學時,發現多名中國學生失蹤,意外揭發黑龍會的陰謀。原來,黑龍會研發新藥以增強日本軍在戰爭中的體能,並捉拿中國學生做實驗。於是,陳真誓要瓦解黑龍會,並將其實驗密室搗毀。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society’s conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 赤練君在押解過程中逃脫,張道長亦因此被逐出師門。為追查赤煉君的下落,張道長來到一個地方,發現有很多平民無故失蹤。當張道長查出赤練君為練成蛇魔而抓走平民後,一場人魔大戰旋即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang’s custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩名來自截然不同世界的加拿大年輕男子,各自被困於無法掌控的命運之中。當命運將他們推上地下赤手拳擊場,那場對決將點燃一段充滿復仇、報應與自我救贖的血腥旅程。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two young Canadians from starkly different worlds are each trapped in a life beyond his control. When they are pulled into the unforgiving underground bare knuckle fight circuit, their collision sparks a brutal journey of vengeance, retribution and self discovery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 千年前,青蛇在道清的點化下逐漸開化,生出與道清相守之心。因自己對道清的執念,卻導致道清進入輪迴之劫,遭受世間橫死之難。為了化解道清的劫難,數百年間,青蛇不斷尋找轉世的道清…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Embark on the journey with two Thai artistes, Gun and Ticha, as they navigate the bustling city life and discover the serene outskirts of Hong Kong.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Only Live Once spends some time with two superstars of BMX. Daniel Dhers and Alex Colbourn talk about what it's like being a professional rider in the FISE World Series.
