epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #2
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與初賽的優勝者和一些強悍的新挑戰者一起投入這場瘋狂的衝刺,迎接他們的在七月洄游的鮭魚!跟隨大男孩踏上尋找美食之旅,並歡迎紅背兒參加盛宴;再看看新手媽媽能否保護她僅存的小熊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the frantic dash to cash in on Julys salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡迎小猩猩托潘,她是一個需要代孕媽媽照顧的孤兒.當她還在幼兒園學習之時,她的同學們已經進入了初中,高中和野外實習學校.與此同時,16歲的卡斯帕正在為畢業做著準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome baby orangutan Topan, an orphan in need of a surrogate mom. Watch her learning journey in nursery school while her fellow students move through junior, senior, and wild-immersion schools. Meanwhile, 16-year-old Kasper preps for graduation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 觀察幼兒園裡蓬勃發展的友誼和物種間的聯繫,窺探初中生瓦伦蒂诺,尤特里斯和马达拉之間的兄弟情誼.我們看到心不在焉的貝尼沉浸在對食物的熱愛中,還遭到了高年級學生的毆打.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe blossoming friendships and interspecies bonds in nursery school, and peek inside a bromance among junior-school buds Valentino, Yutris and Madara. See distractible Beni lean into his love of food and get a beating from a more-senior pupil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的野生海岸綿延170英里.印度和大西洋的海流匯合於此,逼使大浪湧向海岸線.這裡也是駐莫桑比克的鬼蝠魟研究員安德里亞馬歇爾希望在南非境內進行首次鬼蝠魟探索的地方.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A blind woman has found a new lease on life thanks to her canine running mate, a Jack Russell works as a super-nanny to a surprising array of species, and a team of dogs in Kenya are on daily patrol protecting endangered rhinos from poachers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從內部乾燥的平原上可以看到澳洲最知名的影像,紅色巨石烏盧魯,慵懶地跳躍的紅色袋鼠; 澳洲的干旱中心地帶是巨大又具標誌性的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the vast, dry plains of the interior come some of Australias most recognized imagery, such as the monolithic red rock of Uluru and the bounding red kangaroo. But how did the arid center of the continent come to be?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當街頭部族發現深山部族侵入他們的領地後,爭戰一觸即發.目擊馬特諾爾糟糕的育兒技巧,並見證具領袖野心的阿吉特如何展開行動.熱浪來襲,迫使大家在森林中共享資源,緩和衝突氣氛.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 處理爭鬥的小鴨圍捕,看看獸醫卡琳娜 (Karina) 是否會請專家來治療考拉斯派克 (Spike) 的腿部骨折.深入了解困擾針鼴寶寶乒 (Ping) 和乓 (Pong) 的胃病問題,並遇到了似乎迷路了的考拉賈拉 (Jarrah).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deal with duelling duckling roundups and find out if vet Karina calls in specialists to treat koala Spikes leg fracture. Get to the bottom of stomach issues plaguing baby echidnas Ping and Pong, and meet koala Jarrah, who seems to have lost his way.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: With real-life dueling dragons, giant sumo-wrestling beetles, street-fighting monkeys, and sea turtles that play king of the hill – on top of another sea turtle, Southeast Asia boasts a wide range of wildlife warriors.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #3
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 挑戰者一一提起精神,因為十月的寒流使局面變得更加複雜.看看大男孩在絆倒後如何重新振作,然後見證悲劇降臨四子之母.為粉絲最愛的新手媽媽和她的黏人的小孩加油.挑戰來到尾聲,誰會成為最終的皇者?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況.佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了.了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟水獺奧茲以及他的教練萊絲莉一起學習游泳,接著看看佩特羅內爾如何贏得犀牛孤兒莉莉的信任,牠曾因偷獵者而受到創傷.和老鼠科比一起嗅出地雷,並和雙髻鯊蓋婭一起自由潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狗隻在本集利用其出色的嗅覺進行拯救生命和積極地保護環境治安的工作.在加拿大,一隊偵緝犬正在嗅探破壞性的入侵物種斑馬貽貝,這些貽貝對北美的湖泊和河流造成嚴重破壞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Labrador cross and its partner help prevent ecological disaster in Canada, a Lagotto Romagnolo unearths a rare delicacy in Washington forests, and a Belgian malinois team tracks down the critically endangered geometric tortoise to save the species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大狄維亭山脈被巨大的力量所打造,從大陸的中心地帶以一條細長的綠色絲帶分開.從塔斯曼尼亞的冰冷山峰經過1800英里,到達古老的戴恩樹雨林,無數的物種以大狄維亭山脈為家,全都適應地生存,並茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Created by titanic forces and spanning 3,700 km along the eastern edge of Australia, the Great Dividing Range separates two very different worlds. Aerial footage and intimate studies reveal how species survive and thrive in this mountain home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡迎小猩猩托潘,她是一個需要代孕媽媽照顧的孤兒.當她還在幼兒園學習之時,她的同學們已經進入了初中,高中和野外實習學校.與此同時,16歲的卡斯帕正在為畢業做著準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome baby orangutan Topan, an orphan in need of a surrogate mom. Watch her learning journey in nursery school while her fellow students move through junior, senior, and wild-immersion schools. Meanwhile, 16-year-old Kasper preps for graduation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 觀察幼兒園裡蓬勃發展的友誼和物種間的聯繫,窺探初中生瓦伦蒂诺,尤特里斯和马达拉之間的兄弟情誼.我們看到心不在焉的貝尼沉浸在對食物的熱愛中,還遭到了高年級學生的毆打.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe blossoming friendships and interspecies bonds in nursery school, and peek inside a bromance among junior-school buds Valentino, Yutris and Madara. See distractible Beni lean into his love of food and get a beating from a more-senior pupil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與大量被遺棄的考拉幼崽打交道,隨後與獸醫護士尼克 (Nick) 一起尋找治療小袋鼠腸道疾病的天然藥物.思考如何解救被困在樹上的蝙蝠寶寶,並觀看獸醫卡琳娜為一隻翅膀骨折的倉鸮進行手術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Contend with a flood of abandoned koala joeys, then join vet nurse Nick on a hunt for natural remedies to treat a wallabys gut ailment. Ponder options for a baby bat stuck in a tree and look on as vet Karina operates on a barn owls fractured wing.

epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 挑戰者一一提起精神,因為十月的寒流使局面變得更加複雜.看看大男孩在絆倒後如何重新振作,然後見證悲劇降臨四子之母.為粉絲最愛的新手媽媽和她的黏人的小孩加油.挑戰來到尾聲,誰會成為最終的皇者?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 美國地大物博充滿奇觀.大角羊在山頂躁動.棕熊在戰鬥,奮不顧身為冬天囤脂.尖尾松雞在舞池中搖擺尾羽.野生種馬優美地踏步.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The USA is big on flash and spectacle. Bighorn rams rattle the mountaintops. Brown bears battle, desperate to fatten up for winter. Sharp-tailed grouse shake their tail-feathers on the dance floor. Wild stallions rumble with beauty and grace.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洪都拉斯海岸島嶼是熱門的度假勝地,但吸引遊客的不止是它的陽光與海灘.它實際上是一個潛水者天堂,島的各個角落都散落著沉船.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But its not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. Its actually a divers paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過馬修・麥康納的旁述,跟隨鯰魚,虎貓等當地生物的視角,展開一場奇妙之旅.讓我們一同讚頌德克薩斯州的地景風貌和野生動物,並深入了解保育工作對拯救德克薩斯州獨特棲息地的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star States landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當家庭分崩離析,一隻幼獅必須活下來; 兩隻青少年豹崽在被遺棄後必須自生自滅,一隻年輕的成年黑羚必須冒上生命和肢體的危險,因牠試圖保證第一次交配.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young lion cub must survive as his family is torn apart; two adolescent leopard cubs must fend for themselves after they are abandoned, and a young adult blackbuck must risk life and limb as he tries to secure his first mating.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華贊是一頭強大的雄性領袖,坐擁一個異常龐大的部隊.他在維持這個大集團方面做得很好,但未來的路並不明朗.還有更多的同伴需要糊口,但牠的叢林正在萎縮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rajan is the powerful alpha male who sits at the head of an unusually large troop. He has done well to sustain such a big group, but the future doesnt look so bright. There are more mouths to feed, and yet his jungle home is shrinking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豪華的廟宇花園坐落在古城焦特布爾的邊緣位置,是一大群長尾葉猴的家,牠們享受著寧靜的生活,卻有嚴格的等級制度.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nestled on the edge of the ancient city of Jodhpur, the luxurious Temple Gardens are home to a huge troop of Hanuman Langurs, who enjoy a peaceful life of bounty. But the troop has a strict hierarchy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在印度南部炎熱又潮濕的熱帶森林中,一位雌性眼鏡王蛇正在執行任務:在季候風到來前,她需要找到伴侶,食物並順利下蛋.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the hot forest of Southern India, a female King Cobra is on a mission: to find a mate, find food, and lay eggs before the monsoon arrives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在印度南部的森林中,夏季無情的酷熱給亞洲大象帶來了挑戰,他們每天都需要喝水.當水開始在周圍消失時,聰明的女族長安露娜決定帶領她的家人遷移到遙遠的水源.她能否成功為3個月大的孫子找到新水源?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In southern India, the summer is a challenge for Asian elephants who must drink every day. As things dry up, Anura, the matriarch, leads her herd to a distant watering hole. But will she succeed in getting her 3-month-old grandson there in time?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狗隻在本集正以各種令人驚訝的方式來幫助我們.一隻大丹犬向我們展示如何改變一名13歲的馬薩諸塞州女孩的生活,她只剩有限的生命.一隻隸屬搜索和救援隊的邊境牧羊犬曾經在動物收容所等死,但現在是加州特遣部隊不可或缺的一員,當地震,颶風或致命的泥石流襲擊時負責尋找倖存者.尚比亞的反偷獵犬路格正在檢查走私...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dogs around the world come to the rescue in surprising ways. Some search for survivors when disaster strikes or rescue animals from poachers and wildlife traffickers. Others help us in times of trouble-both on land and in the water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狗隻正在世界各地拯救生命.在南非機場,趕鳥的邊境牧羊犬正在防止鳥類與飛機發生潛在的破壞性碰撞.在英國鄉村,西班牙獵犬的非凡嗅覺和安那托利亞牧羊犬的天然保護本能在保護瀕危物種方面發揮著至關重要的救命作用.在美國亞特蘭大,一隻受虐的小狗被遺棄在街頭,但被動物服務公司救出後,牠幫助拯救了整個努力應對...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a border collie that protects aircraft from lethal bird strikes, a sprocker spaniel whose sense of smell is saving imperilled water voles, and an Anatolian shepherd that helps conserve Africas most endangered big cat, the cheetah.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集集中在狗隻與其(大部份)人類拍檔間的卓越合作關係.2018年,一隻德國牧羊種的搜救犬與加州特遣隊和她的洛杉磯消防員拍檔被部署在蒙特西托尋找破壞性泥石流意外的倖存者.在英國,土地調查犬類拍檔- 西班牙獵犬與牠們的人類拍檔,使用牠們的鼻子進行地下水洩漏搜索.最後,同樣在英國,與一隻學會閱讀的聰...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a golden retriever that assuages anxiety and helps heal PTSD, a shepherd mix who rescues mudslide survivors, a pair of spaniels who sniff out underground water leaks, and a group of teachers pets in the UK that assist children learning to read.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的野生海岸綿延170英里.印度和大西洋的海流匯合於此,逼使大浪湧向海岸線.這裡也是駐莫桑比克的鬼蝠魟研究員安德里亞馬歇爾希望在南非境內進行首次鬼蝠魟探索的地方.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A blind woman has found a new lease on life thanks to her canine running mate, a Jack Russell works as a super-nanny to a surprising array of species, and a team of dogs in Kenya are on daily patrol protecting endangered rhinos from poachers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狗隻在本集利用其出色的嗅覺進行拯救生命和積極地保護環境治安的工作.在加拿大,一隊偵緝犬正在嗅探破壞性的入侵物種斑馬貽貝,這些貽貝對北美的湖泊和河流造成嚴重破壞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Labrador cross and its partner help prevent ecological disaster in Canada, a Lagotto Romagnolo unearths a rare delicacy in Washington forests, and a Belgian malinois team tracks down the critically endangered geometric tortoise to save the species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速.觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊,與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺,與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物,並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​體驗超越人類能力的動物技能.看看鹹水鱷魚如何利用其壓力敏感的圓頂檢測最微小的動作,發現鴿子的內部GPS系統,並利用第七感與海豚一起檢測獵物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeons internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與自然界中最狡猾和堅韌的戰士一起部署生化武器.釋放科莫多龍的毒咬,與獴群一起抵抗有毒的敵人,並觀察鳥類如何使用骨骼粉碎的力量來反擊有毒攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deploy biochemical weaponry with natures most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是自然界中最具戲劇性的事件之一. 捕食者殺戮獵物時,血肉橫飛,塵土飛揚,爪子和牙齒都染紅.不過大自然的殺戮機器是如何實現這種史詩式的速度,狡猾和敏捷?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從高地到阿爾卑斯山,歐洲令人回味的景致成為了野生動物劇的史詩式背景.通常,堅忍的歐洲馬鹿在發情期會變得狂野,狼群發生領土衝突,狐狸踏著狐步- 這並非聽起來般美好.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Highlands to the Alps, Europes evocative landscapes are the backdrop for epic wildlife drama. Normally stoic red deer go wild during the rut. Wolf packs clash over territory, and foxes do the foxtrot - its not as nice as it sounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從機會主義的海盜船到裝備精良的海軍艦艇,墨西哥的尤卡坦半島沉浸在海事的歷史中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From opportunistic pirate ships, to well-armed navy vessels, Mexicos Yucatan Peninsula is steeped in maritime history.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們將帶領您環繞著赤道,深入探索居住在熱帶森林中的多樣物種,您將有機會遇見一隻獨自打造迷你森林的樹懶,與共享互助的狐猴,以及細心照料林地花園的象群,隨後,我們將一同揭開熱帶森林的神秘面紗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Circle the equator for a look at the diverse species that dwell in tropical forests. Meet a lone sloth growing a mini-forest, lemurs that share and share alike, and elephants that tend to their woodland gardens. Then explore the regions dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與我們一同欣賞四季更迭,並深入了解樹木和動物如何相互依賴共生.在夜幕低垂之際,欣賞在春天夜晚翩翩起舞的螢火蟲,探索協助樹木降溫的夏季菌菇,並在秋葉紛飛之際為秋季的來臨做好準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the seasons wax and wane and learn how trees and animals help one another survive. Witness spring fireflies dancing after dark, discover summer fungi that cool off overheated trees, and prep for autumn migrations as the leaves begin to fall.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與我們一同踏入樹林與水源共同孕育新生命的溼地,再潛入保護年幼海狗的水下森林,拜訪一群藏身在紅樹林保護區的好奇水下古怪生物,同時你還有機會一窺真實存在的沼澤怪物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wade into wetlands, where trees and water meet to nurture new life. Dive into an underwater forest that protects young fur seals, visit a mangrove sanctuary where a curious band of aquatic misfits hides out, and meet some real-life swamp monsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上的森林如何連結和滋養著無數物種的生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Climb into a realm of thin air and towering rock. Tag along as mythical monkeys battle for a winter food stash, sing along with lemurs in a fruit-filled tree canopy, and watch an aromatic tree bring together blossom and possum in a moonlit tryst.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上的森林如何連結和滋養著無數物種的生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to the Arctic for a peek at the brutal challenges of life in the boreal forest, then admire some stellar animal adaptations. Witness a secret reindeer superpower, navigate a rodent labyrinth of snow, and learn why moose are gourmets at heart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上的森林如何連結和滋養著無數物種的生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how plants and animals tough it out in some of the driest terrain Earth has to offer. Run across thirsty trees that act as elephant signposts, see insects team up with plants for a chance at life, and get insight into natural chemical warfare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬堤侯連拿博士和海洋哺乳類救援隊趕著拯救被塑料套索困住的一大群海獅;一頭小水獺孤兒被一個新家庭收養.另外,在溫哥華水族館裡,一隻企鵝因一種神秘疾病而病倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the vet and his team in saving a massive sea lion caught in a plastic noose, and then visit the Rescue Center, where a harbor seal pup may lose its eyesight and a baby sea otter needs a risky but life-saving surgery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 救援隊嘗試救活一頭情況危急的海獺.馬堤博士在海上對抗惡劣的環境,以幫助被纏住的海獅.而在救援中心內,一隻頑皮的小海豹將自己置於險地,一隻瞎眼的鴨子重拾光明.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Battle wind and waves to find a sea lion trapped in a plastic ring. Then visit the rescue center, where over 80 orphan seals must be fed several times a day to prepare for release into the wild, and see an Amazonian duck get a miraculous operation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋哺乳類救援隊幫助迷路的海龜回家.一頭巨大的海獅被發現被十字弓擊中,需要吊車才能將牠帶到救援中心.馬堤博士幫助一隻果蝠應付晚年,還有幫助一隻好鬥的獨眼海豹游向自由.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從內部乾燥的平原上可以看到澳洲最知名的影像,紅色巨石烏盧魯,慵懶地跳躍的紅色袋鼠; 澳洲的干旱中心地帶是巨大又具標誌性的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the vast, dry plains of the interior come some of Australias most recognized imagery, such as the monolithic red rock of Uluru and the bounding red kangaroo. But how did the arid center of the continent come to be?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大狄維亭山脈被巨大的力量所打造,從大陸的中心地帶以一條細長的綠色絲帶分開.從塔斯曼尼亞的冰冷山峰經過1800英里,到達古老的戴恩樹雨林,無數的物種以大狄維亭山脈為家,全都適應地生存,並茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Created by titanic forces and spanning 3,700 km along the eastern edge of Australia, the Great Dividing Range separates two very different worlds. Aerial footage and intimate studies reveal how species survive and thrive in this mountain home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 旅程的最後一站,來到澳洲內陸沙漠與印度洋交匯處,探索一片炙熱的未知之境.跟隨莉茲深入海床,見證虎鯊,魔鬼魚和海龜如何應對生存威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Complete the trips final lap in the untamed lands where Australias interior desert meets the hot, hostile Indian Ocean. Confront the challenges of survival in this region as Lizzie dives with tiger sharks, manta rays, and nomadic turtles.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在繁殖季節中與米克和阿黛爾一起糾纏不清,他們救了一隻被饑餓的蟒蛇威脅的傑克羅素犬.與米克一起在泳池中對抗一條致命的紅腹黑蛇,並與斯圖和莉芙一起在建築工地上處理東部棕蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​準備好進行一場火熱的救援,當丹和傑絲從後院移除交配中的東部棕蛇時,然後屏住呼吸,因為米克在沙發墊裡嗅出了一條高度有毒的蛇.稍後,觀看斯圖拆解一個雞舍以撬出一條地毯蟒蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​前往一個度假村,斯圖和莉芙試圖在度假者面前捕捉一條懷孕的紅腹黑蛇.觀看米克和阿黛爾抓住一條正在追逐雞肉晚餐的花紋監視蜥蜴,然後與傑絲和丹一起捕捉一個滑溜的車庫入侵者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. Watch Mick and Adele nab a lace monitor lizard thats chasing a chicken dinner, then catch a slippery garage intruder with Jess and Dan.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與斯圖和莉芙一起變得一團糟,他們試圖智勝一條大型藍舌蜥蜴.與傑絲和丹一起賽跑,試圖在一條懷孕的蛇變成多條之前救出它,並看看米克和阿黛爾如何將一條蟒蛇遠離兩隻玩耍的小狗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. Race the clock with Jess and Dan as they try to rescue a pregnant snake before one serpent turns into many, and see Mick and Adele keep a python away from two playful puppies.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與阿黛爾和米克展開意志的較量,他們試圖將一條蟒蛇引出排水管.靜候傑絲和丹試圖在一條鰭背蛇放出臭彈之前抓住它,然後與斯圖一起面對隱藏在大學牆壁中的危險蛇類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Engage in a battle of wills with Adele and Mick as they try to coax a python out of a drainpipe. Stand by as Jess and Dan try to grab a keelback snake before it drops a stink bomb, then face a dangerous serpent hidden in a university wall with Stu.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​放鬆一下,觀看米克和阿黛爾在一個養老院中打斷一對交配的東部棕蛇.與斯圖和莉芙一起處理不需要的庫存,他們在倉庫中捕捉到一條綠樹蛇,然後與傑絲和丹一起悄悄接近一位兇險的訪客.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kick back as Mick and Adele break up a pair of mating eastern brown snakes at a retirement home. Take care of unwanted inventory with Stu and Liv, who capture a green tree snake in a warehouse, then sneak up on a killer visitor with Jess and Dan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一旦天氣變冷變黑,昆蟲開始從草地和田地消失,牠們會慢慢消失直至全滅.所有動物都有其特殊的生存方式,像燕子和鶴這種候鳥會飛向南方,許多像鹿一樣的哺乳動物會得到厚厚的冬季皮毛或躲在溫暖的地方冬眠.但昆蟲都做了甚麼?為何牠們在春天就會回歸?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As soon as the days get cold and dark insects begin to disappear from the meadows and fields. Their sum and hum slowly fades away and will finally be gone. All animals have their special ways to survive winter. Migrating birds like swallows and cr...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太恐怖了!這是謀殺!殘酷的死亡以及刺激的戰鬥,還有特殊的絕地救援.你在看到它之後就會知道最令人毛骨悚然的地方其實就是你附近的草叢.利用來自恐怖類型的型格設備,這部非凡的自然紀錄片將帶您跟隨一位著名英雄,牠有六條腿,紅色的翅膀和七個黑點,這趟旅程的目的地是一個看似正常但充滿怪物的草叢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is horror! It is murder! Brutal death as well as exciting fights with an exceptional last-minute rescue. And after seeing it – you will know the creepiest spot is actually the meadow in your neighborhood. With stylistic devices from the horror ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 甲蟲已經在地球上居住了超過2.4億年.科學家們已知的甲蟲大約有38萬種,而每年都會發現數百種新品種.世上四分之一的動物是甲蟲.牠們幾乎征服了地球上每個角落和棲息地,在每次全球災難中都能倖存下來.牠們為何如此成功?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Beetles have inhabited the Earth for more than 240 million years. There are around 380,000 kinds of beetles known to scientists and every year hundreds of new species are discovered. One fourth of the worlds animals are beetles. They have conquer...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 旅程的最後一站,來到澳洲內陸沙漠與印度洋交匯處,探索一片炙熱的未知之境.跟隨莉茲深入海床,見證虎鯊,魔鬼魚和海龜如何應對生存威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Complete the trips final lap in the untamed lands where Australias interior desert meets the hot, hostile Indian Ocean. Confront the challenges of survival in this region as Lizzie dives with tiger sharks, manta rays, and nomadic turtles.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在繁殖季節中與米克和阿黛爾一起糾纏不清,他們救了一隻被饑餓的蟒蛇威脅的傑克羅素犬.與米克一起在泳池中對抗一條致命的紅腹黑蛇,並與斯圖和莉芙一起在建築工地上處理東部棕蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​準備好進行一場火熱的救援,當丹和傑絲從後院移除交配中的東部棕蛇時,然後屏住呼吸,因為米克在沙發墊裡嗅出了一條高度有毒的蛇.稍後,觀看斯圖拆解一個雞舍以撬出一條地毯蟒蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​前往一個度假村,斯圖和莉芙試圖在度假者面前捕捉一條懷孕的紅腹黑蛇.觀看米克和阿黛爾抓住一條正在追逐雞肉晚餐的花紋監視蜥蜴,然後與傑絲和丹一起捕捉一個滑溜的車庫入侵者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. Watch Mick and Adele nab a lace monitor lizard thats chasing a chicken dinner, then catch a slippery garage intruder with Jess and Dan.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與斯圖和莉芙一起變得一團糟,他們試圖智勝一條大型藍舌蜥蜴.與傑絲和丹一起賽跑,試圖在一條懷孕的蛇變成多條之前救出它,並看看米克和阿黛爾如何將一條蟒蛇遠離兩隻玩耍的小狗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. Race the clock with Jess and Dan as they try to rescue a pregnant snake before one serpent turns into many, and see Mick and Adele keep a python away from two playful puppies.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與阿黛爾和米克展開意志的較量,他們試圖將一條蟒蛇引出排水管.靜候傑絲和丹試圖在一條鰭背蛇放出臭彈之前抓住它,然後與斯圖一起面對隱藏在大學牆壁中的危險蛇類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Engage in a battle of wills with Adele and Mick as they try to coax a python out of a drainpipe. Stand by as Jess and Dan try to grab a keelback snake before it drops a stink bomb, then face a dangerous serpent hidden in a university wall with Stu.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​放鬆一下,觀看米克和阿黛爾在一個養老院中打斷一對交配的東部棕蛇.與斯圖和莉芙一起處理不需要的庫存,他們在倉庫中捕捉到一條綠樹蛇,然後與傑絲和丹一起悄悄接近一位兇險的訪客.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kick back as Mick and Adele break up a pair of mating eastern brown snakes at a retirement home. Take care of unwanted inventory with Stu and Liv, who capture a green tree snake in a warehouse, then sneak up on a killer visitor with Jess and Dan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 角馬為群體階級而戰,狐獴過著幫派生活,鯖魚在陸上分勝負,蝗蟲在同類相食的瘋狂中放棄素食主義.這一切都發生在南非的野外和開闊的景致中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wildebeest battle for herd hierarchy, meerkats live the thug life, floppy fish fight it out on land and locusts give up their vegetarian ways in a frenzy of cannibalism. It all happens on the wild and wide-open landscape of South Africa.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與蒂姆,當地土著和其他專家一同觀察塑造寧格魯珊瑚礁,開普山脈和埃克斯茅斯灣的自然與人為力量.欣賞有百萬年歷史的珊瑚礁化石,一條巨大的魚和令人震撼的鰩魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe the natural and human forces that have shaped Ningaloo Reef, Cape Range, and Exmouth Gulf with Tim, Traditional Owners, and other experts. Check out a million-year-old fossil reef, a gargantuan fish, and a ray that packs quite a punch.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨科學家和當地土著一起規劃保護寧格魯生物多樣性的生態聯繫,遷徙途徑和物種紐帶.與鯨魚嬉戲,在海藻島之間漂浮,見證考古學家揭穿定居者的神話.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow scientists and Traditional Owners as they map out ecological links, migratory pathways, and interspecies bonds that conserve Ningaloos biodiversity. Frolic with whales, float among seaweed islands, and see archaeologists nix a settler myth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​體驗超越人類能力的動物技能.看看鹹水鱷魚如何利用其壓力敏感的圓頂檢測最微小的動作,發現鴿子的內部GPS系統,並利用第七感與海豚一起檢測獵物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeons internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪卡拉哈里沙漠,跟隨幼獴寶寶學習如何讓蠍子解除武裝,並成為午餐的主菜.到肯亞幫助一隻母獅提升調情策略.見證一對同性企鵝伴侶如何共同養育幼雛,並一起加入由一頭亞洲象創立的保姆俱樂部.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters club.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與軍艦鳥一起出動,跟隨他們從較小的海鳥身上偷取食物;造訪一個為疣豬而設的水療中心,一起放鬆身心;解讀非洲象的秘密信息,然後見證戀愛中的卷尾猴如何以投石來吸引心儀對象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephants secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與美洲虎幼崽弗里達一起探索極限,她正在巴西的凱門保護區磨練自己的生存技能.學習如何與媽媽加圖納一起潛行,看姐姐阿努克幫助她躲避飢餓的入侵者,最後進行一次冒險但幸運的單獨跋涉,.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Test limits with jaguar cub Frida, whos honing her survival skills in Brazils Caiman Lodge Reserve. Learn how to sneak with mum Gatuna, see sister Anouk help her hide from hungry interlopers, and go on a reckless solo trek that takes a lucky turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每一天在非洲都上演為生存而掙扎的戲碼.捕獵者狂歡,而大自然的拾屍者亦在等待牠們的機會.當強者死亡時,一支軍隊來吞噬別人留下的東西,因為牠們也必須養育寶貴的家庭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffes demise becomes a source of life for the regions vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪卡拉哈里沙漠,跟隨幼獴寶寶學習如何讓蠍子解除武裝,並成為午餐的主菜.到肯亞幫助一隻母獅提升調情策略.見證一對同性企鵝伴侶如何共同養育幼雛,並一起加入由一頭亞洲象創立的保姆俱樂部.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters club.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與軍艦鳥一起出動,跟隨他們從較小的海鳥身上偷取食物;造訪一個為疣豬而設的水療中心,一起放鬆身心;解讀非洲象的秘密信息,然後見證戀愛中的卷尾猴如何以投石來吸引心儀對象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephants secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與美洲虎幼崽弗里達一起探索極限,她正在巴西的凱門保護區磨練自己的生存技能.學習如何與媽媽加圖納一起潛行,看姐姐阿努克幫助她躲避飢餓的入侵者,最後進行一次冒險但幸運的單獨跋涉,.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Test limits with jaguar cub Frida, whos honing her survival skills in Brazils Caiman Lodge Reserve. Learn how to sneak with mum Gatuna, see sister Anouk help her hide from hungry interlopers, and go on a reckless solo trek that takes a lucky turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每一天在非洲都上演為生存而掙扎的戲碼.捕獵者狂歡,而大自然的拾屍者亦在等待牠們的機會.當強者死亡時,一支軍隊來吞噬別人留下的東西,因為牠們也必須養育寶貴的家庭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffes demise becomes a source of life for the regions vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與蒂姆,當地土著和其他專家一同觀察塑造寧格魯珊瑚礁,開普山脈和埃克斯茅斯灣的自然與人為力量.欣賞有百萬年歷史的珊瑚礁化石,一條巨大的魚和令人震撼的鰩魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe the natural and human forces that have shaped Ningaloo Reef, Cape Range, and Exmouth Gulf with Tim, Traditional Owners, and other experts. Check out a million-year-old fossil reef, a gargantuan fish, and a ray that packs quite a punch.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨科學家和當地土著一起規劃保護寧格魯生物多樣性的生態聯繫,遷徙途徑和物種紐帶.與鯨魚嬉戲,在海藻島之間漂浮,見證考古學家揭穿定居者的神話.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow scientists and Traditional Owners as they map out ecological links, migratory pathways, and interspecies bonds that conserve Ningaloos biodiversity. Frolic with whales, float among seaweed islands, and see archaeologists nix a settler myth.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​前往一個度假村,斯圖和莉芙試圖在度假者面前捕捉一條懷孕的紅腹黑蛇.觀看米克和阿黛爾抓住一條正在追逐雞肉晚餐的花紋監視蜥蜴,然後與傑絲和丹一起捕捉一個滑溜的車庫入侵者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. Watch Mick and Adele nab a lace monitor lizard thats chasing a chicken dinner, then catch a slippery garage intruder with Jess and Dan.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與斯圖和莉芙一起變得一團糟,他們試圖智勝一條大型藍舌蜥蜴.與傑絲和丹一起賽跑,試圖在一條懷孕的蛇變成多條之前救出它,並看看米克和阿黛爾如何將一條蟒蛇遠離兩隻玩耍的小狗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. Race the clock with Jess and Dan as they try to rescue a pregnant snake before one serpent turns into many, and see Mick and Adele keep a python away from two playful puppies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 撒哈拉以南的緯度為繁多的戰士提供了多樣性的戰場.雄性長頸鹿像落錘一樣擺動頭部,斑馬擁有動物王國中最強大的踢腿,黑猩猩的戰爭異常地似曾相識.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The latitudes south of the Sahara offer vastly different battlegrounds for a wide range of warriors. Male giraffes swing their heads like wrecking balls, zebras boast the most powerful kick in the animal kingdom, and chimpanzee warfare is eerily f...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與自然界中最狡猾和堅韌的戰士一起部署生化武器.釋放科莫多龍的毒咬,與獴群一起抵抗有毒的敵人,並觀察鳥類如何使用骨骼粉碎的力量來反擊有毒攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deploy biochemical weaponry with natures most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 樹木主導亞馬遜地區,總數目超過三千億.但是它們每一個都是獨立又蓬勃發展的生態系統.它們是數十種不同動物所組成的繁忙社區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: How many trees can you find in the Amazon? And whats it like to live up in them? Travel through the canopy and see how more than 1200 species of trees coexist. Plus, follow monkeys and other creatures who call these trees home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在亞馬遜森林中,情況可以瞬間從破裂的土地變為氾濫或被樹木淹沒.認識活在這個古老世界的物種必須如何足智多謀和有上進心,才能生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The dry season is the toughest time of year. With lower water levels and less space, animals need to quickly learn new skills to survive...and if they dont, predatory vultures will swoop in for a feast.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看海獅蘿拉在阿根廷海岸的雄性戰場上邁出的第一步.觀察這個海獅寶寶學會了關鍵的發聲和游泳技能,努力留在媽媽瑪麗亞身邊並以迅雷不及掩耳之勢躲過致命捕獵,為她歡呼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch sea lion Lola take her first chaotic steps into a macho battlefield on Argentinas coast. Cheer as this baby learns key vocal and swimming skills, fights to stay by mom Marias side, and makes a lightning-fast escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 牠們的祖先是第一批在乾旱地區殖民的脊椎動物,除南極洲以外,牠們居住在每一個大陸,但牠們的世界正在迅速變化.20個物種稱這個城市為家,但過去的濕地成了遊樂場,高爾夫球場和賽道.這是牠們堅守的土地.世界各地的青蛙數量正在下降,而且時間所剩無幾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the regions species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the citys shrinking wetlands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與阿黛爾和米克展開意志的較量,他們試圖將一條蟒蛇引出排水管.靜候傑絲和丹試圖在一條鰭背蛇放出臭彈之前抓住它,然後與斯圖一起面對隱藏在大學牆壁中的危險蛇類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Engage in a battle of wills with Adele and Mick as they try to coax a python out of a drainpipe. Stand by as Jess and Dan try to grab a keelback snake before it drops a stink bomb, then face a dangerous serpent hidden in a university wall with Stu.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​放鬆一下,觀看米克和阿黛爾在一個養老院中打斷一對交配的東部棕蛇.與斯圖和莉芙一起處理不需要的庫存,他們在倉庫中捕捉到一條綠樹蛇,然後與傑絲和丹一起悄悄接近一位兇險的訪客.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kick back as Mick and Adele break up a pair of mating eastern brown snakes at a retirement home. Take care of unwanted inventory with Stu and Liv, who capture a green tree snake in a warehouse, then sneak up on a killer visitor with Jess and Dan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與阿黛爾和米克展開意志的較量,他們試圖將一條蟒蛇引出排水管.靜候傑絲和丹試圖在一條鰭背蛇放出臭彈之前抓住它,然後與斯圖一起面對隱藏在大學牆壁中的危險蛇類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Engage in a battle of wills with Adele and Mick as they try to coax a python out of a drainpipe. Stand by as Jess and Dan try to grab a keelback snake before it drops a stink bomb, then face a dangerous serpent hidden in a university wall with Stu.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​放鬆一下,觀看米克和阿黛爾在一個養老院中打斷一對交配的東部棕蛇.與斯圖和莉芙一起處理不需要的庫存,他們在倉庫中捕捉到一條綠樹蛇,然後與傑絲和丹一起悄悄接近一位兇險的訪客.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kick back as Mick and Adele break up a pair of mating eastern brown snakes at a retirement home. Take care of unwanted inventory with Stu and Liv, who capture a green tree snake in a warehouse, then sneak up on a killer visitor with Jess and Dan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 樹木主導亞馬遜地區,總數目超過三千億.但是它們每一個都是獨立又蓬勃發展的生態系統.它們是數十種不同動物所組成的繁忙社區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: How many trees can you find in the Amazon? And whats it like to live up in them? Travel through the canopy and see how more than 1200 species of trees coexist. Plus, follow monkeys and other creatures who call these trees home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在亞馬遜森林中,情況可以瞬間從破裂的土地變為氾濫或被樹木淹沒.認識活在這個古老世界的物種必須如何足智多謀和有上進心,才能生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The dry season is the toughest time of year. With lower water levels and less space, animals need to quickly learn new skills to survive...and if they dont, predatory vultures will swoop in for a feast.

epg.programme_title_en: Secrets Of The Great White Shark
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鯊魚是怪物嗎?還是已經被妖魔化?這部紀錄片探討大白鯊本性背後的真相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 領略納米比亞千公裡的狂野海岸!乾旱沙漠中生命頑強綻放,本片捕捉了萬物在極端環境下生存的壯麗奇景.一同見證超越極限的生命之美!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience Namibia’s wild 1,000km coast! Where arid deserts meet stubborn life, this film captures a grandiose, fragile spectacle of nature thriving against all odds. Witness the impossible beauty!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影.這是一片莊嚴且神聖,亟需我們守護的原始荒野!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Rockies to the Pacific, British Columbia is a jewel of biodiversity! Roam vast landscapes where the mighty grizzly bear reigns supreme. It’s a majestic, wild world waiting to be preserved!

epg.programme_title_en: Secrets Of The Great White Shark
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鯊魚是怪物嗎?還是已經被妖魔化?這部紀錄片探討大白鯊本性背後的真相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.programme_title_tc: 前進宇宙:太空,競賽,火星與更遠之處
epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.programme_title_en: Growing Up Grizzly: A Tale Of Two Orphans
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱西安達臣撫養一隻名叫砵突士的熊孤兒18年後,將盡一切努力確保沒有熊生活在人造庇護所中.有一年,當他得知有兩隻灰熊幼崽成為孤兒後,他的決心受到考驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After 18 years of raising an orphaned bear named Brutus, Casey Anderson will do anything to ensure no bears have to live in a man made sanctuary. His resolve is put to the test one year when he is notified of 2 recently orphaned grizzly cubs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From their teeth, and claws, to incredible stealth and cunning, nature’s most lethal predators have evolved a staggering array of hunting techniques.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利到訪加勒比海地區,他在後巷冒險尋覓真正的當地食物.他與當地人共度時光,和好味道先生在海灘上做煎餅和超讚的魚糕,並嘗試了有史以來最辣的辣醬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley visits the Caribbean, where he ventures down the backstreets in search of the true local food. He spends time with the locals, cooks roti on the beach with Mr Delicious, fries up spectacular fishcakes, and tries the hottest hot sauce ever.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往冰島雷克雅未克,發現一種真心刺激的傳統和現代美食.他用大蒜牛油烹調經典的挪威龍蝦,還有醃三文魚和檸汁魚生,麥芽麵包和在間歇泉中焗製的蛋糕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Reykjavik, Iceland, to discover a truly exciting traditional and modern cuisine. She prepares a local classic of langoustines in garlic butter, and there is also gravadlax and ceviche, malted bread, and cakes cooked in a geyser.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利的街頭美食長徵於大阪落幕,他在當地發現了製作大阪燒的藝術,有點像用班㦸包裹的英國早餐,嘗試日本風的小食,並製作生蠔天婦羅和辣蝦烏冬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsleys street food odyssey concludes in Osaka, where he discovers the art of making okonomiyaki, a bit like an English breakfast wrapped in a pancake, tries tapas Japanese style, and makes oyster tempura and udon noodles with chili prawns.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席琳狄翁不用多作介紹.除了成功外,她的私人生活充斥痛苦的悲劇.她的故事關於力量,堅韌和愛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Céline Dion is a name that needs no introduction. Beyond the success, her personal life has been marked with a painful amount of tragedy. Her story is one of strength, resilience and love.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好萊塢以鐵蝴蝶聞名的茱莉安德魯斯,在她七十載的職業生涯中獲得無數讚譽.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Best known in Hollywood as 「The Iron Butterfly」 - Julie Andrews has garnered numerous accolades throughout her career spanning over seven decades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一部講述歌影戲劇三棲最具魅力人物之一的麗莎明妮莉令人難以置信的生活和職業生涯的傳記式紀錄片.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A biographical documentary about the incredible life and career of one of the most charismatic personalities in film, theatre and music: Liza Minnelli.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季對大部分動物來說都是豐收的季節,但對北極熊卻相反.在海洋再度結冰前,牠們無法捕獵海豹,導致日益飢餓.對其他動物來說,夏天是幼崽們必須學習如何生存的時機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer is the season of plenty for most animals, but not polar bears; unable to hunt seals until the sea freezes over again, they grow hungrier by the day; for other animals summer is when youngsters must learn how to survive.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬季的結束預示世上最大型又瘋狂的覓食潮來臨,大型海洋獵食者瞄準在阿拉斯加灣尋求庇護的數百萬條魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The end of winter heralds one of the worlds greatest feeding frenzies as large ocean predators target the millions of fish who have found refuge in the Gulf of Alaska.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著春季來臨,日照變長,氣溫上升.不過,阿拉斯加只有短暫的春季.動物只有兩個月時間來覓食和組織家庭,還要避開獵食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With the arrival of spring, days grow longer and temperatures rise. However, spring in Alaska is short. Animals have just two months to find food and start a family, while avoiding predators.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿拉斯加已進入夏季.這為世上最大規模之一的阿拉斯加三文魚遷徙準備了舞臺.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer has arrived in Alaska.This sets the scene for one of the worlds greatest migrations of the Alaskan salmon run.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 座頭鯨回歸阿拉斯加豐饒的食堂,三文魚則回到河流產卵.不過,牠們必須跟飢餓的棕熊討一條生路.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Humpback whales return to Alaskas rich feeding grounds and salmon return to spawn in the rivers. The returning salmon however have to negotiate a path past hungry brown bears.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述了這些雄偉的座頭鯨的旅程,從覓食地到繁殖地,母鯨與幼鯨之間的溫柔時光,以及幼鯨在最初幾個月面臨的危險,包括與食肉鯨的驚人互動.座頭鯨還面臨著一個充滿人類威脅的世界,從大型貨櫃船到尋找石油和天然氣時地震測試的影響,現在這些威脅再次威脅到它們的生存.

epg.programme_title_tc: 前進宇宙:太空,競賽,火星與更遠之處
epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從洶湧的海到內陸莫哈維沙漠,獲伯發現一個講述偉大的科羅拉多州如何被馴服和胡佛水壩如何被建造的驚人故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From stormy seas to the land locked Mojave Desert, Rob discovers the amazing story of how the mighty Colorado was tamed and the Hoover Dam built.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯前往蘇格蘭北部,發現英國石油工業的故事.儘管從第一批石油到今天創新的鑽探機,那是令人難以置信的工程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travelling to the North of Scotland, Rob discovers the story of the British Oil Industry though it’s incredible engineering; from first oil to today’s innovative rigs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring is late this year, and when it finally arrives, the race is on to find a mate and start a family; black bears and beavers in the west, wood frogs in the south and 20,000 gannets in the east all have one thing on their minds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 科學家史蒂夫託馬斯必須賭上名聲,事業和生命,從一顆直奔地球的巨大小行星中拯救人類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scientist Steve Thomas must risk his reputation, career, and life in order to save mankind from a huge asteroid headed straight for Earth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物嬰兒:為了嬰兒免受極端情況,飢餓掠食者和飢餓威脅,所有動物都必須為其物種的未來而戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Animals: Protecting babies against extreme conditions, hungry predators, and the threat of starvation, all animals must fight for the future of their species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利的街頭美食長徵於大阪落幕,他在當地發現了製作大阪燒的藝術,有點像用班㦸包裹的英國早餐,嘗試日本風的小食,並製作生蠔天婦羅和辣蝦烏冬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsleys street food odyssey concludes in Osaka, where he discovers the art of making okonomiyaki, a bit like an English breakfast wrapped in a pancake, tries tapas Japanese style, and makes oyster tempura and udon noodles with chili prawns.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往義大利西西里島的巴勒摩,並用上即捕的吞拿魚在海灘上準備海鮮麵食.他又品嚐了包括炸魷魚,釀沙甸魚和島上獨特香蒜醬的地道美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Palermo on the Italian island of Sicily and prepares seafood pasta on the beach, using freshly caught tuna; Ainsley samples local delicacies including fried calamari, stuffed sardines and the islands unique recipe for pesto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往臺灣,發現它是世上最偉大的美食聖地之一.他發現香燉魚和辣炒豬肉,並用大蒜和辣椒煮臺灣大蝦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Taiwan and discovers it is one of the greatest food destinations in the world. He finds fragrant braised fish and chilli pork stir-fry, and cooks Taiwan prawns with garlic and chilli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一部講述歌影戲劇三棲最具魅力人物之一的麗莎明妮莉令人難以置信的生活和職業生涯的傳記式紀錄片.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A biographical documentary about the incredible life and career of one of the most charismatic personalities in film, theatre and music: Liza Minnelli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蒂娜透娜是我們這個時代最偉大的表演者之一,她那具爆發力的嗓音,令人興奮的舞臺表演和啟發性的人生故事俘虜全球數百萬人的心靈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the greatest performers of our time, Tina Turner, has captured the hearts and souls of millions around the world with her powerful voice, electrifying stage presence, and inspiring life story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 芭芭拉史翠珊以其高亢,精緻的嗓音本事和魅力四射的個性,使她成為一生中最具創意和商業上最成功的表演者之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With her highly resonant and sophisticated vocal prowess and charismatic personality, Barbra Streisand rose to fame as one of the most creatively and commercially successful performers of her lifetime.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 布斯韋利士憑著在《虎膽龍威》中飾演尊麥堅這個標誌性角色而成為巨星,他在傳奇的演藝生涯演出過百部電影.他以魅力和幽默而聞名,但卻在2022年遭遇悲慘的挫折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bruce Willis became a star with his iconic role as John McClane in Die Hard, leading to a legendary career with over 100 films. Known for his charm and humor, his career faced a tragic setback in 2022.

epg.programme_title_tc: 布萊德彼特:突破好萊塢
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 他可能是最性感的好萊塢演員之一,但他的職業和個人目標比他的外表更有味道.布萊德彼特.整個好萊塢首屈一指的人物之一.一個默默無聞的天才轉變為超級巨星的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: He may be one of the sexiest Hollywood actors, but his career and personal goals offer much more than his looks. Brad Pitt. One of the leading names in all of Hollywood. The well-known story of an unknown talent who transformed into a superstar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從塔爾(Thal)的平凡起點,到成為好萊塢最響亮的名字之一.他以健美運動員出身,隨後轉戰演藝界與政壇,這就是傳奇動作巨星阿諾·史瓦辛格(Arnold Schwarzenegger)的一生與諸多考驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings in Thal to becoming one of the biggest names in Hollywood. He began as a bodybuilder, he turned to acting and politics, this is the life and many trials of the legendary action star, Arnold Schwarzenegger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出身卑微到成為有抱負的演員,再到扮演世上最具標誌性和最著名的角色.他贏得了美國好人,平民和藝術遊牧民的美譽.而我們都知道他......是 湯姆漢克斯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings to an aspiring thespian to acting as some of the world’s most iconic and notable characters. He has picked up a reputation as 『America’s Nice Guy』, 』The Everyman』 and a nomad of the arts. But we all know him... as Tom Hanks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每個人都認為自己熟悉夏裡遜福.他們認識富有冒險精神的反納粹考古學家和反烏託邦未來的銀翼殺手.但一旦停下攝錄機,就沒有人真正瞭解演員的真實人生了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Everyone thinks they know Harrison Ford. They know the adventurous Nazi-fighting archaeologist and the Blade Runner from a dystopian future. But nobody really knows the man behind the movies once the cameras have stopped rolling.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 科學家史蒂夫託馬斯必須賭上名聲,事業和生命,從一顆直奔地球的巨大小行星中拯救人類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scientist Steve Thomas must risk his reputation, career, and life in order to save mankind from a huge asteroid headed straight for Earth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 業餘賽車手蕭詠詩 (Vivian Siu) 夢想徵戰澳門格蘭披治大賽.她自費且經驗極少,迅速躍升至 F4,成為中國錦標賽首位女車手.她面臨著技術和籌集關鍵資金的巨大挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amateur driver Vivian Siu chases her dream of racing the Macau Grand Prix. Self-funded and with minimal experience, she quickly jumps to Formula 4, becoming the first female driver in the Chinese Championship. She faces the huge challenge of driving

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 澳門大賽從賽程中移除,Vivian 的賽車之旅遭遇挫折,夢想面臨終結.即使有一絲希望,她仍需在數週內完成尋找賽車,車隊和搭檔車手的艱鉅任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Vivians journey hits a roadblock when the Macau Grand Prix is removed from the calendar, threatening to end her dream. Even with a small chance of hope, she faces the immense task of securing a car, a team, and a co-driver in mere weeks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.

epg.programme_title_tc: 傳奇拳王: 曼尼帕奎奧
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是拳擊界最勢不可擋的力量之一的非凡旅程.曼尼柏基奧的傳奇將因其在拳擊場內外所實現的變革而被永遠銘記......
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is the remarkable journey of one of boxing’s most unstoppable forces. Manny Pacquiao’s legacy will forever be remembered for the change accomplished inside and outside the ring...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《恐龍效應》是一部關於現今加拿大古生物學復興的紀錄片,恐龍能怎樣教導我們有關氣候變化的知識.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Dinosaur Echo is a documentary about the renaissance of paleontology in Canada today and what dinosaurs can teach us about climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 領略納米比亞千公裡的狂野海岸!乾旱沙漠中生命頑強綻放,本片捕捉了萬物在極端環境下生存的壯麗奇景.一同見證超越極限的生命之美!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience Namibia’s wild 1,000km coast! Where arid deserts meet stubborn life, this film captures a grandiose, fragile spectacle of nature thriving against all odds. Witness the impossible beauty!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影.這是一片莊嚴且神聖,亟需我們守護的原始荒野!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Rockies to the Pacific, British Columbia is a jewel of biodiversity! Roam vast landscapes where the mighty grizzly bear reigns supreme. It’s a majestic, wild world waiting to be preserved!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往臺灣,發現它是世上最偉大的美食聖地之一.他發現香燉魚和辣炒豬肉,並用大蒜和辣椒煮臺灣大蝦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Taiwan and discovers it is one of the greatest food destinations in the world. He finds fragrant braised fish and chilli pork stir-fry, and cooks Taiwan prawns with garlic and chilli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利發現馬德裡是個充滿秘密的城市.首先這個沉迷美食的城市禁止街頭美食.那麼當地人如何繞過這道禁令呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley discovers that Madrid is a city of secrets. The first one comes as a bit of a shock: street food is banned in this food-obsessed city. So how do the locals get round this?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利來到摩洛哥,但他沒有去馬拉喀什或卡薩布蘭加,而是去了豐富多彩,混亂而夢幻的費茲.雜亂無序的麥地那是世界遺產,也是通往另一個時代的門戶.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley lands in Morocco, but he doesnt go to Marrakesch or Casablanca, but to the colourful, chaotic and dreamy city of Fes. The sprawling medina is a World Heritage site and a gateway to another time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅.從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智慧統治著地球和我們.人工智慧將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨的最大存亡風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a near-future where artificial intelligence rules the planet, and us. AI will arrive in our life-times bringing with it the biggest existential risk humanity has ever faced.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯沿著巴拿馬運河旅行,以瞭解無法被徵服的地峽如何屈服於堅定的工程師的意志和技巧之下,從而創造出現今的七大奇蹟之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rob journeys along the length of the Panama Canal to learn how the un-conquerable Isthmus was bent to the will and skill of determined engineers, creating one of the seven wonders of the Modern World.

epg.programme_title_tc: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅:蘇格蘭 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Alan Cummings Most Luxurious Train Journeys: Scotland #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾倫從愛丁堡出發,探索一列奢華列車,與列車主廚會面,造訪二戰與雅各賓紀念地,漫步於莫拉的銀白沙灘,並了解西高地鐵路的工程奇蹟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alan explores a luxury train from Edinburgh, meets its chef, visits WWII and Jacobite memorials, strolls Morar’s Silver Sands, and learns about the West Highland Line’s engineering marvels.

epg.programme_title_tc: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅:蘇格蘭 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Alan Cummings Most Luxurious Train Journeys: Scotland #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾倫在列車上享受水療設施,造訪威姆斯灣,參觀布特島上的斯圖亞特山莊,欣賞珍貴的莎士比亞原稿,探索列車工作人員區域,參與刺激冒險,並造訪皮特洛赫裡的著名山頂劇院.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alan enjoys the trains spa, visits Wemyss Bay, tours Mount Stuart on Bute, sees a rare Shakespeare folio, explores crew areas, joins wild adventures, and tours Pitlochry’s famed hilltop theatre.

epg.programme_title_tc: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅:蘇格蘭 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Alan Cummings Most Luxurious Train Journeys: Scotland #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾倫的奢華列車之旅持續展開,欣賞車廂美景,了解卡洛登的歷史,在普洛克頓觀察海豹,聆聽牧牛故事,體驗駕駛列車,品嚐威士忌,觀察老鷹,並在鄉間享受瑜伽的寧靜時光.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alan’s luxury train tour continues with cabin views, Culloden’s history, seal-spotting in Plockton, cattle droving tales, train driving, whisky tasting, eagle spotting, and countryside yoga bliss.

epg.programme_title_tc: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅:蘇格蘭 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Alan Cummings Most Luxurious Train Journeys: Scotland #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Alan 展開一段罕見旅程,航行至愛奧那與斯塔法,參觀司康宮與鄧迪 VA 博物館,與百老匯老友重聚,品嚐歐本的海鮮,最後在福斯橋旁參加凱利舞會作為告別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alan’s rare journey sails to Iona and Staffa, tours Scone Palace and VA Dundee, reunites with a Broadway friend, savours Oban seafood, and ends with a ceilidh and farewell over the Forth Bridge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這城市擁有悠久的歷史和大量的美食,還有令人驚喜的高水準明火烹飪,新鮮義大利小雲吞和意想不到經典費城牛肉芝士三文治.文拿與喜劇演員馬士祖班尼一起學習製作美味的冬甩,並吃下一個極巨大的肉丸三文治.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The city rich in history and hearty food surprises with elevated live-fire cooking, fresh Capalachi pasta and an unexpected turn on the classic Philly 「Cheesesteak」. Mena learns to make delectable donuts with funnyman Maz Jobrani and crushes an absol

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿到訪一個充滿傳統⋯⋯和肉汁的城市,他品嚐了豐盛的素魁北克經典美食-蓋澆薯條,煙燻肉三文治,加拿大肉餡餅和著名的蒙特婁貝果.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena visits a city steeped in tradition... and gravy, as he indulges in hearty planted-based Quebecois classics-poutine, smoked 「meat」 sandwiches, tourtiere, and the famous Montreal bagel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從頭記錄ABBA由歐洲歌唱大賽到崛起成全球巨星,他們標誌性的嗓音,破紀錄的成功,單飛的努力,ABBA精選唱片- Gold的復甦,以及先進的全息投影巡演- 《啟航》,樂隊以虛擬形式重聚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chronicling ABBAs rise from Eurovision to global stardom, their iconic sound, record-breaking success, solo endeavors, ABBA Gold revival, and cutting-edge hologram tour Voyage that reunited the virtual band.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《萊恩雷諾斯:談笑風生》是一部紀錄片,追隨這位演員從溫哥華到好萊塢的崛起,探索他的喜劇發展,個人生活,心理健康,慈善事業和社交媒體掌控力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ryan Reynolds: Funny Business is a documentary tracing the actors rise from Vancouver to Hollywood, exploring his comedic evolution, personal life, mental health, philanthropy, and social media mastery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾倫的奢華列車之旅持續展開,欣賞車廂美景,了解卡洛登的歷史,在普洛克頓觀察海豹,聆聽牧牛故事,體驗駕駛列車,品嚐威士忌,觀察老鷹,並在鄉間享受瑜伽的寧靜時光.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alan’s luxury train tour continues with cabin views, Culloden’s history, seal-spotting in Plockton, cattle droving tales, train driving, whisky tasting, eagle spotting, and countryside yoga bliss.

epg.programme_title_tc: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅:蘇格蘭 #4

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alan’s rare journey sails to Iona and Staffa, tours Scone Palace and VA Dundee, reunites with a Broadway friend, savours Oban seafood, and ends with a ceilidh and farewell over the Forth Bridge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這城市擁有悠久的歷史和大量的美食,還有令人驚喜的高水準明火烹飪,新鮮義大利小雲吞和意想不到經典費城牛肉芝士三文治.文拿與喜劇演員馬士祖班尼一起學習製作美味的冬甩,並吃下一個極巨大的肉丸三文治.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場前所未見的流星雨,讓一名科學家,他的助手以及一名陰謀論者察覺到一個巨大的掩蓋行動,以及一場更龐大的威脅--一顆正朝地球逼近,足以毀滅世界的隕石.他們必須爭分奪秒揭露真相,拯救地球.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An unmatched meteor shower alerts a scientist, his assistant, and a conspiracy theorist to a massive cover-up and an even massive threat: a meteor aiming to destroy Earth. They race to expose the truth and save the planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場前所未見的流星雨,讓一名科學家,他的助手以及一名陰謀論者察覺到一個巨大的掩蓋行動,以及一場更龐大的威脅--一顆正朝地球逼近,足以毀滅世界的隕石.他們必須爭分奪秒揭露真相,拯救地球.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明在日本發現了一連串樂趣.在寒冷的北海道北島上,他品嚐了海膽,池沼公魚和精緻的芝士蛋糕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw discovers a host of delights in Japan. On the wintry northern island of Hokkaido, he samples sea urchin, pond smelt and boutique cheesecake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利到訪檳島首都喬治敦,馬來西亞人發現這個沉迷美食的國家中最好的街頭食品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley visits Georgetown, the capital of Penang island, where Malaysians come to discover the best street food in this food-obsessed country.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利在美食之旅的最後一站到訪問約旦的安曼,那是來自伊拉克,黎巴嫩,巴勒斯坦和敘利亞中東一族叫作家的交匯處.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the final leg of his culinary journey, Ainsley visits Amman in Jordan, the crossroads in the Middle East that families from Iraq, Lebanon, Palestine and Syria now call home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯沿著巴拿馬運河旅行,以瞭解無法被徵服的地峽如何屈服於堅定的工程師的意志和技巧之下,從而創造出現今的七大奇蹟之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rob journeys along the length of the Panama Canal to learn how the un-conquerable Isthmus was bent to the will and skill of determined engineers, creating one of the seven wonders of the Modern World.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從洶湧的海到內陸莫哈維沙漠,獲伯發現一個講述偉大的科羅拉多州如何被馴服和胡佛水壩如何被建造的驚人故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From stormy seas to the land locked Mojave Desert, Rob discovers the amazing story of how the mighty Colorado was tamed and the Hoover Dam built.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯前往蘇格蘭北部,發現英國石油工業的故事.儘管從第一批石油到今天創新的鑽探機,那是令人難以置信的工程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travelling to the North of Scotland, Rob discovers the story of the British Oil Industry though it’s incredible engineering; from first oil to today’s innovative rigs.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往巴西,一群巨型發電船正處於解決當地逼切的電力需求的最後階段.它們對抗風浪,趕在限期前為200萬戶家庭提供盡可能多的電力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Host Mike Davidson goes to Brazil where giant powerships are in the final stages of fixing the countrys desperate need for electricity. They battle winds and sea as they race to hit the deadline to send much needed power to two million homes.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往智利偏遠的阿塔卡馬沙漠,到訪地球上最令人難以置信,最複雜的天文臺之一- ALMA.他與ALMA的專家團一起修復一些世上最大的天線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Host Mike Davidson goes to the remote Atacama desert in Chile and to one of the most incredible and complex observatories on Earth - ALMA. He works alongside ALMAs expert team as they repair some of the worlds biggest antennas.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球疫情導致世上唯一的水底棲息地停運.米克大衛臣加入裂縫修復小組,一同潛入水中修復它,並讓美國太空總署的太空人返回內部進行訓練.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The worldwide pandemic ceased operations on the worlds only underwater habitat. Mike Davidson joins a crack repair crew as they dive in to bring it back to life and get NASA astronauts back inside for training.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入正準備接受試驗的美國海軍陸戰隊的重型運輸機中隊.他們致力保持CH53超級種馬直升機機隊飛行,為在沙漠和山區進行激戰的訓練演習作準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson joins the US Marines Heavy Haulers squadron as theyre put to the test. They battle to keep their fleet of CH53 Super Stallion choppers flying, in preparation for intense warfare training exercises in the desert and mountains.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣展開一場跨國公路旅行,以幫助井井有條基金會.他們致力尋找並封鎖全美各地估計200萬個洩漏,有毒,可能致命的廢棄石油和天然氣井.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson goes on a cross-country road trip to help the Well Done Foundation. They work to find and cap some of the estimated two million leaking, toxic - potentially deadly abandoned oil and gas wells that are scattered throughout the U.S.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入世上最極端,最容易發生雪崩的滑雪山之一- 雪鳥的團隊.他們使用鏟子,壓雪車,甚至二戰的榴彈砲,奮力保衛陡峭斜坡的安全.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson embeds with the team of one of the most extreme, avalanche-prone mountain ski mountains in the world - Snowbird. They battle to keep the steep and deep slopes safe with shovels, snowcats and even a WWII Howitzer cannon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是勵志的一集,我們花時間與團隊一起將毛利人帶到元宇宙,並了解一些當地的顛覆者,他們關注打造每個人都有歸屬感的數碼世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its an inspirational episode, we spend time with the team taking Māori to the metaverse and check-in on a couple of local disrupters focused on making digital worlds where everyone feels like they can belong.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏天代表食物充足,今年的幼崽們必須進食,長大並準備自立.對海鸚來說,當從懸崖頂的巢穴跳落大海時,實在是一次巨大的信仰之躍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer means food is plentiful and this years youngsters must feed, grow and prepare to start life alone. For puffins its a massive leap of faith as they jump from their cliff-top nests into the ocean.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在大西洋最北端,秋季是大風,涼意和大雨的季節.野生動物於此時必須為過冬做足最後準備,或遷移到溫暖的地區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Atlantics far north, autumn is the season of gales, cooling temperatures and driving rain. This is when the wildlife must make the final preparations for winter or migrate to warmer climes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往冰島雷克雅未克,發現一種真心刺激的傳統和現代美食.他用大蒜牛油烹調經典的挪威龍蝦,還有醃三文魚和檸汁魚生,麥芽麵包和在間歇泉中焗製的蛋糕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Reykjavik, Iceland, to discover a truly exciting traditional and modern cuisine. She prepares a local classic of langoustines in garlic butter, and there is also gravadlax and ceviche, malted bread, and cakes cooked in a geyser.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利的街頭美食長徵於大阪落幕,他在當地發現了製作大阪燒的藝術,有點像用班㦸包裹的英國早餐,嘗試日本風的小食,並製作生蠔天婦羅和辣蝦烏冬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsleys street food odyssey concludes in Osaka, where he discovers the art of making okonomiyaki, a bit like an English breakfast wrapped in a pancake, tries tapas Japanese style, and makes oyster tempura and udon noodles with chili prawns.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往義大利西西里島的巴勒摩,並用上即捕的吞拿魚在海灘上準備海鮮麵食.他又品嚐了包括炸魷魚,釀沙甸魚和島上獨特香蒜醬的地道美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Palermo on the Italian island of Sicily and prepares seafood pasta on the beach, using freshly caught tuna; Ainsley samples local delicacies including fried calamari, stuffed sardines and the islands unique recipe for pesto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往臺灣,發現它是世上最偉大的美食聖地之一.他發現香燉魚和辣炒豬肉,並用大蒜和辣椒煮臺灣大蝦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Taiwan and discovers it is one of the greatest food destinations in the world. He finds fragrant braised fish and chilli pork stir-fry, and cooks Taiwan prawns with garlic and chilli.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley discovers that Madrid is a city of secrets. The first one comes as a bit of a shock: street food is banned in this food-obsessed city. So how do the locals get round this?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利來到摩洛哥,但他沒有去馬拉喀什或卡薩布蘭加,而是去了豐富多彩,混亂而夢幻的費茲.雜亂無序的麥地那是世界遺產,也是通往另一個時代的門戶.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley lands in Morocco, but he doesnt go to Marrakesch or Casablanca, but to the colourful, chaotic and dreamy city of Fes. The sprawling medina is a World Heritage site and a gateway to another time.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Reykjavik, Iceland, to discover a truly exciting traditional and modern cuisine. She prepares a local classic of langoustines in garlic butter, and there is also gravadlax and ceviche, malted bread, and cakes cooked in a geyser.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《恐龍效應》是一部關於現今加拿大古生物學復興的紀錄片,恐龍能怎樣教導我們有關氣候變化的知識.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Dinosaur Echo is a documentary about the renaissance of paleontology in Canada today and what dinosaurs can teach us about climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 科學家史蒂夫託馬斯必須賭上名聲,事業和生命,從一顆直奔地球的巨大小行星中拯救人類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scientist Steve Thomas must risk his reputation, career, and life in order to save mankind from a huge asteroid headed straight for Earth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《阿姆斯壯》戲劇性,感人且富有洞察力地講述尼爾巖士唐最完整的人生故事-從他在俄亥俄州鄉村的童年到他首次登月-以及伴隨而來非他所願的名人地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dramatic, moving and insightful, Armstrong tells the definitive life story of Neil Armstrong - from his childhood in rural Ohio, through aerial combat in Korea, to his first steps on the Moon - and the unwanted celebrity status that ensued.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影.這是一片莊嚴且神聖,亟需我們守護的原始荒野!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Rockies to the Pacific, British Columbia is a jewel of biodiversity! Roam vast landscapes where the mighty grizzly bear reigns supreme. It’s a majestic, wild world waiting to be preserved!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《納萊迪:小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Naledi follows the journey of a baby elephant orphaned in a rescue camp, as the man tasked with her survival races to protect an entire species while fighting to save her life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From their teeth, and claws, to incredible stealth and cunning, nature’s most lethal predators have evolved a staggering array of hunting techniques.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集見證大自然最非凡的動物遷徙,並發現牠們為了生存而必須出走多遠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we witness nature’s most extraordinary animal migrations, and discover the lengths they must go to, in order to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物嬰兒:為了嬰兒免受極端情況,飢餓掠食者和飢餓威脅,所有動物都必須為其物種的未來而戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Animals: Protecting babies against extreme conditions, hungry predators, and the threat of starvation, all animals must fight for the future of their species.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏天代表食物充足,今年的幼崽們必須進食,長大並準備自立.對海鸚來說,當從懸崖頂的巢穴跳落大海時,實在是一次巨大的信仰之躍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer means food is plentiful and this years youngsters must feed, grow and prepare to start life alone. For puffins its a massive leap of faith as they jump from their cliff-top nests into the ocean.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入正準備接受試驗的美國海軍陸戰隊的重型運輸機中隊.他們致力保持CH53超級種馬直升機機隊飛行,為在沙漠和山區進行激戰的訓練演習作準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson joins the US Marines Heavy Haulers squadron as theyre put to the test. They battle to keep their fleet of CH53 Super Stallion choppers flying, in preparation for intense warfare training exercises in the desert and mountains.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣展開一場跨國公路旅行,以幫助井井有條基金會.他們致力尋找並封鎖全美各地估計200萬個洩漏,有毒,可能致命的廢棄石油和天然氣井.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson goes on a cross-country road trip to help the Well Done Foundation. They work to find and cap some of the estimated two million leaking, toxic - potentially deadly abandoned oil and gas wells that are scattered throughout the U.S.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入世上最極端,最容易發生雪崩的滑雪山之一- 雪鳥的團隊.他們使用鏟子,壓雪車,甚至二戰的榴彈砲,奮力保衛陡峭斜坡的安全.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson embeds with the team of one of the most extreme, avalanche-prone mountain ski mountains in the world - Snowbird. They battle to keep the steep and deep slopes safe with shovels, snowcats and even a WWII Howitzer cannon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.

epg.programme_title_tc: 前進宇宙:太空,競賽,火星與更遠之處
epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場前所未見的流星雨,讓一名科學家,他的助手以及一名陰謀論者察覺到一個巨大的掩蓋行動,以及一場更龐大的威脅--一顆正朝地球逼近,足以毀滅世界的隕石.他們必須爭分奪秒揭露真相,拯救地球.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An unmatched meteor shower alerts a scientist, his assistant, and a conspiracy theorist to a massive cover-up and an even massive threat: a meteor aiming to destroy Earth. They race to expose the truth and save the planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱西安達臣撫養一隻名叫砵突士的熊孤兒18年後,將盡一切努力確保沒有熊生活在人造庇護所中.有一年,當他得知有兩隻灰熊幼崽成為孤兒後,他的決心受到考驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After 18 years of raising an orphaned bear named Brutus, Casey Anderson will do anything to ensure no bears have to live in a man made sanctuary. His resolve is put to the test one year when he is notified of 2 recently orphaned grizzly cubs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 求偶是最強大的本能之一.從美麗的到奇怪的,本集探索動物王國裡最驚奇的交配儀式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The instinct to secure a mate is one of the most powerful that there is. From the beautiful to the bizarre, this episode explores the most amazing mating rituals from right across the animal kingdom.

epg.programme_title_tc: 前進宇宙:太空,競賽,火星與更遠之處
epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.programme_title_tc: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅:蘇格蘭 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Alan Cummings Most Luxurious Train Journeys: Scotland #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Alan 展開一段罕見旅程,航行至愛奧那與斯塔法,參觀司康宮與鄧迪 VA 博物館,與百老匯老友重聚,品嚐歐本的海鮮,最後在福斯橋旁參加凱利舞會作為告別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alan’s rare journey sails to Iona and Staffa, tours Scone Palace and VA Dundee, reunites with a Broadway friend, savours Oban seafood, and ends with a ceilidh and farewell over the Forth Bridge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這城市擁有悠久的歷史和大量的美食,還有令人驚喜的高水準明火烹飪,新鮮義大利小雲吞和意想不到經典費城牛肉芝士三文治.文拿與喜劇演員馬士祖班尼一起學習製作美味的冬甩,並吃下一個極巨大的肉丸三文治.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The city rich in history and hearty food surprises with elevated live-fire cooking, fresh Capalachi pasta and an unexpected turn on the classic Philly 「Cheesesteak」. Mena learns to make delectable donuts with funnyman Maz Jobrani and crushes an absol

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿到訪一個充滿傳統⋯⋯和肉汁的城市,他品嚐了豐盛的素魁北克經典美食-蓋澆薯條,煙燻肉三文治,加拿大肉餡餅和著名的蒙特婁貝果.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena visits a city steeped in tradition... and gravy, as he indulges in hearty planted-based Quebecois classics-poutine, smoked 「meat」 sandwiches, tourtiere, and the famous Montreal bagel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 芭芭拉史翠珊以其高亢,精緻的嗓音本事和魅力四射的個性,使她成為一生中最具創意和商業上最成功的表演者之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With her highly resonant and sophisticated vocal prowess and charismatic personality, Barbra Streisand rose to fame as one of the most creatively and commercially successful performers of her lifetime.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 業餘賽車手蕭詠詩 (Vivian Siu) 夢想徵戰澳門格蘭披治大賽.她自費且經驗極少,迅速躍升至 F4,成為中國錦標賽首位女車手.她面臨著技術和籌集關鍵資金的巨大挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amateur driver Vivian Siu chases her dream of racing the Macau Grand Prix. Self-funded and with minimal experience, she quickly jumps to Formula 4, becoming the first female driver in the Chinese Championship. She faces the huge challenge of driving

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 澳門大賽從賽程中移除,Vivian 的賽車之旅遭遇挫折,夢想面臨終結.即使有一絲希望,她仍需在數週內完成尋找賽車,車隊和搭檔車手的艱鉅任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Vivians journey hits a roadblock when the Macau Grand Prix is removed from the calendar, threatening to end her dream. Even with a small chance of hope, she faces the immense task of securing a car, a team, and a co-driver in mere weeks.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience Namibia’s wild 1,000km coast! Where arid deserts meet stubborn life, this film captures a grandiose, fragile spectacle of nature thriving against all odds. Witness the impossible beauty!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影.這是一片莊嚴且神聖,亟需我們守護的原始荒野!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命自會找到出路!隨風漂流而來的物種,讓加勒比海成為全球生物多樣性熱點.深入探索這些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生態系,感受海島生機.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿越時空!探索昆士蘭古老的濕地與原生雨林.這裡棲息著史前時代的倖存者,帶您踏上一場通往熱帶澳洲起源的生命活力之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step back in time! Explore Queensland’s ancient wetlands and primary rainforests. Home to survivors of prehistoric eras, it’s a vibrant journey to the very origins of tropical Australia.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine 60s ad men and women and how they used wit and irony to reach a new audience, consequently revolutionizing the industry.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores the world’s most toxic animals, revealing how poison and venom have given them the edge over the competition in their fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索大自然中最頑強的動物如何適應地球上一些最惡劣環境中的極端條件.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores how nature’s toughest animals have adapted to the extreme conditions in some of the planet’s most inhospitable environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《恐龍效應》是一部關於現今加拿大古生物學復興的紀錄片,恐龍能怎樣教導我們有關氣候變化的知識.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利在美食之旅的最後一站到訪問約旦的安曼,那是來自伊拉克,黎巴嫩,巴勒斯坦和敘利亞中東一族叫作家的交匯處.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the final leg of his culinary journey, Ainsley visits Amman in Jordan, the crossroads in the Middle East that families from Iraq, Lebanon, Palestine and Syria now call home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在聖露西亞,雙胞胎驚喜現身梅茜的度假之旅,帆船探險,叢林健行,極致享受的巧克力按摩,蘭姆酒品鑑,熱帶樂趣無限延伸!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Saint Lucia, the twins crash Maisie’s getaway for a whirlwind of sailing adventures, jungle hikes, decadent chocolate massages, rum tastings, and endless tropical fun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,邦妮與雙胞胎展開史詩冒險--賞鯨,火山健行,策馬奔馳,還有極光下的深度環保對話.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland, Bonnie teams up with the twins for an epic escape-whale watching, volcano trekking, horseback riding, and inspiring eco chats under the midnight sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chronicling ABBAs rise from Eurovision to global stardom, their iconic sound, record-breaking success, solo endeavors, ABBA Gold revival, and cutting-edge hologram tour Voyage that reunited the virtual band.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《萊恩雷諾斯:談笑風生》是一部紀錄片,追隨這位演員從溫哥華到好萊塢的崛起,探索他的喜劇發展,個人生活,心理健康,慈善事業和社交媒體掌控力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ryan Reynolds: Funny Business is a documentary tracing the actors rise from Vancouver to Hollywood, exploring his comedic evolution, personal life, mental health, philanthropy, and social media mastery.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿拉斯加已進入夏季.這為世上最大規模之一的阿拉斯加三文魚遷徙準備了舞臺.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer has arrived in Alaska.This sets the scene for one of the worlds greatest migrations of the Alaskan salmon run.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 座頭鯨回歸阿拉斯加豐饒的食堂,三文魚則回到河流產卵.不過,牠們必須跟飢餓的棕熊討一條生路.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Humpback whales return to Alaskas rich feeding grounds and salmon return to spawn in the rivers. The returning salmon however have to negotiate a path past hungry brown bears.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述了這些雄偉的座頭鯨的旅程,從覓食地到繁殖地,母鯨與幼鯨之間的溫柔時光,以及幼鯨在最初幾個月面臨的危險,包括與食肉鯨的驚人互動.座頭鯨還面臨著一個充滿人類威脅的世界,從大型貨櫃船到尋找石油和天然氣時地震測試的影響,現在這些威脅再次威脅到它們的生存.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Often referred to as the dinosaur fish, the coelacanth occupies a unique place in the fossil record, and when it was rediscovered almost a century ago it shook the scientific community. We follow its journey to the present day, accompanying WildOcean

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In A Tale Of Two Sharks we take a look at the incredible array of sharks found off the South African coast, focusing on the endangered Scalloped Hammerhead and the iconic Great White.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園.懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子.兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為力的奇觀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is spring, and migrating ospreys return to the park. Pregnant red deer come down from the mountain tops to the lowlands to calve. On a mountainside, two big cocks fight for the right to mate in a spectacle called a lek.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the British bomber Lancaster flew out of the factory and into action, leading devastating attacks on Germany.
