epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述了這些雄偉的座頭鯨的旅程,從覓食地到繁殖地,母鯨與幼鯨之間的溫柔時光,以及幼鯨在最初幾個月面臨的危險,包括與食肉鯨的驚人互動.座頭鯨還面臨著一個充滿人類威脅的世界,從大型貨櫃船到尋找石油和天然氣時地震測試的影響,現在這些威脅再次威脅到它們的生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode follows the journeys of these magnificent humpbacks, from their feeding grounds to their breeding grounds, the tender moments between mother and calf, and see the dangers their calves face in their first few months, including incredible

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往世界各地的海岸線,那裡的食物和棲息地衝突導致了絕望的生存之戰.目睹企鹅們從愉悅的性情轉變為兇殘的憤怒,進入一頭保護幼崽的座頭鯨的世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Massive elephant seals go nose to nose to win the title of beachmaster, and giant petrels earn the nickname, murderous garbagemen. Meanwhile, a female humpback goes to extremes to protect her calf from amorous males.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起見證南極洲的巴布亞企鵝用一塊石頭表示愛意,走訪馬達加斯加看看狐猴如何利用有毒的千足蟲來擊退害蟲.齊來跟紅鸛學習化妝技巧,並看看蜜蜂獾展示開鎖技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch an Antarctic gentoo penguin pop the question with a rocky token of his devotion, then learn how a Madagascar lemur uses toxic millipedes for pest control. Bone up on makeup techniques with a flamingo and meet a honey badger that can pick locks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來到在伯利茲的「海灘銀行」,見證寄居蟹有序排隊,以我們最歷史悠久的貨幣--貝殼進行交易.然後走訪塞內加爾,探望黑猩猩和他的寵物麝貓.見證一隻水獺如何以「人質」換來免費午餐,並到雨林中與切葉蟻們的一起收割.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get in line with hermit crabs for an orderly shell exchange on a Belize beach, then meet a Senegalese chimps pet genet. Float with an otter who swaps hostages for free meals and admire the agricultural prowess of leafcutter ants in the rainforest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​體驗超越人類能力的動物技能.看看鹹水鱷魚如何利用其壓力敏感的圓頂檢測最微小的動作,發現鴿子的內部GPS系統,並利用第七感與海豚一起檢測獵物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeons internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亞馬遜熱帶雨林中,擁有致命力量的掠食者正在捕獵.完美的進化 - 誰將獲得勝利?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A jaguar stalks the riverbank. A venomous snake is on the move. A Colombian tarantula waits for night fall. Watch as these fierce predators prowl through the jungle and bite into their next great meal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如同亞馬遜的森林一樣豐富,尋找愛情和養家一樣是個挑戰,交配策略也跟動物一樣各適其適.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its not easy to fall in love in the jungle. Find out how these animals turn to strategic mating strategies in order to pass on their genes. Meet monkeys who like monogamy, a bird who rivals Casanova, and a spider wholl risk his life for love.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狗隻正在世界各地拯救生命.在南非機場,趕鳥的邊境牧羊犬正在防止鳥類與飛機發生潛在的破壞性碰撞.在英國鄉村,西班牙獵犬的非凡嗅覺和安那托利亞牧羊犬的天然保護本能在保護瀕危物種方面發揮著至關重要的救命作用.在美國亞特蘭大,一隻受虐的小狗被遺棄在街頭,但被動物服務公司救出後,牠幫助拯救了整個努力應對...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a border collie that protects aircraft from lethal bird strikes, a sprocker spaniel whose sense of smell is saving imperilled water voles, and an Anatolian shepherd that helps conserve Africas most endangered big cat, the cheetah.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 救援隊嘗試救活一頭情況危急的海獺.馬堤博士在海上對抗惡劣的環境,以幫助被纏住的海獅.而在救援中心內,一隻頑皮的小海豹將自己置於險地,一隻瞎眼的鴨子重拾光明.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Battle wind and waves to find a sea lion trapped in a plastic ring. Then visit the rescue center, where over 80 orphan seals must be fed several times a day to prepare for release into the wild, and see an Amazonian duck get a miraculous operation.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​前往一個度假村,斯圖和莉芙試圖在度假者面前捕捉一條懷孕的紅腹黑蛇.觀看米克和阿黛爾抓住一條正在追逐雞肉晚餐的花紋監視蜥蜴,然後與傑絲和丹一起捕捉一個滑溜的車庫入侵者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. Watch Mick and Adele nab a lace monitor lizard thats chasing a chicken dinner, then catch a slippery garage intruder with Jess and Dan.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與斯圖和莉芙一起變得一團糟,他們試圖智勝一條大型藍舌蜥蜴.與傑絲和丹一起賽跑,試圖在一條懷孕的蛇變成多條之前救出它,並看看米克和阿黛爾如何將一條蟒蛇遠離兩隻玩耍的小狗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. Race the clock with Jess and Dan as they try to rescue a pregnant snake before one serpent turns into many, and see Mick and Adele keep a python away from two playful puppies.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Canada, where summer is short and time is tight – any time is the right time to fight. The mighty North provides the setting for bison, bald eagles, and polar bears to wage some of the most heavy-duty fighting in the animal kingdom.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #1
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七隻飢腸轆轆的大熊剛從冬眠中甦醒過來,挑戰隨即展開!一起見證新手媽媽如何與狼群作戰,身型細小的跺跺如何爭奪地盤和金鬆少女的愛,並旁觀老練的伯尼如何與出其不己的少年卡薩諾瓦搏鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondies love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當街頭部族發現深山部族侵入他們的領地後,爭戰一觸即發.目擊馬特諾爾糟糕的育兒技巧,並見證具領袖野心的阿吉特如何展開行動.熱浪來襲,迫使大家在森林中共享資源,緩和衝突氣氛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stand back when a brawl erupts after the Street Troop finds the Hill Troop on their turf. Assess Matnoors poor parenting skills, see alpha wannabe Ajit make his move, then cool off as a heat wave pushes everyone to share the wealth in the forest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以澳洲最近發生災難性森林大火的後續,透過充滿希望,人為干預和復原力的故事,記錄野生動植物的長期恢復情況.本節目發放了一個十萬火急的訊息,不要太遲愛護大自然.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine fires pivotal role in shaping Australias natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020s brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continents wildlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a golden retriever that assuages anxiety and helps heal PTSD, a shepherd mix who rescues mudslide survivors, a pair of spaniels who sniff out underground water leaks, and a group of teachers pets in the UK that assist children learning to read.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋哺乳類救援隊幫助迷路的海龜回家.一頭巨大的海獅被發現被十字弓擊中,需要吊車才能將牠帶到救援中心.馬堤博士幫助一隻果蝠應付晚年,還有幫助一隻好鬥的獨眼海豹游向自由.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亞馬遜熱帶雨林中,擁有致命力量的掠食者正在捕獵.完美的進化 - 誰將獲得勝利?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A jaguar stalks the riverbank. A venomous snake is on the move. A Colombian tarantula waits for night fall. Watch as these fierce predators prowl through the jungle and bite into their next great meal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如同亞馬遜的森林一樣豐富,尋找愛情和養家一樣是個挑戰,交配策略也跟動物一樣各適其適.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its not easy to fall in love in the jungle. Find out how these animals turn to strategic mating strategies in order to pass on their genes. Meet monkeys who like monogamy, a bird who rivals Casanova, and a spider wholl risk his life for love.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟随團隊的腳步,從囤積的病人中分診患者,隨後與救援人員喬 (Jo) 和尚特爾 (Chantelle) 一起解救糾纏在一起的朱鹮.與獸醫梅爾 (Mel) 一起檢查一隻跳水的考拉寶寶,並與一條致命的東方棕色蛇玩伺機而動的遊戲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chase the team as they triage patients from a hoarding case, then free a tangled-up ibis with rescue officers Jo and Chantelle. Check on a baby koala that took a swan dive with vet Mel and play the waiting game with a deadly eastern brown snake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當街頭部族發現深山部族侵入他們的領地後,爭戰一觸即發.目擊馬特諾爾糟糕的育兒技巧,並見證具領袖野心的阿吉特如何展開行動.熱浪來襲,迫使大家在森林中共享資源,緩和衝突氣氛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stand back when a brawl erupts after the Street Troop finds the Hill Troop on their turf. Assess Matnoors poor parenting skills, see alpha wannabe Ajit make his move, then cool off as a heat wave pushes everyone to share the wealth in the forest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七隻飢腸轆轆的大熊剛從冬眠中甦醒過來,挑戰隨即展開!一起見證新手媽媽如何與狼群作戰,身型細小的跺跺如何爭奪地盤和金鬆少女的愛,並旁觀老練的伯尼如何與出其不己的少年卡薩諾瓦搏鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondies love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由亞馬遜到安第斯山脈,南美洲有著一些美景. 從草原上吵鬧的原駝,到灘頭上擠擁的海鬣蜥,再到偷掉居所的寄居蟹,住屋的需求引發很多衝突.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Amazon to the Andes, South America has some beautiful scenery. From guanacos sparring over grassland, to marine iguanas head-butting over a beachhead, to home-stealing hermit crabs, the quest for real estate causes a lot of conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當街頭部族發現深山部族侵入他們的領地後,爭戰一觸即發.目擊馬特諾爾糟糕的育兒技巧,並見證具領袖野心的阿吉特如何展開行動.熱浪來襲,迫使大家在森林中共享資源,緩和衝突氣氛.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #2
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與初賽的優勝者和一些強悍的新挑戰者一起投入這場瘋狂的衝刺,迎接他們的在七月洄游的鮭魚!跟隨大男孩踏上尋找美食之旅,並歡迎紅背兒參加盛宴;再看看新手媽媽能否保護她僅存的小熊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the frantic dash to cash in on Julys salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡迎小猩猩托潘,她是一個需要代孕媽媽照顧的孤兒.當她還在幼兒園學習之時,她的同學們已經進入了初中,高中和野外實習學校.與此同時,16歲的卡斯帕正在為畢業做著準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome baby orangutan Topan, an orphan in need of a surrogate mom. Watch her learning journey in nursery school while her fellow students move through junior, senior, and wild-immersion schools. Meanwhile, 16-year-old Kasper preps for graduation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 觀察幼兒園裡蓬勃發展的友誼和物種間的聯繫,窺探初中生瓦伦蒂诺,尤特里斯和马达拉之間的兄弟情誼.我們看到心不在焉的貝尼沉浸在對食物的熱愛中,還遭到了高年級學生的毆打.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe blossoming friendships and interspecies bonds in nursery school, and peek inside a bromance among junior-school buds Valentino, Yutris and Madara. See distractible Beni lean into his love of food and get a beating from a more-senior pupil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的野生海岸綿延170英里.印度和大西洋的海流匯合於此,逼使大浪湧向海岸線.這裡也是駐莫桑比克的鬼蝠魟研究員安德里亞馬歇爾希望在南非境內進行首次鬼蝠魟探索的地方.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A blind woman has found a new lease on life thanks to her canine running mate, a Jack Russell works as a super-nanny to a surprising array of species, and a team of dogs in Kenya are on daily patrol protecting endangered rhinos from poachers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從內部乾燥的平原上可以看到澳洲最知名的影像,紅色巨石烏盧魯,慵懶地跳躍的紅色袋鼠; 澳洲的干旱中心地帶是巨大又具標誌性的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the vast, dry plains of the interior come some of Australias most recognized imagery, such as the monolithic red rock of Uluru and the bounding red kangaroo. But how did the arid center of the continent come to be?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 處理爭鬥的小鴨圍捕,看看獸醫卡琳娜 (Karina) 是否會請專家來治療考拉斯派克 (Spike) 的腿部骨折.深入了解困擾針鼴寶寶乒 (Ping) 和乓 (Pong) 的胃病問題,並遇到了似乎迷路了的考拉賈拉 (Jarrah).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deal with duelling duckling roundups and find out if vet Karina calls in specialists to treat koala Spikes leg fracture. Get to the bottom of stomach issues plaguing baby echidnas Ping and Pong, and meet koala Jarrah, who seems to have lost his way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以澳洲最近發生災難性森林大火的後續,透過充滿希望,人為干預和復原力的故事,記錄野生動植物的長期恢復情況.本節目發放了一個十萬火急的訊息,不要太遲愛護大自然.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine fires pivotal role in shaping Australias natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020s brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continents wildlife.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #2
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與初賽的優勝者和一些強悍的新挑戰者一起投入這場瘋狂的衝刺,迎接他們的在七月洄游的鮭魚!跟隨大男孩踏上尋找美食之旅,並歡迎紅背兒參加盛宴;再看看新手媽媽能否保護她僅存的小熊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the frantic dash to cash in on Julys salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡迎小猩猩托潘,她是一個需要代孕媽媽照顧的孤兒.當她還在幼兒園學習之時,她的同學們已經進入了初中,高中和野外實習學校.與此同時,16歲的卡斯帕正在為畢業做著準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome baby orangutan Topan, an orphan in need of a surrogate mom. Watch her learning journey in nursery school while her fellow students move through junior, senior, and wild-immersion schools. Meanwhile, 16-year-old Kasper preps for graduation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 觀察幼兒園裡蓬勃發展的友誼和物種間的聯繫,窺探初中生瓦伦蒂诺,尤特里斯和马达拉之間的兄弟情誼.我們看到心不在焉的貝尼沉浸在對食物的熱愛中,還遭到了高年級學生的毆打.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe blossoming friendships and interspecies bonds in nursery school, and peek inside a bromance among junior-school buds Valentino, Yutris and Madara. See distractible Beni lean into his love of food and get a beating from a more-senior pupil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的野生海岸綿延170英里.印度和大西洋的海流匯合於此,逼使大浪湧向海岸線.這裡也是駐莫桑比克的鬼蝠魟研究員安德里亞馬歇爾希望在南非境內進行首次鬼蝠魟探索的地方.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A blind woman has found a new lease on life thanks to her canine running mate, a Jack Russell works as a super-nanny to a surprising array of species, and a team of dogs in Kenya are on daily patrol protecting endangered rhinos from poachers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從內部乾燥的平原上可以看到澳洲最知名的影像,紅色巨石烏盧魯,慵懶地跳躍的紅色袋鼠; 澳洲的干旱中心地帶是巨大又具標誌性的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the vast, dry plains of the interior come some of Australias most recognized imagery, such as the monolithic red rock of Uluru and the bounding red kangaroo. But how did the arid center of the continent come to be?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 處理爭鬥的小鴨圍捕,看看獸醫卡琳娜 (Karina) 是否會請專家來治療考拉斯派克 (Spike) 的腿部骨折.深入了解困擾針鼴寶寶乒 (Ping) 和乓 (Pong) 的胃病問題,並遇到了似乎迷路了的考拉賈拉 (Jarrah).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deal with duelling duckling roundups and find out if vet Karina calls in specialists to treat koala Spikes leg fracture. Get to the bottom of stomach issues plaguing baby echidnas Ping and Pong, and meet koala Jarrah, who seems to have lost his way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現實中決鬥的龍,巨型相撲甲蟲,街頭毆鬥的猴子和扮演山之王的海龜- 處於另一隻海龜之上,東南亞擁有繁多的野生動物戰士.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With real-life dueling dragons, giant sumo-wrestling beetles, street-fighting monkeys, and sea turtles that play king of the hill – on top of another sea turtle, Southeast Asia boasts a wide range of wildlife warriors.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #3
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 挑戰者一一提起精神,因為十月的寒流使局面變得更加複雜.看看大男孩在絆倒後如何重新振作,然後見證悲劇降臨四子之母.為粉絲最愛的新手媽媽和她的黏人的小孩加油.挑戰來到尾聲,誰會成為最終的皇者?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況.佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了.了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟水獺奧茲以及他的教練萊絲莉一起學習游泳,接著看看佩特羅內爾如何贏得犀牛孤兒莉莉的信任,牠曾因偷獵者而受到創傷.和老鼠科比一起嗅出地雷,並和雙髻鯊蓋婭一起自由潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狗隻在本集利用其出色的嗅覺進行拯救生命和積極地保護環境治安的工作.在加拿大,一隊偵緝犬正在嗅探破壞性的入侵物種斑馬貽貝,這些貽貝對北美的湖泊和河流造成嚴重破壞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Labrador cross and its partner help prevent ecological disaster in Canada, a Lagotto Romagnolo unearths a rare delicacy in Washington forests, and a Belgian malinois team tracks down the critically endangered geometric tortoise to save the species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大狄維亭山脈被巨大的力量所打造,從大陸的中心地帶以一條細長的綠色絲帶分開.從塔斯曼尼亞的冰冷山峰經過1800英里,到達古老的戴恩樹雨林,無數的物種以大狄維亭山脈為家,全都適應地生存,並茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Created by titanic forces and spanning 3,700 km along the eastern edge of Australia, the Great Dividing Range separates two very different worlds. Aerial footage and intimate studies reveal how species survive and thrive in this mountain home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與大量被遺棄的考拉幼崽打交道,隨後與獸醫護士尼克 (Nick) 一起尋找治療小袋鼠腸道疾病的天然藥物.思考如何解救被困在樹上的蝙蝠寶寶,並觀看獸醫卡琳娜為一隻翅膀骨折的倉鸮進行手術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Contend with a flood of abandoned koala joeys, then join vet nurse Nick on a hunt for natural remedies to treat a wallabys gut ailment. Ponder options for a baby bat stuck in a tree and look on as vet Karina operates on a barn owls fractured wing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與大量被遺棄的考拉幼崽打交道,隨後與獸醫護士尼克 (Nick) 一起尋找治療小袋鼠腸道疾病的天然藥物.思考如何解救被困在樹上的蝙蝠寶寶,並觀看獸醫卡琳娜為一隻翅膀骨折的倉鸮進行手術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Contend with a flood of abandoned koala joeys, then join vet nurse Nick on a hunt for natural remedies to treat a wallabys gut ailment. Ponder options for a baby bat stuck in a tree and look on as vet Karina operates on a barn owls fractured wing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況.佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了.了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟水獺奧茲以及他的教練萊絲莉一起學習游泳,接著看看佩特羅內爾如何贏得犀牛孤兒莉莉的信任,牠曾因偷獵者而受到創傷.和老鼠科比一起嗅出地雷,並和雙髻鯊蓋婭一起自由潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 美國地大物博充滿奇觀.大角羊在山頂躁動.棕熊在戰鬥,奮不顧身為冬天囤脂.尖尾松雞在舞池中搖擺尾羽.野生種馬優美地踏步.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The USA is big on flash and spectacle. Bighorn rams rattle the mountaintops. Brown bears battle, desperate to fatten up for winter. Sharp-tailed grouse shake their tail-feathers on the dance floor. Wild stallions rumble with beauty and grace.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洪都拉斯海岸島嶼是熱門的度假勝地,但吸引遊客的不止是它的陽光與海灘.它實際上是一個潛水者天堂,島的各個角落都散落著沉船.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But its not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. Its actually a divers paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過馬修・麥康納的旁述,跟隨鯰魚,虎貓等當地生物的視角,展開一場奇妙之旅.讓我們一同讚頌德克薩斯州的地景風貌和野生動物,並深入了解保育工作對拯救德克薩斯州獨特棲息地的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star States landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當家庭分崩離析,一隻幼獅必須活下來; 兩隻青少年豹崽在被遺棄後必須自生自滅,一隻年輕的成年黑羚必須冒上生命和肢體的危險,因牠試圖保證第一次交配.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young lion cub must survive as his family is torn apart; two adolescent leopard cubs must fend for themselves after they are abandoned, and a young adult blackbuck must risk life and limb as he tries to secure his first mating.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華贊是一頭強大的雄性領袖,坐擁一個異常龐大的部隊.他在維持這個大集團方面做得很好,但未來的路並不明朗.還有更多的同伴需要糊口,但牠的叢林正在萎縮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rajan is the powerful alpha male who sits at the head of an unusually large troop. He has done well to sustain such a big group, but the future doesnt look so bright. There are more mouths to feed, and yet his jungle home is shrinking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豪華的廟宇花園坐落在古城焦特布爾的邊緣位置,是一大群長尾葉猴的家,牠們享受著寧靜的生活,卻有嚴格的等級制度.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nestled on the edge of the ancient city of Jodhpur, the luxurious Temple Gardens are home to a huge troop of Hanuman Langurs, who enjoy a peaceful life of bounty. But the troop has a strict hierarchy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在印度南部炎熱又潮濕的熱帶森林中,一位雌性眼鏡王蛇正在執行任務:在季候風到來前,她需要找到伴侶,食物並順利下蛋.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the hot forest of Southern India, a female King Cobra is on a mission: to find a mate, find food, and lay eggs before the monsoon arrives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在印度南部的森林中,夏季無情的酷熱給亞洲大象帶來了挑戰,他們每天都需要喝水.當水開始在周圍消失時,聰明的女族長安露娜決定帶領她的家人遷移到遙遠的水源.她能否成功為3個月大的孫子找到新水源?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In southern India, the summer is a challenge for Asian elephants who must drink every day. As things dry up, Anura, the matriarch, leads her herd to a distant watering hole. But will she succeed in getting her 3-month-old grandson there in time?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狗隻在本集正以各種令人驚訝的方式來幫助我們.一隻大丹犬向我們展示如何改變一名13歲的馬薩諸塞州女孩的生活,她只剩有限的生命.一隻隸屬搜索和救援隊的邊境牧羊犬曾經在動物收容所等死,但現在是加州特遣部隊不可或缺的一員,當地震,颶風或致命的泥石流襲擊時負責尋找倖存者.尚比亞的反偷獵犬路格正在檢查走私...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dogs around the world come to the rescue in surprising ways. Some search for survivors when disaster strikes or rescue animals from poachers and wildlife traffickers. Others help us in times of trouble-both on land and in the water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狗隻正在世界各地拯救生命.在南非機場,趕鳥的邊境牧羊犬正在防止鳥類與飛機發生潛在的破壞性碰撞.在英國鄉村,西班牙獵犬的非凡嗅覺和安那托利亞牧羊犬的天然保護本能在保護瀕危物種方面發揮著至關重要的救命作用.在美國亞特蘭大,一隻受虐的小狗被遺棄在街頭,但被動物服務公司救出後,牠幫助拯救了整個努力應對...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a border collie that protects aircraft from lethal bird strikes, a sprocker spaniel whose sense of smell is saving imperilled water voles, and an Anatolian shepherd that helps conserve Africas most endangered big cat, the cheetah.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集集中在狗隻與其(大部份)人類拍檔間的卓越合作關係.2018年,一隻德國牧羊種的搜救犬與加州特遣隊和她的洛杉磯消防員拍檔被部署在蒙特西托尋找破壞性泥石流意外的倖存者.在英國,土地調查犬類拍檔- 西班牙獵犬與牠們的人類拍檔,使用牠們的鼻子進行地下水洩漏搜索.最後,同樣在英國,與一隻學會閱讀的聰...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a golden retriever that assuages anxiety and helps heal PTSD, a shepherd mix who rescues mudslide survivors, a pair of spaniels who sniff out underground water leaks, and a group of teachers pets in the UK that assist children learning to read.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的野生海岸綿延170英里.印度和大西洋的海流匯合於此,逼使大浪湧向海岸線.這裡也是駐莫桑比克的鬼蝠魟研究員安德里亞馬歇爾希望在南非境內進行首次鬼蝠魟探索的地方.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A blind woman has found a new lease on life thanks to her canine running mate, a Jack Russell works as a super-nanny to a surprising array of species, and a team of dogs in Kenya are on daily patrol protecting endangered rhinos from poachers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狗隻在本集利用其出色的嗅覺進行拯救生命和積極地保護環境治安的工作.在加拿大,一隊偵緝犬正在嗅探破壞性的入侵物種斑馬貽貝,這些貽貝對北美的湖泊和河流造成嚴重破壞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Labrador cross and its partner help prevent ecological disaster in Canada, a Lagotto Romagnolo unearths a rare delicacy in Washington forests, and a Belgian malinois team tracks down the critically endangered geometric tortoise to save the species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速.觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊,與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺,與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物,並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​體驗超越人類能力的動物技能.看看鹹水鱷魚如何利用其壓力敏感的圓頂檢測最微小的動作,發現鴿子的內部GPS系統,並利用第七感與海豚一起檢測獵物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeons internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與自然界中最狡猾和堅韌的戰士一起部署生化武器.釋放科莫多龍的毒咬,與獴群一起抵抗有毒的敵人,並觀察鳥類如何使用骨骼粉碎的力量來反擊有毒攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deploy biochemical weaponry with natures most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是自然界中最具戲劇性的事件之一. 捕食者殺戮獵物時,血肉橫飛,塵土飛揚,爪子和牙齒都染紅.不過大自然的殺戮機器是如何實現這種史詩式的速度,狡猾和敏捷?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從高地到阿爾卑斯山,歐洲令人回味的景致成為了野生動物劇的史詩式背景.通常,堅忍的歐洲馬鹿在發情期會變得狂野,狼群發生領土衝突,狐狸踏著狐步- 這並非聽起來般美好.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Highlands to the Alps, Europes evocative landscapes are the backdrop for epic wildlife drama. Normally stoic red deer go wild during the rut. Wolf packs clash over territory, and foxes do the foxtrot - its not as nice as it sounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從機會主義的海盜船到裝備精良的海軍艦艇,墨西哥的尤卡坦半島沉浸在海事的歷史中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From opportunistic pirate ships, to well-armed navy vessels, Mexicos Yucatan Peninsula is steeped in maritime history.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們將帶領您環繞著赤道,深入探索居住在熱帶森林中的多樣物種,您將有機會遇見一隻獨自打造迷你森林的樹懶,與共享互助的狐猴,以及細心照料林地花園的象群,隨後,我們將一同揭開熱帶森林的神秘面紗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Circle the equator for a look at the diverse species that dwell in tropical forests. Meet a lone sloth growing a mini-forest, lemurs that share and share alike, and elephants that tend to their woodland gardens. Then explore the regions dark side.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與我們一同欣賞四季更迭,並深入了解樹木和動物如何相互依賴共生.在夜幕低垂之際,欣賞在春天夜晚翩翩起舞的螢火蟲,探索協助樹木降溫的夏季菌菇,並在秋葉紛飛之際為秋季的來臨做好準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the seasons wax and wane and learn how trees and animals help one another survive. Witness spring fireflies dancing after dark, discover summer fungi that cool off overheated trees, and prep for autumn migrations as the leaves begin to fall.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與我們一同踏入樹林與水源共同孕育新生命的溼地,再潛入保護年幼海狗的水下森林,拜訪一群藏身在紅樹林保護區的好奇水下古怪生物,同時你還有機會一窺真實存在的沼澤怪物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wade into wetlands, where trees and water meet to nurture new life. Dive into an underwater forest that protects young fur seals, visit a mangrove sanctuary where a curious band of aquatic misfits hides out, and meet some real-life swamp monsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上的森林如何連結和滋養著無數物種的生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Climb into a realm of thin air and towering rock. Tag along as mythical monkeys battle for a winter food stash, sing along with lemurs in a fruit-filled tree canopy, and watch an aromatic tree bring together blossom and possum in a moonlit tryst.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上的森林如何連結和滋養著無數物種的生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to the Arctic for a peek at the brutal challenges of life in the boreal forest, then admire some stellar animal adaptations. Witness a secret reindeer superpower, navigate a rodent labyrinth of snow, and learn why moose are gourmets at heart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上的森林如何連結和滋養著無數物種的生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how plants and animals tough it out in some of the driest terrain Earth has to offer. Run across thirsty trees that act as elephant signposts, see insects team up with plants for a chance at life, and get insight into natural chemical warfare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬堤侯連拿博士和海洋哺乳類救援隊趕著拯救被塑料套索困住的一大群海獅;一頭小水獺孤兒被一個新家庭收養.另外,在溫哥華水族館裡,一隻企鵝因一種神秘疾病而病倒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the vet and his team in saving a massive sea lion caught in a plastic noose, and then visit the Rescue Center, where a harbor seal pup may lose its eyesight and a baby sea otter needs a risky but life-saving surgery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 救援隊嘗試救活一頭情況危急的海獺.馬堤博士在海上對抗惡劣的環境,以幫助被纏住的海獅.而在救援中心內,一隻頑皮的小海豹將自己置於險地,一隻瞎眼的鴨子重拾光明.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Battle wind and waves to find a sea lion trapped in a plastic ring. Then visit the rescue center, where over 80 orphan seals must be fed several times a day to prepare for release into the wild, and see an Amazonian duck get a miraculous operation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋哺乳類救援隊幫助迷路的海龜回家.一頭巨大的海獅被發現被十字弓擊中,需要吊車才能將牠帶到救援中心.馬堤博士幫助一隻果蝠應付晚年,還有幫助一隻好鬥的獨眼海豹游向自由.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從內部乾燥的平原上可以看到澳洲最知名的影像,紅色巨石烏盧魯,慵懶地跳躍的紅色袋鼠; 澳洲的干旱中心地帶是巨大又具標誌性的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the vast, dry plains of the interior come some of Australias most recognized imagery, such as the monolithic red rock of Uluru and the bounding red kangaroo. But how did the arid center of the continent come to be?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大狄維亭山脈被巨大的力量所打造,從大陸的中心地帶以一條細長的綠色絲帶分開.從塔斯曼尼亞的冰冷山峰經過1800英里,到達古老的戴恩樹雨林,無數的物種以大狄維亭山脈為家,全都適應地生存,並茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Created by titanic forces and spanning 3,700 km along the eastern edge of Australia, the Great Dividing Range separates two very different worlds. Aerial footage and intimate studies reveal how species survive and thrive in this mountain home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 旅程的最後一站,來到澳洲內陸沙漠與印度洋交匯處,探索一片炙熱的未知之境.跟隨莉茲深入海床,見證虎鯊,魔鬼魚和海龜如何應對生存威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Complete the trips final lap in the untamed lands where Australias interior desert meets the hot, hostile Indian Ocean. Confront the challenges of survival in this region as Lizzie dives with tiger sharks, manta rays, and nomadic turtles.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在繁殖季節中與米克和阿黛爾一起糾纏不清,他們救了一隻被饑餓的蟒蛇威脅的傑克羅素犬.與米克一起在泳池中對抗一條致命的紅腹黑蛇,並與斯圖和莉芙一起在建築工地上處理東部棕蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​準備好進行一場火熱的救援,當丹和傑絲從後院移除交配中的東部棕蛇時,然後屏住呼吸,因為米克在沙發墊裡嗅出了一條高度有毒的蛇.稍後,觀看斯圖拆解一個雞舍以撬出一條地毯蟒蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​前往一個度假村,斯圖和莉芙試圖在度假者面前捕捉一條懷孕的紅腹黑蛇.觀看米克和阿黛爾抓住一條正在追逐雞肉晚餐的花紋監視蜥蜴,然後與傑絲和丹一起捕捉一個滑溜的車庫入侵者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. Watch Mick and Adele nab a lace monitor lizard thats chasing a chicken dinner, then catch a slippery garage intruder with Jess and Dan.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與斯圖和莉芙一起變得一團糟,他們試圖智勝一條大型藍舌蜥蜴.與傑絲和丹一起賽跑,試圖在一條懷孕的蛇變成多條之前救出它,並看看米克和阿黛爾如何將一條蟒蛇遠離兩隻玩耍的小狗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. Race the clock with Jess and Dan as they try to rescue a pregnant snake before one serpent turns into many, and see Mick and Adele keep a python away from two playful puppies.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與阿黛爾和米克展開意志的較量,他們試圖將一條蟒蛇引出排水管.靜候傑絲和丹試圖在一條鰭背蛇放出臭彈之前抓住它,然後與斯圖一起面對隱藏在大學牆壁中的危險蛇類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Engage in a battle of wills with Adele and Mick as they try to coax a python out of a drainpipe. Stand by as Jess and Dan try to grab a keelback snake before it drops a stink bomb, then face a dangerous serpent hidden in a university wall with Stu.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​放鬆一下,觀看米克和阿黛爾在一個養老院中打斷一對交配的東部棕蛇.與斯圖和莉芙一起處理不需要的庫存,他們在倉庫中捕捉到一條綠樹蛇,然後與傑絲和丹一起悄悄接近一位兇險的訪客.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kick back as Mick and Adele break up a pair of mating eastern brown snakes at a retirement home. Take care of unwanted inventory with Stu and Liv, who capture a green tree snake in a warehouse, then sneak up on a killer visitor with Jess and Dan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一旦天氣變冷變黑,昆蟲開始從草地和田地消失,牠們會慢慢消失直至全滅.所有動物都有其特殊的生存方式,像燕子和鶴這種候鳥會飛向南方,許多像鹿一樣的哺乳動物會得到厚厚的冬季皮毛或躲在溫暖的地方冬眠.但昆蟲都做了甚麼?為何牠們在春天就會回歸?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As soon as the days get cold and dark insects begin to disappear from the meadows and fields. Their sum and hum slowly fades away and will finally be gone. All animals have their special ways to survive winter. Migrating birds like swallows and cr...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太恐怖了!這是謀殺!殘酷的死亡以及刺激的戰鬥,還有特殊的絕地救援.你在看到它之後就會知道最令人毛骨悚然的地方其實就是你附近的草叢.利用來自恐怖類型的型格設備,這部非凡的自然紀錄片將帶您跟隨一位著名英雄,牠有六條腿,紅色的翅膀和七個黑點,這趟旅程的目的地是一個看似正常但充滿怪物的草叢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is horror! It is murder! Brutal death as well as exciting fights with an exceptional last-minute rescue. And after seeing it – you will know the creepiest spot is actually the meadow in your neighborhood. With stylistic devices from the horror ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 甲蟲已經在地球上居住了超過2.4億年.科學家們已知的甲蟲大約有38萬種,而每年都會發現數百種新品種.世上四分之一的動物是甲蟲.牠們幾乎征服了地球上每個角落和棲息地,在每次全球災難中都能倖存下來.牠們為何如此成功?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Beetles have inhabited the Earth for more than 240 million years. There are around 380,000 kinds of beetles known to scientists and every year hundreds of new species are discovered. One fourth of the worlds animals are beetles. They have conquer...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 角馬為群體階級而戰,狐獴過著幫派生活,鯖魚在陸上分勝負,蝗蟲在同類相食的瘋狂中放棄素食主義.這一切都發生在南非的野外和開闊的景致中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wildebeest battle for herd hierarchy, meerkats live the thug life, floppy fish fight it out on land and locusts give up their vegetarian ways in a frenzy of cannibalism. It all happens on the wild and wide-open landscape of South Africa.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與蒂姆,當地土著和其他專家一同觀察塑造寧格魯珊瑚礁,開普山脈和埃克斯茅斯灣的自然與人為力量.欣賞有百萬年歷史的珊瑚礁化石,一條巨大的魚和令人震撼的鰩魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe the natural and human forces that have shaped Ningaloo Reef, Cape Range, and Exmouth Gulf with Tim, Traditional Owners, and other experts. Check out a million-year-old fossil reef, a gargantuan fish, and a ray that packs quite a punch.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨科學家和當地土著一起規劃保護寧格魯生物多樣性的生態聯繫,遷徙途徑和物種紐帶.與鯨魚嬉戲,在海藻島之間漂浮,見證考古學家揭穿定居者的神話.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow scientists and Traditional Owners as they map out ecological links, migratory pathways, and interspecies bonds that conserve Ningaloos biodiversity. Frolic with whales, float among seaweed islands, and see archaeologists nix a settler myth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​體驗超越人類能力的動物技能.看看鹹水鱷魚如何利用其壓力敏感的圓頂檢測最微小的動作,發現鴿子的內部GPS系統,並利用第七感與海豚一起檢測獵物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeons internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪卡拉哈里沙漠,跟隨幼獴寶寶學習如何讓蠍子解除武裝,並成為午餐的主菜.到肯亞幫助一隻母獅提升調情策略.見證一對同性企鵝伴侶如何共同養育幼雛,並一起加入由一頭亞洲象創立的保姆俱樂部.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters club.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與軍艦鳥一起出動,跟隨他們從較小的海鳥身上偷取食物;造訪一個為疣豬而設的水療中心,一起放鬆身心;解讀非洲象的秘密信息,然後見證戀愛中的卷尾猴如何以投石來吸引心儀對象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephants secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與美洲虎幼崽弗里達一起探索極限,她正在巴西的凱門保護區磨練自己的生存技能.學習如何與媽媽加圖納一起潛行,看姐姐阿努克幫助她躲避飢餓的入侵者,最後進行一次冒險但幸運的單獨跋涉,.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Test limits with jaguar cub Frida, whos honing her survival skills in Brazils Caiman Lodge Reserve. Learn how to sneak with mum Gatuna, see sister Anouk help her hide from hungry interlopers, and go on a reckless solo trek that takes a lucky turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每一天在非洲都上演為生存而掙扎的戲碼.捕獵者狂歡,而大自然的拾屍者亦在等待牠們的機會.當強者死亡時,一支軍隊來吞噬別人留下的東西,因為牠們也必須養育寶貴的家庭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffes demise becomes a source of life for the regions vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與蒂姆,當地土著和其他專家一同觀察塑造寧格魯珊瑚礁,開普山脈和埃克斯茅斯灣的自然與人為力量.欣賞有百萬年歷史的珊瑚礁化石,一條巨大的魚和令人震撼的鰩魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe the natural and human forces that have shaped Ningaloo Reef, Cape Range, and Exmouth Gulf with Tim, Traditional Owners, and other experts. Check out a million-year-old fossil reef, a gargantuan fish, and a ray that packs quite a punch.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨科學家和當地土著一起規劃保護寧格魯生物多樣性的生態聯繫,遷徙途徑和物種紐帶.與鯨魚嬉戲,在海藻島之間漂浮,見證考古學家揭穿定居者的神話.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow scientists and Traditional Owners as they map out ecological links, migratory pathways, and interspecies bonds that conserve Ningaloos biodiversity. Frolic with whales, float among seaweed islands, and see archaeologists nix a settler myth.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​前往一個度假村,斯圖和莉芙試圖在度假者面前捕捉一條懷孕的紅腹黑蛇.觀看米克和阿黛爾抓住一條正在追逐雞肉晚餐的花紋監視蜥蜴,然後與傑絲和丹一起捕捉一個滑溜的車庫入侵者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. Watch Mick and Adele nab a lace monitor lizard thats chasing a chicken dinner, then catch a slippery garage intruder with Jess and Dan.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與斯圖和莉芙一起變得一團糟,他們試圖智勝一條大型藍舌蜥蜴.與傑絲和丹一起賽跑,試圖在一條懷孕的蛇變成多條之前救出它,並看看米克和阿黛爾如何將一條蟒蛇遠離兩隻玩耍的小狗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. Race the clock with Jess and Dan as they try to rescue a pregnant snake before one serpent turns into many, and see Mick and Adele keep a python away from two playful puppies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪卡拉哈里沙漠,跟隨幼獴寶寶學習如何讓蠍子解除武裝,並成為午餐的主菜.到肯亞幫助一隻母獅提升調情策略.見證一對同性企鵝伴侶如何共同養育幼雛,並一起加入由一頭亞洲象創立的保姆俱樂部.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters club.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The latitudes south of the Sahara offer vastly different battlegrounds for a wide range of warriors. Male giraffes swing their heads like wrecking balls, zebras boast the most powerful kick in the animal kingdom, and chimpanzee warfare is eerily f...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與自然界中最狡猾和堅韌的戰士一起部署生化武器.釋放科莫多龍的毒咬,與獴群一起抵抗有毒的敵人,並觀察鳥類如何使用骨骼粉碎的力量來反擊有毒攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deploy biochemical weaponry with natures most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 樹木主導亞馬遜地區,總數目超過三千億.但是它們每一個都是獨立又蓬勃發展的生態系統.它們是數十種不同動物所組成的繁忙社區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: How many trees can you find in the Amazon? And whats it like to live up in them? Travel through the canopy and see how more than 1200 species of trees coexist. Plus, follow monkeys and other creatures who call these trees home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在亞馬遜森林中,情況可以瞬間從破裂的土地變為氾濫或被樹木淹沒.認識活在這個古老世界的物種必須如何足智多謀和有上進心,才能生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The dry season is the toughest time of year. With lower water levels and less space, animals need to quickly learn new skills to survive...and if they dont, predatory vultures will swoop in for a feast.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看海獅蘿拉在阿根廷海岸的雄性戰場上邁出的第一步.觀察這個海獅寶寶學會了關鍵的發聲和游泳技能,努力留在媽媽瑪麗亞身邊並以迅雷不及掩耳之勢躲過致命捕獵,為她歡呼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch sea lion Lola take her first chaotic steps into a macho battlefield on Argentinas coast. Cheer as this baby learns key vocal and swimming skills, fights to stay by mom Marias side, and makes a lightning-fast escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 牠們的祖先是第一批在乾旱地區殖民的脊椎動物,除南極洲以外,牠們居住在每一個大陸,但牠們的世界正在迅速變化.20個物種稱這個城市為家,但過去的濕地成了遊樂場,高爾夫球場和賽道.這是牠們堅守的土地.世界各地的青蛙數量正在下降,而且時間所剩無幾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the regions species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the citys shrinking wetlands.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與阿黛爾和米克展開意志的較量,他們試圖將一條蟒蛇引出排水管.靜候傑絲和丹試圖在一條鰭背蛇放出臭彈之前抓住它,然後與斯圖一起面對隱藏在大學牆壁中的危險蛇類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Engage in a battle of wills with Adele and Mick as they try to coax a python out of a drainpipe. Stand by as Jess and Dan try to grab a keelback snake before it drops a stink bomb, then face a dangerous serpent hidden in a university wall with Stu.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​放鬆一下,觀看米克和阿黛爾在一個養老院中打斷一對交配的東部棕蛇.與斯圖和莉芙一起處理不需要的庫存,他們在倉庫中捕捉到一條綠樹蛇,然後與傑絲和丹一起悄悄接近一位兇險的訪客.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kick back as Mick and Adele break up a pair of mating eastern brown snakes at a retirement home. Take care of unwanted inventory with Stu and Liv, who capture a green tree snake in a warehouse, then sneak up on a killer visitor with Jess and Dan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 樹木主導亞馬遜地區,總數目超過三千億.但是它們每一個都是獨立又蓬勃發展的生態系統.它們是數十種不同動物所組成的繁忙社區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: How many trees can you find in the Amazon? And whats it like to live up in them? Travel through the canopy and see how more than 1200 species of trees coexist. Plus, follow monkeys and other creatures who call these trees home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在亞馬遜森林中,情況可以瞬間從破裂的土地變為氾濫或被樹木淹沒.認識活在這個古老世界的物種必須如何足智多謀和有上進心,才能生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The dry season is the toughest time of year. With lower water levels and less space, animals need to quickly learn new skills to survive...and if they dont, predatory vultures will swoop in for a feast.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看海獅蘿拉在阿根廷海岸的雄性戰場上邁出的第一步.觀察這個海獅寶寶學會了關鍵的發聲和游泳技能,努力留在媽媽瑪麗亞身邊並以迅雷不及掩耳之勢躲過致命捕獵,為她歡呼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch sea lion Lola take her first chaotic steps into a macho battlefield on Argentinas coast. Cheer as this baby learns key vocal and swimming skills, fights to stay by mom Marias side, and makes a lightning-fast escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 牠們的祖先是第一批在乾旱地區殖民的脊椎動物,除南極洲以外,牠們居住在每一個大陸,但牠們的世界正在迅速變化.20個物種稱這個城市為家,但過去的濕地成了遊樂場,高爾夫球場和賽道.這是牠們堅守的土地.世界各地的青蛙數量正在下降,而且時間所剩無幾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the regions species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the citys shrinking wetlands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪卡拉哈里沙漠,跟隨幼獴寶寶學習如何讓蠍子解除武裝,並成為午餐的主菜.到肯亞幫助一隻母獅提升調情策略.見證一對同性企鵝伴侶如何共同養育幼雛,並一起加入由一頭亞洲象創立的保姆俱樂部.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters club.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與軍艦鳥一起出動,跟隨他們從較小的海鳥身上偷取食物;造訪一個為疣豬而設的水療中心,一起放鬆身心;解讀非洲象的秘密信息,然後見證戀愛中的卷尾猴如何以投石來吸引心儀對象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephants secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與自然界中最狡猾和堅韌的戰士一起部署生化武器.釋放科莫多龍的毒咬,與獴群一起抵抗有毒的敵人,並觀察鳥類如何使用骨骼粉碎的力量來反擊有毒攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deploy biochemical weaponry with natures most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Darwin is the capital of Australia’s Northern Territory and a former frontier outpost. It’s also a gateway to the massive Kakadu National Park. If balmy nights, colourful characters and outdoor adventures are on your bucket list, you’ll want to visit Darwin – just like our All Stars!

This area also boasts some of the world’s best walking tracks, taking in coastal forest, coves, inlets, and spectacular skyline ridges. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Brisbane, capital of Queensland, is a large city on the Brisbane River. This stunning sunshine capital has no shortage of bucket list items, and our All Stars certainly ticked off a few. During this trip we also got to experience Brisbane’s backyard, with Moreton Bay’s tropical islands on the city’s doorstep, including beautiful North Stradbroke. Add to this a dynamic cultural precinct, abundant wildlife and easy access adventure destinations like the Gold Coast and Great Barrier Reef, and you’ve got a destination you can’t say no to.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Brisbane, capital of Queensland, is a large city on the Brisbane River. This stunning sunshine capital has no shortage of bucket list items, and our All Stars certainly ticked off a few. During this trip we also got to experience Brisbane’s backyard, with Moreton Bay’s tropical islands on the city’s doorstep, including beautiful North Stradbroke. Add to this a dynamic cultural precinct, abundant wildlife and easy access adventure destinations like the Gold Coast and Great Barrier Reef, and you’ve got a destination you can’t say no to.

Has a coastline ever been better named?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Clare Valley is located in South Australia about 100 kilometres north of Adelaide. We asked our All Stars to “find the magic”, and in this episode they certainly did!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Margaret River is a small town south of Perth in western Australia, known for its wineries, beaches migratory whales and coastal adventures. Stretching between 2 lighthouses north and south of the town, the region fringes the limestone caves and sea cliffs of Leeuwin-Naturaliste National Park. For over 50,000 years the Margaret River Region has supported one of the world’s longest, unbroken human occupations, resulting in an immensely deep connection to the land. Natural beauty, abundance of space, fine wine and fresh coastal air make this episode a must-watch.

Natural beauty, abundance of space, fine wine and fresh coastal air make this episode a must-watch.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like.  Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme.  There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells.  A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole.  Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security.  Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners. So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally.  Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release.  For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold. Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Tigris River, which was the site of the ancient civilization of Mesopotamia, still flows majestically through Baghdad, Iraq's capital. In March2003, the area around this river underwent intense airstrikes by U.S. and British forces. The U.S. armed forces gained control of Baghdad. Journalist Watai Takeharu witnessed the moment when the bronze statue of then-president Saddam Hussein was pulled down. The next day he saw many victims of the airstrikes at a city hospital. There he met 31-year-old Ali Saqban, whose home had been destroyed in the bombing. In his arms he was carrying his 5-year-old daughter Shahad, whose body was covered with blood.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Police brutality against marginalised communities is not isolated to American shores. In 2015, David Dungay Jr., an Aboriginal Australian, died in police custody. The coroner later found a “lack of oxygen while he was restrained as a contributing factor to his death”, drawing disturbing parallels with the death of George Floyd in May this year. Stan Grant, himself of Aboriginal heritage, feels a kinship across the continents. “When I see black America, I see part of myself. When I was growing up black America spoke to me when white Australia did not.” For those who believe race is no longer an issue that needs discussion, he has a simple message. “Why do we still talk about racism? Because it still exists. Because it is there. Because it can touch my life at any time.”

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troubles.Real people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life.
From money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like.  Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme.  There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells.  A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole.  Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security.  Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners. So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally.  Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release.  For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold. Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

epg.programme_title_en: Late Night With Seth Meyers S13 # 107
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞斯梅耶斯深夜秀由艾美獎得主洛恩米高斯監製,邀請一線紅星作嘉賓,還有難忘的喜劇和最棒的音樂人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Late Night with Seth Meyers is executive produced by the Emmy Award-winning Lorne Michaels and is home to A-list celebrity guests, memorable comedy and the best in musical talent.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 倖存者在敗仗後努力重整旗鼓.約翰在荒涼的阿萊里亞星面臨前所未有的損失.索倫和萊華尋找失蹤的兒子.仲裁者開始失去耐性,麥基要步步為營.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the aftermath of defeat, the survivors struggle to pick up the pieces. On the desolate planet of Aleria, John grapples with an unprecedented loss. Soren and Laera search for their missing son. Makee treads carefully as the Arbiter grows impatient.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 約翰向一個秘密聯合國太空指揮部海軍情報星球復仇.皮里斯受訓成為一名新型士兵.凱發現自己夾在斯巴達準則和士官長的忠誠之間.麥基向可塔娜求助來尋找光環.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: John seeks revenge on a secret ONI planet. Perez trains to become a new kind of soldier. Kai finds herself torn between her Spartan code and her loyalty to Master Chief. Makee turns to Cortana for help in her search for the Halo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 約翰-117與麥基正面交鋒.被揭露的訊息讓厄克森臣質疑他的忠誠.索倫和萊華的關係開始破裂.哈爾茜,關和米蘭達合作解開一個謎團.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: John-117 comes face to face with Makee. A revelation leads Ackerson to question his loyalties. Soren and Laera’s relationship begins to fracture. Halsey, Kwan and Miranda work to solve a mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 高潮迭起爭奪光環的戰事正式展開.約翰做出一個決定命運的選擇.索倫和關執行一場救援任務.哈爾茜和米蘭達釋放出一個古老的恐怖.季度大結局.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The climactic battle for the Halo begins. John makes a fateful choice. Soren and Kwan undertake a rescue mission. Halsey and Miranda unleash an ancient horror. Season finale.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三隻會唱流行歌的花栗鼠--艾爾文,賽門與喜多,徹底將一位落魄詞曲創作者的生活搞得天翻地覆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pop-singer Chipmunks Alvin, Simon and Theodore turn a songwriters life upside-down.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 8位網紅在3個級數的廚房對壘爭奪大獎.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eight social media stars battle it out on three kitchen levels for a chance at the grand prize.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海選仍然繼續,家庭的大廚們搶奪夢寐以求的5個名額之一,從而進入導師團選學員階段.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The auditions continue as the home cooks fight for one of the coveted five spots that advances them to the mentorship team draught.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 試鏡結束後,專業廚師們搶奪夢寐以求的5個名額之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The auditions conclude as the professional chefs battle for one of the coveted five spots.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 排名前15名的廚師被選入3支隊伍;參賽者必須準備全美式碎肉餅漢堡來證明他們的烹飪能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The top 15 chefs are drafted into their three teams; the contestants must prepare an all-American smash burger that proves their cooking abilities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剩下的14位廚師被指派在30分鐘內準備一道震撼的咖哩菜式;獲勝的菜式使整隊獲得豁免,並在下次挑戰中獲得高級廚房.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The 14 remaining chefs are tasked with preparing a curry dish that promises to pack a punch with only 30 minutes on the clock; the winning dish gives the entire team immunity and claims the top-level kitchen for the next challenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剩下的13位廚師在準備一道受熱帶島嶼美食啟發的海鮮菜式時,展現了他們的度假氛圍;獲勝的菜式使整隊獲得豁免,並在下次挑戰中獲得高級廚房.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The 13 remaining chefs channel their vacation vibes when theyre tasked with preparing a seafood dish inspired by tropical island cuisine; the winning dish gives the entire team immunity and claims the top-level kitchen for the next challenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廚師們被委派準備更高層次的國際街頭美食;在整個挑戰過程中,平台都會不斷移動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The chefs are tasked with preparing a next-level international street food dish; the platform never stops moving throughout the challenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剩下的廚師在各自的團隊中庖丁解牛,以製作鐵板牛扒菜式;2名參賽者在進入激烈的海鮮鬥地煮時面臨淘汰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The remaining chefs butcher and break down various cuts of beef amongst their teams to create sizzling steak dishes; two contestants face elimination as they enter a heated seafood cook-off.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剩下的10名參賽者踏入廚房,只為將傳統薄餅提升為更高層次的傑作;獲勝的薄餅使整隊獲得豁免,並可以使用高級廚房.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The 10 remaining contestants step into the kitchen with the goal of elevating the traditional pizza into a next-level masterpiece; the winning pizza gains immunity for the whole team and claims the top-level kitchen spot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廚師們使用平台上的大量新鮮食材,準備最好的希臘主菜,為他們的團隊贏得豁免權.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using a bounty of fresh ingredients from the platform, the chef who prepares the best Greek entrée wins immunity for their team.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剩下的8名大廚必須分組合作,製作出一頓環環緊扣的3道菜大餐;距離比賽只剩 30 分鐘,獲勝的菜單確保隊伍免被淘汰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The eight remaining competitors must work together in teams to create a cohesive three-course meal; with only 30 minutes on the clock, the team with the winning menu remains safe from elimination.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剩下的7位廚師各自為便當製作受日本啟發的菜式; 1名評審在淘汰賽中負責監督廚師,而2名評審則負責盲測他們的作品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The seven remaining chefs work individually to create Japanese-inspired dishes for their bento boxes; one judge oversees the chefs during the elimination challenge, while two judges blindly taste test their creations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剩下的6名廚師被委派僅利用參考照片的記憶來重新製作一道完美地用來打卡的菜式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The six remaining chefs are tasked with recreating a picture perfect dish using just the memory of a reference photo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 最後5名廚師必須使用一種名為康普茶的發酵飲料製作一道菜式;2名廚師爭奪準決賽一席位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The final five chefs must create a dish using a fermented drink called kombucha; two chefs battle for a spot in the semifinals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 最後4名廚師在準決賽面臨激烈的轉折,他們被委派展示一種經典的味覺元素.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the semi-finals, the final four chefs face a tangy twist as theyre tasked with showcasing one of the classic taste elements.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 最後4名廚師在準決賽面臨激烈的轉折,他們被委派展示一種經典的味覺元素.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the semi-finals, the final four chefs face a tangy twist as theyre tasked with showcasing one of the classic taste elements.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 最後3強廚師爭分奪秒製作出美味的3道菜大餐;只有1位廚師終登上寶座並贏得大獎.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The final three chefs race against the clock to craft a sensational three-course meal; one chef rises to the top and wins the grand prize.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 8位網紅大廚展開競賽.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eight social media chefs kick off the competition.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海選迎來下一組參賽者,家庭主廚各顯神通.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The auditions continue with the next group to show off their culinary skills - the home cooks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海選最後一回合,8位專業大廚必須讓評審驚豔,從而擠身下回合.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its the final round of auditions, where eight professional chefs must impress the judges in order to advance to the next stage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被認可的15 位大廚跟導師配對,並接受他們的首個團隊挑戰;每位大廚必須創造一道令人難以置信的意大利菜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The 15 chefs who qualified for the draft are matched with their mentors and are given their first team challenge; each chef must create an incredible Italian dish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大廚們各顯神通烹製出最美味的燒烤盛宴;兩位大廚在淘汰環節正面交鋒,用椰菜花烹製一道高級菜餚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The chefs battle it out to make the best barbecue feast; in the elimination round, two chefs go head-to-head and make an elevated dish using cauliflower.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 導師們向大廚們發起挑戰,讓他們製作出最令人印象深刻的拉麵菜式,但他們要在整個過程中於一個快速上下移動的平台進行挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The mentors challenge the chefs to make the most impressive ramen dish while reaching from a fast moving platform that moves up and down each level throughout the entire challenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在幾位驚喜的幫廚協助下,大廚們齊心協力烹製出一頓五道菜大餐.為了成功完成這項挑戰,大廚們必須依靠彼此的烹飪和溝通技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The chefs work together to create a cohesive five-course meal, with the help of a few surprise sous chefs. To succeed in this challenge, the chefs must count on one anothers culinary and communication skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 餘下的大廚們被委派去烤,蒸或炸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The remaining chefs are tasked with oven roasting, steaming or deep frying.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大廚們在比賽中首次不再團隊合作,而是獨力完成下一個烹飪挑戰並生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For the first time in the competition, the chefs are no longer working on teams and must survive the next cooking challenge on their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 餘下的大廚們被委派烹煮揉合南方風味和法國特色的卡津菜;創造出最佳菜餚的大廚將獲得令人垂涎的時間代幣,那會為他們在下次挑戰中帶來巨大優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The remaining chefs are tasked with cooking Cajun dishes that blend southern flare with French influence; the chef who creates the best dish receives a coveted time token that gives them a major advantage in the next challenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大廚們嘗試西班牙美食,從小食開始,到中場墜落平台,導致經典搭配;三位大廚在淘汰賽中繼續準備他們的西班牙菜,送上色彩鮮豔的西班牙海鮮飯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The chefs experiment with Spanish cuisine, starting with tapas and a mid-round platform drop resulting in a classic pairing; in the elimination round, three chefs carry on their Spanish preparations, serving up vibrant plates of paella.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 最後六名廚師必須烹煮帶骨的蛋白質,在緊絀的時間下可算是個壯舉;兩位廚師在淘汰賽中決一死戰,他們有一群魚可供選擇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The final six chefs must cook protein with the bone in, which is no small feat in the essence of time; two chefs fight to the finish in the elimination round, where they are presented with a formation of fish to choose from.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 餘下五位廚師的任務是反傳統菜式:重現哥頓藍斯的招牌惠靈頓牛排,但不能有牛肉;兩名廚師免遭淘汰,其餘三名廚師進行最後一場對決.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The five remaining chefs are tasked with putting a twist on a classic: recreating Gordon Ramsays signature beef Wellington without beef; two chefs are safe from elimination, while the remaining three chefs battle it out one last time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 最後三強廚師必須在90分鐘時限內炮製出一頓出色的三道菜餐單.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The final three chefs must create an outstanding three-course meal in just 90 minutes.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eight social media chefs kick off the competition.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海選迎來下一組參賽者,家庭主廚各顯神通.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The auditions continue with the next group to show off their culinary skills - the home cooks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海選最後一回合,8位專業大廚必須讓評審驚豔,從而擠身下回合.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its the final round of auditions, where eight professional chefs must impress the judges in order to advance to the next stage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被認可的15 位大廚跟導師配對,並接受他們的首個團隊挑戰;每位大廚必須創造一道令人難以置信的意大利菜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The 15 chefs who qualified for the draft are matched with their mentors and are given their first team challenge; each chef must create an incredible Italian dish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大廚們各顯神通烹製出最美味的燒烤盛宴;兩位大廚在淘汰環節正面交鋒,用椰菜花烹製一道高級菜餚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The chefs battle it out to make the best barbecue feast; in the elimination round, two chefs go head-to-head and make an elevated dish using cauliflower.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 導師們向大廚們發起挑戰,讓他們製作出最令人印象深刻的拉麵菜式,但他們要在整個過程中於一個快速上下移動的平台進行挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The mentors challenge the chefs to make the most impressive ramen dish while reaching from a fast moving platform that moves up and down each level throughout the entire challenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在幾位驚喜的幫廚協助下,大廚們齊心協力烹製出一頓五道菜大餐.為了成功完成這項挑戰,大廚們必須依靠彼此的烹飪和溝通技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The chefs work together to create a cohesive five-course meal, with the help of a few surprise sous chefs. To succeed in this challenge, the chefs must count on one anothers culinary and communication skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 餘下的大廚們被委派去烤,蒸或炸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The remaining chefs are tasked with oven roasting, steaming or deep frying.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大廚們在比賽中首次不再團隊合作,而是獨力完成下一個烹飪挑戰並生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For the first time in the competition, the chefs are no longer working on teams and must survive the next cooking challenge on their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 餘下的大廚們被委派烹煮揉合南方風味和法國特色的卡津菜;創造出最佳菜餚的大廚將獲得令人垂涎的時間代幣,那會為他們在下次挑戰中帶來巨大優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The remaining chefs are tasked with cooking Cajun dishes that blend southern flare with French influence; the chef who creates the best dish receives a coveted time token that gives them a major advantage in the next challenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大廚們嘗試西班牙美食,從小食開始,到中場墜落平台,導致經典搭配;三位大廚在淘汰賽中繼續準備他們的西班牙菜,送上色彩鮮豔的西班牙海鮮飯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The chefs experiment with Spanish cuisine, starting with tapas and a mid-round platform drop resulting in a classic pairing; in the elimination round, three chefs carry on their Spanish preparations, serving up vibrant plates of paella.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 最後六名廚師必須烹煮帶骨的蛋白質,在緊絀的時間下可算是個壯舉;兩位廚師在淘汰賽中決一死戰,他們有一群魚可供選擇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The final six chefs must cook protein with the bone in, which is no small feat in the essence of time; two chefs fight to the finish in the elimination round, where they are presented with a formation of fish to choose from.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 餘下五位廚師的任務是反傳統菜式:重現哥頓藍斯的招牌惠靈頓牛排,但不能有牛肉;兩名廚師免遭淘汰,其餘三名廚師進行最後一場對決.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The five remaining chefs are tasked with putting a twist on a classic: recreating Gordon Ramsays signature beef Wellington without beef; two chefs are safe from elimination, while the remaining three chefs battle it out one last time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 最後三強廚師必須在90分鐘時限內炮製出一頓出色的三道菜餐單.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The final three chefs must create an outstanding three-course meal in just 90 minutes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 8位網紅在3個級數的廚房對壘爭奪大獎.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eight social media stars battle it out on three kitchen levels for a chance at the grand prize.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海選仍然繼續,家庭的大廚們搶奪夢寐以求的5個名額之一,從而進入導師團選學員階段.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The auditions continue as the home cooks fight for one of the coveted five spots that advances them to the mentorship team draught.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 試鏡結束後,專業廚師們搶奪夢寐以求的5個名額之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The auditions conclude as the professional chefs battle for one of the coveted five spots.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 排名前15名的廚師被選入3支隊伍;參賽者必須準備全美式碎肉餅漢堡來證明他們的烹飪能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The top 15 chefs are drafted into their three teams; the contestants must prepare an all-American smash burger that proves their cooking abilities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剩下的14位廚師被指派在30分鐘內準備一道震撼的咖哩菜式;獲勝的菜式使整隊獲得豁免,並在下次挑戰中獲得高級廚房.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The 14 remaining chefs are tasked with preparing a curry dish that promises to pack a punch with only 30 minutes on the clock; the winning dish gives the entire team immunity and claims the top-level kitchen for the next challenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剩下的13位廚師在準備一道受熱帶島嶼美食啟發的海鮮菜式時,展現了他們的度假氛圍;獲勝的菜式使整隊獲得豁免,並在下次挑戰中獲得高級廚房.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The 13 remaining chefs channel their vacation vibes when theyre tasked with preparing a seafood dish inspired by tropical island cuisine; the winning dish gives the entire team immunity and claims the top-level kitchen for the next challenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廚師們被委派準備更高層次的國際街頭美食;在整個挑戰過程中,平台都會不斷移動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The chefs are tasked with preparing a next-level international street food dish; the platform never stops moving throughout the challenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剩下的廚師在各自的團隊中庖丁解牛,以製作鐵板牛扒菜式;2名參賽者在進入激烈的海鮮鬥地煮時面臨淘汰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The remaining chefs butcher and break down various cuts of beef amongst their teams to create sizzling steak dishes; two contestants face elimination as they enter a heated seafood cook-off.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剩下的10名參賽者踏入廚房,只為將傳統薄餅提升為更高層次的傑作;獲勝的薄餅使整隊獲得豁免,並可以使用高級廚房.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The 10 remaining contestants step into the kitchen with the goal of elevating the traditional pizza into a next-level masterpiece; the winning pizza gains immunity for the whole team and claims the top-level kitchen spot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廚師們使用平台上的大量新鮮食材,準備最好的希臘主菜,為他們的團隊贏得豁免權.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using a bounty of fresh ingredients from the platform, the chef who prepares the best Greek entrée wins immunity for their team.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剩下的8名大廚必須分組合作,製作出一頓環環緊扣的3道菜大餐;距離比賽只剩 30 分鐘,獲勝的菜單確保隊伍免被淘汰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The eight remaining competitors must work together in teams to create a cohesive three-course meal; with only 30 minutes on the clock, the team with the winning menu remains safe from elimination.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剩下的7位廚師各自為便當製作受日本啟發的菜式; 1名評審在淘汰賽中負責監督廚師,而2名評審則負責盲測他們的作品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The seven remaining chefs work individually to create Japanese-inspired dishes for their bento boxes; one judge oversees the chefs during the elimination challenge, while two judges blindly taste test their creations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剩下的6名廚師被委派僅利用參考照片的記憶來重新製作一道完美地用來打卡的菜式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The six remaining chefs are tasked with recreating a picture perfect dish using just the memory of a reference photo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 最後5名廚師必須使用一種名為康普茶的發酵飲料製作一道菜式;2名廚師爭奪準決賽一席位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The final five chefs must create a dish using a fermented drink called kombucha; two chefs battle for a spot in the semifinals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 最後4名廚師在準決賽面臨激烈的轉折,他們被委派展示一種經典的味覺元素.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the semi-finals, the final four chefs face a tangy twist as theyre tasked with showcasing one of the classic taste elements.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 最後3強廚師爭分奪秒製作出美味的3道菜大餐;只有1位廚師終登上寶座並贏得大獎.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The final three chefs race against the clock to craft a sensational three-course meal; one chef rises to the top and wins the grand prize.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: John-117 comes face to face with Makee. A revelation leads Ackerson to question his loyalties. Soren and Laera’s relationship begins to fracture. Halsey, Kwan and Miranda work to solve a mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 高潮迭起爭奪光環的戰事正式展開.約翰做出一個決定命運的選擇.索倫和關執行一場救援任務.哈爾茜和米蘭達釋放出一個古老的恐怖.季度大結局.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The climactic battle for the Halo begins. John makes a fateful choice. Soren and Kwan undertake a rescue mission. Halsey and Miranda unleash an ancient horror. Season finale.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Considered the most beautiful debutante of the 1930s, heiress Margaret Sweeny (Claire Foy) is in the midst of a divorce when she meets the dashing - and married - Ian Campbell, future Duke of Argyll (Paul Bettany).

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪格麗特拋開對婚姻痛苦的疑慮,繼續她那確保成為因弗雷里城堡女主人的計劃.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Putting aside gnawing doubts about her marriage, Margaret continues with her plan to secure her claim to Inveraray Castle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!
They are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In Essex Animal Collection officer Joe White's on his way to pick up a dog that's been left abandoned and tethered to the edge of a bridge. Last year the charity received over 63,000 reports of abandoned animals, and nearly half of those were dogs. When Joe arrives in Harlow, the lady who found the dog has moved him to a place of safety and is waiting with a couple of concerned neighbours. With his bones clearly visible through his already skinny frame, the poor dog is worryingly thin. But a lack of food isn't all that's wrong, there are scars on his face and body that suggest he's been through a hard youth. To try and piece together the dog's history Joe needs all the information he can gather.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In the UK nearly a quarter of the adult population have made a dog part of their family. But there are some reports RSPCA inspectors respond to that have them thinking otherwise, and in Staffordshire Inspector Charlotte Melvin is left reeling from the shock of what she finds when she investigates one such case. She receives a complaint about a house full of animals, some in cages and living in cramped and dirty conditions. When she arrived things looked so bad that Charlotte calls the police who help her gain access to the property. Inside there's a menagerie of different creatures, from a fox to a snake, to a lizard, all suffering in totally unsuitable quarters. Two of the worst affected are dogs Mocha and Lexi. Mocha has extreme hair loss. As well as having the same terrible skin problems as Mocha, Lexi is also severely emaciated. Charlotte must act fast to help all the animals to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Comedian Alan Davies is acting vet's assistant at Harmsworth animal hospital in London. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在1923年的橫濱,年輕的漢水捲入一場即將改變一切的嚴重慘劇.

epg.episode_synopsis_en:
Creating a brand-new interactive ATM that combined with puzzle solving and daily life! Guests can win money by taking three rounds of intellectual challenges from the ATM, turn wisdom into money!
Futuristic program scenes with video game clearing concept, where challengers engage in the intellectual competition to switch on the ATM. Those who won goes to the ultimate challenge. Host Hu Gua, co-host Sandra and the elite challengers will stay together, built up a whole new competition between technology and wisdom!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The reality variety show Actors On The Tour, guided by hosts Allison Lin and Fandy Fan , will invite an actor to travel alongside them. Creating a brand-new interactive ATM that combined with puzzle solving and daily life! Guests can win money by taking three rounds of intellectual challenges from the ATM, turn wisdom into money!

epg.programme_title_en: Forthright Securities Presents:Inside The Stock Exchange[Can]

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 慶竟收朱莉亞作契女，要朋收朱莉亞為徒，但朋拒收。朱莉亞不捨不棄，報讀所有課程希望能學東坡肉的製法。皇天不負有心人，朋終在激將法下教茱煮此菜，但想不到茱在嘗過朋的手藝後，卻說朋的東坡肉不是真正的東坡肉。

epg.programme_title_tc: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#10[粵/普][PG]
epg.programme_title_en: The Legend of Heroes - Hot Blooded#10[Can/Man][PG]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 郭靖和楊康路上獲周全照料，直到郭靖嘗到叫花雞才知是黃蓉的安排…寶應縣出現採花賊強搶女子，郭靖和黃蓉起初誤會是丐幫叛徒的所為，搞清楚後與丐幫合作捉拿真正採花賊歐陽克，可惜被識破，危急關頭幸得洪七公趕至…

epg.programme_title_tc: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: Forthright Securities Presents:Inside The Stock Exchange[Can]

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 石九公鮮甜，肥媽配上番茄薯仔煲湯，如何逼出鮮魚的獨有精華？將豆腐、蝦、雞蛋、芝士、麵包糠拌勻，搓成球狀，炸熟後就煮成一道外脆內軟的「豆腐蝦丸」，何其容易！還有「芝麻香煎龍脷柳」及「南瓜豆豉辣椒排骨」。

epg.programme_title_tc: 才駿HASHTAG  AI 點只科技股[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: Elite HASHTAG AI Isn't Just Tech Stocks[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《才駿HASHTAG》匯聚各界精英，每周與您分享名家視角、更新市場焦點熱話。

糖尿病發展非一朝一夕，患者會經歷「糖尿病前期」階段，內分泌及糖尿科醫生細說相關資訊與警號，還提到不一定只發生在嗜甜者身上。不過，透過篩檢及早發現，改善生活方式，「前期」仍有降低演變為二型糖尿病的機會。大王、菲比隨大廚葉世昌外出「搵食」，注入福建做法的佛跳牆，實情有何不同？用玫瑰岩鹽焗出的脆皮雞，也別具特色，結尾還有一個「追月大煎堆」，氣勢十足。轉往「睇餸食飯」的廚房，有三姐炮製「子薑馬蹄生煎雞」。

珠海有不少拍照熱點，不想隨波逐流，可花數百元人民幣坐上直升機在高空打卡！落地就品嚐一人一鍋老北京涮羊肉，環境卻是年輕化裝潢，並一試被指是全世界最臭的腐乳，超怡卻不覺一回事？由福田乘深圳地鐵搭兩個站，走進大型商場吃蘭州牛肉麵，八款麵條粗幼度任揀，最重要牛骨湯底夠濃味。繼續為港人尋求飲食着數，車胎人推介的名人飯堂午餐，八道餸人均不需二百元！又到官涌隱世小店去吃工序複雜的公主雞，雞件下面還有香噴噴炒飯。

epg.programme_title_tc: 才駿HASHTAG  AI 點只科技股[粵]

風小子說麵包比大碗飯好。大碗飯三人組對此感到不滿，決定要讓風小子吃好味的大碗飯，令他改觀。細菌人偷聽到果Jam叔叔他們將要前往冰之國觀賞極光，於是搶先一步到冰之國搗亂。

糖尿病發展非一朝一夕，患者會經歷「糖尿病前期」階段，內分泌及糖尿科醫生細說相關資訊與警號，還提到不一定只發生在嗜甜者身上。不過，透過篩檢及早發現，改善生活方式，「前期」仍有降低演變為二型糖尿病的機會。大王、菲比隨大廚葉世昌外出「搵食」，注入福建做法的佛跳牆，實情有何不同？用玫瑰岩鹽焗出的脆皮雞，也別具特色，結尾還有一個「追月大煎堆」，氣勢十足。轉往「睇餸食飯」的廚房，有三姐炮製「子薑馬蹄生煎雞」。

慶竟收朱莉亞作契女，要朋收朱莉亞為徒，但朋拒收。朱莉亞不捨不棄，報讀所有課程希望能學東坡肉的製法。皇天不負有心人，朋終在激將法下教茱煮此菜，但想不到茱在嘗過朋的手藝後，卻說朋的東坡肉不是真正的東坡肉。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 香港人食無定時，熱氣、食慾不振自然在所難免。肥媽出動苦瓜湯，打救六號響起警鐘的身體。「薯仔免治牛肉」想將薯仔、牛肉煮到粒粒分明，秘訣何在？「白焯魚柳」、「合掌瓜白胡椒燜雞」同樣毋需花巧的廚藝。
整容高風險？整形外科醫生解答疑惑。在香港，最常見的整容手術包括雙眼皮、抽脂、隆胸，醫生逐一細說詳情，以及連帶的風險與併發症。而揀選專業的醫生施手術，極為重要！左心室將含氧血液泵往各器官，如力量不足，會有重大影響！醫治相關狀況有「四大支柱」藥物，各有甚麼效用？心臟科醫生提到，臨床還有機會要增加新藥物，從而減低病人心臟衰竭，甚至死亡的風險。「睇餸食飯」環節，許美德師傅烹調一道時令美食「薄殼米炒飯」。

秀怡駕駛，接載凱晴、超怡「港車北上」，並約同慧儀入住珠海的五星級酒店，望着港珠澳大橋於泳池嬉水，價格還包括早、晚自助餐！溫體牛由屠宰到上桌時間迅速，讓顧客食出肉材鮮味，價錢一定離地？跟主持往深圳火鍋店吃，鮮嫩得來花費亦化算。吃完再到超市搜購肉食，切記生肉不許帶過境。港島某雞蛋仔店製作用心，更推出加一蚊多一底優惠？另有精品朱古力飲買一送一着數。眾人還到網紅餐廳一試人均近千元的四人餐，最終三三折埋單？

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天和暖令小丸子老是賴床，小丸子打聽有何方法令自己順利起床，並發現花輪教的播音樂方法十分有效。小丸子重新開始集郵，獲高丸太太贈送一袋外國郵票，誰知卻在裡面發現一張印刷歪斜的版票。

錄影廠內擺放着兩件「蛋糕」，原來是由「Kids’ Notes」嘉賓以韓式唧花技術所製的蛋糕造型擺設，箇中技巧與製作翻糖公仔款蛋糕，有何分別？嘉賓亦即席以韓式唧花技術，快速完成一朵玫瑰。對於初學者，可先用忌廉嘗試，但原來這門手藝經過十幾年發展，豆蓉、朱古力、輕黏土、棉花糖都可以放入唧袋內做出不同作品。不過，每種「材料」的質地不一，部份未必能做出細緻花型。嘉賓也憶述學藝與教學點滴，並談及最喜愛的作品。
沙律公主偷走出城堡外，西洋菜爺爺急忙尋找。苦瓜人遇上正在著急的西洋菜爺爺，於是自動請纓幫忙尋找沙律公主。細菌人偷聽到果Jam叔叔將會前往沙漠小鎮派麵包，於是企圖搶奪果Jam叔叔的麵包。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉驄承繼父親的物業，每月收取豐厚租金，還改建名下一物業單位，與友人合辦共享空間「開心小棧」，理應經濟充裕。嘉冰着嘉驄出資打造金器送贈親戚，嘉驄卻諸多推搪。嘉冰向唐芯問及「開心小棧」的經營狀況，察覺不妥，遂暗中監察嘉驄，竟有重大發現，懷疑他花天酒地、為女人大灑金錢，於是與唐芯設法「拯救」嘉驄，卻揭開不為人知的真相。嘉冰欲為嘉驄出頭追討損失，卻不果，幸而萬里、唐芯動員人脈，合力為嘉驄解困……

epg.programme_title_tc: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#13[粵][PG]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啟榮欲剔除家謙的計劃失敗。幸如因熙妍醉言醉語，得悉家謙結婚在即；家謙獨自借酒消愁。苓君高調公開家謙、曉彤婚訊，二人在人前表面恩愛，家謙在人後亦向曉彤表示會為二人關係努力。隨着婚訊公開，家謙、熙妍的身分亦曝光……繼威為協助其昌的私幫生意賺快錢，不惜利用雪文。雪文繼續主動討好佩貞，又登堂入室宣示主權……幸如好意協助運送繼威一組遺下的道具到拍攝現場，到達後卻見氣氛有異，懷疑繼威打算在此向她求婚。
寄舟替蜜語解圍，之後蜜語喝醉，寄舟抱她到自己房間，被酒店其他人看到，引發軒然大波，集體投訴舉報她影響公司聲譽，最後紀封和寄舟把事件給解決；浦菜中菜廳選用中式下午茶為招?，找來蜜語媽媽製作蘇式船點

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊走智利聖地牙哥，芷珮先往百年市集歎帝王蟹，再試試老字號餡餅滋味。復活節島是一座神秘火山島，以摩艾石像聞名。芷珮踏足「工場」遺址，探秘昔日原住民如何利用火山岩製作石像，還可看到逾三百個完成度不一的石像，好壯觀！島上各處隱藏着大大小小的石像，一於踏單車環島遊覽摩艾文化與自然風光。捕捉日落美景後，走進歌舞餐廳跟原住民共舞。想帶走石像做手信，都有雕刻與倒模款式之分？融入天然水果的石像型肥皂，也值得入手。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 定垚答應投資程凱公司，承諾不會催促進度，程凱喜上眉梢。啟堂懷疑大嶼山項目的環評報告有蹊蹺，找人調查，天生早一步解決，啟堂氣結。程凱遲遲未能遞交智能家居進度，定垚設計刺激程凱，讓他乖乖趕工。澤雨認識了來自香港的甘日朗與謝安東，二人計劃建立烹飪平台，澤雨決定投資，想不到合作的網紅竟然是端兒。在活動上，兆齊口不擇言，戲說天生與明晞無子送終。明晞回家後哭崩，問天生信不信報應？
《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。
整容高風險？整形外科醫生解答疑惑。在香港，最常見的整容手術包括雙眼皮、抽脂、隆胸，醫生逐一細說詳情，以及連帶的風險與併發症。而揀選專業的醫生施手術，極為重要！左心室將含氧血液泵往各器官，如力量不足，會有重大影響！醫治相關狀況有「四大支柱」藥物，各有甚麼效用？心臟科醫生提到，臨床還有機會要增加新藥物，從而減低病人心臟衰竭，甚至死亡的風險。「睇餸食飯」環節，許美德師傅烹調一道時令美食「薄殼米炒飯」。

秀怡駕駛，接載凱晴、超怡「港車北上」，並約同慧儀入住珠海的五星級酒店，望着港珠澳大橋於泳池嬉水，價格還包括早、晚自助餐！溫體牛由屠宰到上桌時間迅速，讓顧客食出肉材鮮味，價錢一定離地？跟主持往深圳火鍋店吃，鮮嫩得來花費亦化算。吃完再到超市搜購肉食，切記生肉不許帶過境。港島某雞蛋仔店製作用心，更推出加一蚊多一底優惠？另有精品朱古力飲買一送一着數。眾人還到網紅餐廳一試人均近千元的四人餐，最終三三折埋單？
月娥承認殺死淑眉；少游發現疑點後告知東坡，東坡憶起可疑人物。史密到湖邊交畫給子才，東坡現身卻遭打暈。東坡與史密被關在密室，史密認錯道出真相……東坡和少游在御前揭穿琴操身分；琴操欲殺皇上，東坡挺身阻止。
慶被友人的頑皮小孩作弄。當慶與小孩父母爭論時，卻被指他的子女亦不算好。慶回家指眾人沒有公德心後奪門而出，卻發現被他視作契仔的養龜「有龜」及其伴侶竟「離家出走」。連番打擊下，慶認為他的下一代已沒有希望。

《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

珠海某大學區隱藏滋味手工菜，筲箕海鮮配陳村粉、苦瓜撈起別具特色，「江南百花雞」更是經典名菜。凱晴、慧儀及後體驗騎馬樂，除了學騎術，不少得餵飼馬匹培養感情。深圳的大學區也有美食，吃過爆膏大頭蝦、鮮甜生蠔等火鍋料，再歎粥底精華。超市海鮮拼盤六十元人仔有找，還要無伏？香港都有性價比高的日式廚師發辦，十八道菜食材皆來自日本，人均僅約四百元！接着「味」遊泰國，品嚐由「摘星」名廚秘製食譜的招牌魷魚、船麵火鍋。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 城崎生日將至，笹山計劃偷偷為她辦生日會，小丸子為送什麼生日禮物給城崎而煩惱。藤木原來只比城崎遲一天生日，小丸子因為說過希望天天都能參加朋友的生日會，無奈之下唯有替藤木慶祝生日。
「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，Mandy姐姐繼續帶領大家感受運動的快樂。她教大家利用紙張作道具，進行全身訓練。除了融入踢毽子的動作，還建議小朋友可把紙換成抹布，運動之餘還能幫媽媽做家務，一舉兩得！接着，Mandy姐姐引領大家進行下肢肌力訓練，做出深蹲、抬腿等動作。完成後，她不忘提醒各位要補充水分，此舉亦可有效促進肌肉修復、恢復體力。另外，本集也會播放AI生成動畫《北風和太陽》的下半部份。
自小夢想成為戰鬥女英雄的如月牡丹，對三位公主心生仰慕，更因此自行縫製一套公主服，讓自己扮演洋紅公主。正當牡丹摸索如何成為一個公主時，突然遇到上好奇心旺盛的小女孩，迫水淺葱。
